It uses the fixed, ungated two-tetrahedron generator \(A=B^T-B\) and its dimensionless native evolution parameter. No derivative is identified with physical seconds or a primitive gate event.

## The exact theorem

On \(K=\langle0123,0124\rangle\), let \(c\in\mathbb R^{23}\). For every oriented adjacent-degree incidence \((i,j)\) with nonzero boundary coefficient \(b_{ij}=\pm1\), put

\[
J_{ij}(c)=2b_{ij}c_i c_j,
\qquad
L_AJ_{ij}(c)=2b_{ij}\bigl((Ac)_i c_j+c_i(Ac)_j\bigr).
\]

The carrier has \(18\) vertex–edge, \(21\) edge–face and \(8\) face–cell incidences, totaling \(47\). The exact rational rank is \(\operatorname{rank}A=22\), and \(\ker A\) is the uniform vertex line.

\[
\boxed{
Ac\ne0
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\exists(i,j):\ J_{ij}(c)\ne0\ \text{or}\ L_AJ_{ij}(c)\ne0.
}
\]

**Proof of the nontrivial direction.** Suppose every \(J_{ij}=0\), so along each incidence at least one endpoint amplitude is zero. The support of \(c\) is an independent set in the incidence graph. If \(Ac\ne0\), pick coordinate \(j\) with \((Ac)_j\ne0\). Its own amplitude must be zero: if \(c_j\ne0\), every incident neighbor amplitude is zero, forcing \((Ac)_j=0\). Since \((Ac)_j\) is a nonzero sum of incident contributions, some neighbor \(i\) has \(c_i\ne0\). Then on that incidence, \(L_AJ_{ij}=2b_{ij}c_i(Ac)_j\ne0\) (with the corresponding index order). This argument holds for any finite skew incidence generator with nonzero link weights. Conversely on this carrier, \(Ac=0\) means \(c\) is uniform on vertices and zero on higher degrees, so both every current and every slope vanish. \(\square\)

The rank calculation establishes that last carrier-specific converse. On a different complex with additional zero modes, a stationary mode needs a separate current check before claiming the same equivalence.

Set all vertices, edges and faces to zero and take the two cell amplitudes \(c_3=(1,-1)\). The state is active because its face derivative is \(-B_3(1,-1)\ne0\). All \(47\) directed currents are zero at this instant. The two shared-face incidence slopes vanish, while each of the six private face–cell current slopes equals exactly \(-2\). Thus the first jet detects activity at a snapshot where a current-only observer is blind.

This example is distinct from the all-time **vertex–edge** blindness in the previous audit. On its ongoing face–cell orbit, face–cell currents generally become nonzero. # UD factor-state jet nonidentifiability v0.1

**10 October 2026 UTC.** Physical promotion **0**. Constructor replay; independent review pending.

## Source, premise, and question

The UD coefficient ledger Q156 defines the hard edge product
\(h_e=C^{\rm hard}_{\rm cl,e}T^{\rm hard}_{\rm int,e}\). Q166 defines native adjacent-degree incidence currents, Q167 the hard-gated vertex–edge current, and Q173 the hard-gated face–cell current. The [first-jet activity audit](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T153453Z-codex-current-jet-34cb9e72) detects activity on a fixed native generator. Here the question is different: can arbitrarily many **pre-event amplitude/current derivatives** identify which factor caused a closed product gate?

This is a **conditional** information result. Assume that before the next primitive event the amplitude generator and the observed currents depend on the edge factors only through \(h_e\), with all other gates, including face gates, fixed. It does not assert that UD has admitted a particular full gated generator, physical time law, repair event, or factor-independent preparation. An independently sourced observation of a factor, or a generator term that depends separately on \(C\) and \(T\), escapes this premise.

## Exact obstruction

For an edge \(e\), \((C,T)=(0,1)\) and \((0,0)\) both give \(h_e=0\). Put identical initial amplitudes \(c_0\) in those two factor states. If \(A(C,T)=A(h)\) over the pre-event interval, then

\[
A(0,1)=A(0,0),\qquad A(0,1)^k c_0=A(0,0)^k c_0\quad(k\geq0).
\]

Consequently their entire analytic pre-event amplitude trajectories coincide, as do every derivative of any current or observation computed from those amplitudes and fixed masks. This follows from equality of the operators, so is an **all-orders theorem**, not an extrapolation from a finite jet test. No rule using only that observation history can always determine whether transport is open or closed in these two states.

To show why the ambiguity matters, declare the diagnostic intervention \(R_C:(C,T)\mapsto(1,T)\). It is **hypothetical**; the ledger does not admit this as a UD event. From \((0,1)\), it opens the product; from \((0,0)\), it leaves the product shut. Thus identical pre-event observation records are compatible with different post-event hard masks under the same factor-specific action. A predictor that receives only the product-mask amplitude history has insufficient input to pick the correct branch. A source law could also forbid one preparation or make \(R_C\) inadmissible; that would resolve this particular witness by changing the premises.

## Exact rational replay

`python3 verify.py` builds the 23-coordinate two-tetrahedron register \(\langle0123,0124\rangle\) with 47 adjacent-degree incidences. It uses the skew incidence test operator with the Q156 hard product on vertex–edge links, and all edge–face and face–cell weights fixed at one. This operator is a **diagnostic product-only lift**, not a promotion of a source-complete gated dynamics. It compares \((0,1)\) and \((0,0)\) at edge \(01\), keeps every other edge open, and starts with \(c_0=e_0+e_{01}\).

The two complete matrices agree. Amplitude jets through order 8 and all 47 Q166 current jets through order 5 agree exactly as rational numbers. Under the diagnostic \(R_C\), \(h_{01}\) becomes 1 versus 0. At the same amplitude immediately after the proposed event, the post-operator derivative difference (first state minus second) is exactly \(+e_0-e_1-e_{01}\), with all other coordinates equal. Twelve named assertions pass. The finite checks catch construction mistakes; the all-orders conclusion follows algebraically from identical matrices.

The immediate vertex–edge gated current is also still zero on an edge whenever its hard mask is zero; a current-based switch test cannot read the missing factor from that zero. This example is about **factor identifiability**, not the previous activity-detection theorem.

## Consequence for the predictive gate

The Q156 product is a compact sufficient input for following a **given** hard-mask trajectory, provided the specified dynamics factor through that product. It is not by itself a sufficient predictive state for factor-specific future events. An admissibility predicate can restrict an event, but to decide an event prospectively it needs a sourced primitive state and update rule.

A candidate source-complete event contract should state, before the event: the addressed edge or face, primitive closure receipts and transport state (or an equivalent sufficient state), the admissibility predicate, event ordering and timing parameter, the allowed factor update, and a cause-tagged pre/post receipt. It must specify the relation of edge product gates to Q173 face gates and be covariant under carrier relabeling. It must handle simultaneous candidates and null/reduction cases without a retrospective tie-break. Each clause is a **source request**, not a derived UD law.

**Stop rule:** Taking higher derivatives of observations that factor only through the same hard mask cannot distinguish its hidden Boolean decompositions. The next evidence gate is an explicit sourced factor/receipt transition law, or a proof that the separate factor states in this witness cannot both occur. Until then, mask-switch prediction remains **OPEN**, and physical promotion stays **0**.

# UD pair-to-edge mask bridge obstruction v0.1

**10 October 2026 UTC. Development lane — no registry entry.** This is a constructor-checked finite theorem under stated types, not an admitted constitutive law.

## Source question

The additional [Tetrahedral Packet Complexes site](https://tetrahedral-packet-complexes.ben-w-mayes.chatgpt.site/) represents three opposite-edge matching classes by a binary triple. Its [idle-mask theorem](https://tetrahedral-packet-complexes.ben-w-mayes.chatgpt.site/#/doc/idleMaskTheorem) constrains pair-indexed \((T,L,q)\) by \(q\leq T\) and \(TL\leq q\), leaving \(q\) free at intact-null \((T,L)=(1,0)\). [Paper I](https://tetrahedral-packet-complexes.ben-w-mayes.chatgpt.site/papers/UD_PAPER_I_REVIEW_DRAFT_v1.1.1.pdf) gives the \(S_4\to S_3\) matching action with four-element kernel and says the source of event receipts remains open. The supplied coefficient ledger v0.39(2), Q156, instead defines an edge-indexed hard product \(h_e=C_{{\rm cl},e}^{\rm hard}T_{{\rm int},e}^{\rm hard}\); Q167 algebraically verifies its vertex–edge current over all \(2^6=64\) single-tetrahedron masks.

The question is whether **pair-indexed state alone** can produce every six-edge hard mask through a deterministic rule covariant under all tetrahedral vertex relabelings. This asks about representation capacity, not physical realizability of each algebraic mask.

## Exact symmetry obstruction

The three matching classes are \(P_A=\{01,23\}\), \(P_B=\{02,13\}\), and \(P_C=\{03,12\}\). Let \(V_4=\ker(S_4\to S_3)\). Every element of \(V_4\) acts trivially on any state made solely of pair-indexed bits, including triples \(q,T,L\). On edges, \(V_4\) exchanges the two edges in each matching class. Therefore any deterministic \(S_4\)-equivariant map \(F\) from such pair state to a six-edge binary mask obeys

\[
F(x)=F(gx)=gF(x)\quad(g\in V_4).
\]

Its output must be constant on each opposite-edge pair. There are only \(2^3=8\) such masks among the \(2^6=64\) algebraically allowed masks. Thus **56 single-tetrahedron mask patterns cannot be represented by any pair-only equivariant map**, regardless of its nonlinear Boolean formula. The conclusion does not assert that the excluded masks occur in UD; it shows what a proposed pair-to-edge bridge cannot cover without an edge-resolved state or an explicitly declared symmetry reduction.

For illustration, the mathematically natural *candidate* lift copies each pair bit to both member edges: \(C_e=q_{P(e)}\), \(T_e=T_{P(e)}\), \(h_e=q_{P(e)}T_{P(e)}\). This candidate is \(S_4\)-equivariant, but **the sources do not identify these differently typed factors**. The idle-mask constraints admit \(5^3=125\) three-pair \((T,L,q)\) states; their candidate hard masks realize all eight pair-constant patterns and no other masks. At an intact-null pair, fixed \((T,L)=(1,0)\) still allows both \(q=0\) and \(q=1\), producing different candidate hard masks. Symmetry and admissibility leave the switch unresolved.

Run `python3 verify.py`. This sharpens the [live-site crosswalk](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T161257Z-codex-site-crosswalk-3f6a18b7). An edge-resolved receipt must carry information that transforms nontrivially under \(V_4\) if all 64 algebraic masks are intended. Either route still needs a pre-event law for the intact-null response, event address and ordering, and the relation to face gates. # UD six-edge receipt carrier and intact-sink decision boundary v0.1

**10 October 2026 UTC · development lane · constructor-checked · physical promotion 0.**

## Source, scope, and typed question

The live site's [Paper I, §7.4–7.5 and F05](https://tetrahedral-packet-complexes.ben-w-mayes.chatgpt.site/#/manuscript?section=F05) leaves the pre-event receipt source open. Its [Idle-Mask and Retention-Preselector Audit v0.1](https://tetrahedral-packet-complexes.ben-w-mayes.chatgpt.site/#/doc/idleMaskAudit) gives pair-addressed binary integrity \(T_p\), latent support \(L_p\), viable obligation \(\omega_p=T_pL_p\), and open response \(q_p\), with \(\omega_p\le q_p\le T_p\). Its [Idle-Response Lineage/Gate-History No-Go v0.1](https://tetrahedral-packet-complexes.ben-w-mayes.chatgpt.site/#/doc/idleResponseLineage) shows that a terminal sink with retained integrity does not choose close versus hold. The supplied **UD Coefficient Provenance Ledger v0.39(2), Q156/Q167** instead has edge-addressed hard factors \(C_{{\rm cl},e}\), \(T_{{\rm int},e}\), and product \(h_e=C_{{\rm cl},e}T_{{\rm int},e}\), and checks the algebra for all 64 binary six-edge masks. These are distinct objects, even if one eventually assigns them equal numerical values.

The previous [pair-to-edge obstruction v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T161720Z-codex-pair-edge-22aece15) proves that a deterministic \(S_4\)-equivariant map from pair-only state yields only eight pair-constant masks. Here the exact question is the capacity of an **edge-mask record**, not whether all 64 masks are UD-admissible physical states.

## Exact carrier theorem

Let the four vertex labels be \(0,1,2,3\) and let \(E=\{01,02,03,12,13,23\}\). Its three opposite-edge pairs are \(P_0=(01,23)\), \(P_1=(02,13)\), and \(P_2=(03,12)\); the displayed order is a coordinate convention. The binary mask space is \(M=\{0,1\}^{E}\). Define the record set

\[
R=\prod_{p=0}^2\{(0,\bot),(1,0),(1,1),(2,\bot)\}.
\]

For \(m\in M\), let \(n_p=m_{e_{p,0}}+m_{e_{p,1}}\). If \(n_p=1\), set \(s_p=m_{e_{p,0}}\); otherwise set \(s_p=\bot\). Then \(\operatorname{enc}:M\to R\), \(m\mapsto((n_p,s_p))_p\), is a bijection: \(n=0\) means \((0,0)\), \(n=2\) means \((1,1)\), and \((1,s)\) means \((s,1-s)\). Both sides contain \(4^3=2^6=64\) states. This is an exact, invertible representation, not a source law.

Under \(\pi\in S_4\), permute the three pairs and, when an ordered first edge maps to the target pair's second edge, flip the mixed selector \(s\mapsto1-s\). The action on \(R\) satisfies \(\operatorname{enc}(\pi m)=\pi\operatorname{enc}(m)\). Thus the six-edge record is symmetry covariant, with the within-pair selector transforming nontrivially under the Klein-four kernel \(V_4=\ker(S_4\to S_3)\).

**Independent orbit check.** Each of the three nonidentity elements of \(V_4\) fixes 16 binary masks; identity fixes 64. Burnside gives \((64+3\cdot16)/4=28\) orbits. Direct orbit enumeration also gives 28. Pair counts alone have \(3^3=27\) signatures, but the all-mixed count signature \((1,1,1)\) has *two* \(V_4\) orbits, distinguished by selector parity in the stated coordinate convention. Every other count signature has one orbit. Parity here is a kernel-orbit invariant for that special signature, not a physical chirality or dynamics claim.

## Decision rule still missing

The site audit fixes \(q=0\) for failed integrity and \(q=1\) for viable output, leaving \((T,L)=(1,0)\) ambiguous. Under a previously saturated pair \(q_-=T_-L_-\), the site's close rule \(q_+=T_+L_+\) and hold rule \(q_+=T_+(q_-\lor T_+L_+)\) disagree in exactly one of 16 source transitions: \((T_-,L_-)=(1,1)\to(T_+,L_+)=(1,0)\). Both satisfy the frozen inequality. That is a counterexample to selecting the response from lineage and gate history alone, reproduced here independently as a finite check; it does not prove either rule true. Without previous saturation, disagreement includes any previously open intact-null input with the same intact-null output.

The carrier \(R\) can **record** a supplied edge mask and track externally supplied changes. It does not decide \(C_{{\rm cl},e}\), \(T_{{\rm int},e}\), the product's next value, which pair-level \(q_p\) affects which edge, or the event's physical time. A native decision contract must identify a pre-event state and receipt, domain and codomain, an edge-resolved factor update (or a sourced restriction to pair-constant masks), the intact-sink close/hold rule, and event-order/clock convention. This is the next source dependency. Operational Hodge margins on the live site are typed soft transport margins; reusing them as hard semantic edge factors needs a separate intertwining argument.

## Reproduction and disposition

Run `python3 verify.py` from this package. Standard library only. It verifies bijection; all 24 relabelings on all 64 masks; the four kernel elements; fixed-point and independent direct-orbit counts; count-signature multiplicities; the site's five admissible pair triples; and all 16 saturated local transitions. `results.json` records exact integers. The count of 1,551 assertions is an implementation count, not independent experiments.

- **EXACT, conditional mathematical scope:** invertible covariant record; 28 \(V_4\) orbits; one saturated transition where close/hold differ.
- **CANDIDATE:** use this record as an edge receipt type; no UD event constructor or factor map sourced.
- **OPEN_GATED:** source-admitted edge-mask family, pair-to-edge factor bridge, intact-sink response, hard update, event order and physical clock.
- **NO-GO under present constraints:** the record and pair lineage alone cannot predict the intact-sink switch.
- **Governance:** constructor checks only, non-constructor review pending; no registry promotion; physical promotion remains 0. Prior releases are preserved without amendment.

Keep the primitive structure fixed for the whole trajectory: fully retained K4 required closure receipts all one, local edge maps \(U_e=I\) on their declared one-dimensional complex transport spaces, and no change to requirements. Consequently \(C_e=T_e=h_e=1\) at all six edges throughout. The signed source changes yet the hard mask does not. `python3 verify.py` checks the boundary identity, eigenvector identities, exact rational endpoint stocks, selector address, and structural mask persistence with standard-library `Fraction` arithmetic. Trigonometric endpoint values are exact analytic identities, not floating-point measurements.

# UD direct-Theta event to typed closure and hard-mask pushforward v0.1

**10 October 2026 UTC · append-only source-scope amendment and exact conditional theorem · physical promotion 0.**

## Source recovery and correction

`UD_THETA_FLIP_DIRECT_EVENT_INPUT_SOURCE_ADDENDUM_v0.1.md` (26 August 2026; Library `libfile_6145629eb8c081919302d99d60df1c82`, “Transition,” “Local source protocol,” and “Missing source”) is an **admitted internal interface**. It defines

\[
\Theta^+=P_g\Theta^-\oplus\xi,
\qquad \Theta,\xi\in\mathbb F_2^3,
\]

for a provenance-bound direct event input \(\xi\) with current class `EXTERNAL_QUARANTINED`. `UD_THETA_FLIP_DIRECT_PRIMITIVE_SOURCE_ADDENDUM_AUDIT_v0.1.md` (26 August; Library `libfile_176d2121e0708191bbc529c33a92cafc`, §§II–VIII and X) proves direction/count and covariance for a **supplied** \(\xi\), while explicitly leaving its endogenous cause open. The package `UD_OMEGA0_PHASE23_THETA_EVENT_AND_CONTROL_BOUNDARY_PACKAGE_v0.1.zip` (Library `libfile_5c9aeab36a448191bf27669bf18f1099`, SHA-256 `b6037a5610d19937178801de3078371b017c16b08fa0f29d78f6e2d0b25f50a0`) contains a quarantine wrapper and 384 conditional test cases. It contains no independent pre-event signed \(G_p^{S\pm}\) matched to outcomes. The separate `UD_THETA_HISTORY_TO_CLOSURE_GATE_HISTORY_THEOREM_v0.1.md` (23 August; Library `libfile_bb82dc6467288191ac6691c1ef6019cf`) pushes an **already supplied** ordered \(\Theta\)-history to edge closure masks.

**Amendment to prior wording:** The [historical selector scope report](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T164302Z-codex-historical-pair-5b327476), [static-null audit](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T164734Z-codex-native-static-null-b71cb9e8), and [intake source audit](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T165944Z-codex-op03-intake-ed488bce) used “primitive update open” without enumerating this admitted exogenous direct-\(\Theta\) interface. The precise result is: **post-event \(\Theta\) and its closure-factor lift are exact once a valid external flip receipt is supplied; an endogenous/pre-event predictor of \(\xi\) and a local edge transport-integrity update remain OPEN.** The prior artifacts remain immutable. This correction changes no physical status.

## New exact typed consequence

Domain: a fixed labeled K4 with opposite-edge pairs \(A=(01,23),B=(02,13),C=(03,12)\), pre-state \(\Theta^-\in\mathbb F_2^3\), a sourced pair permutation \(P_g\), flip receipt \(\xi\in\mathbb F_2^3\), and six independently typed binary local edge transport-integrity values \(T_e\). Let \(Y=P_g\Theta^-\). The closure factor in this **specific pair-lift context** is \(C_{{\rm cl},e}=1-\theta_{p(e)}\); this is not a claim that all context-dependent closure requirement sets are pair-identical. Compare pre/post in the same relabeled edge frame. Then

\[
C_{{\rm cl},e}^-=1-Y_{p(e)},\quad
C_{{\rm cl},e}^+=1-(Y_{p(e)}\oplus\xi_{p(e)}),\quad
C_{{\rm cl},e}^-\oplus C_{{\rm cl},e}^+=\xi_{p(e)}.
\]

Each flipped pair changes **two closure factors**, so \(C_E^{\rm cl}=2\sum_p(1-Y_p)\xi_p\) and \(O_E^{\rm cl}=2\sum_pY_p\xi_p\). If the six \(T_e\) remain fixed across this update and \(h_e=C_{{\rm cl},e}T_e\), the counts of actual **hard-mask** closures and openings are instead

\[
C_E^{\rm hard}=\sum_p(1-Y_p)\xi_p\sum_{e\in M_p}T_e,
\qquad
O_E^{\rm hard}=\sum_pY_p\xi_p\sum_{e\in M_p}T_e.
\]

Thus \(0\le C_E^{\rm hard}\le C_E^{\rm cl}\) and similarly for openings. The two counts agree only if the flipped relevant edge transport predicates pass. If \(T_e\) itself changes, use the typed post-state \(h_e^+=C_{{\rm cl},e}^+T_e^+\); the fixed-\(T\) count theorem cannot be applied. \(U_e\) (the local edge map tested by \(T_e\)) is not the oriented global \(C_1\) transport used to recover a relative frame.

**Proof:** The XOR identity is coordinatewise over \(\mathbb F_2\); each pair has exactly two edges. A closure is \((Y_p,\xi_p)=(0,1)\), an opening is \((1,1)\). Multiplying each changing closure bit by fixed \(T_e\) gives the two weighted sums. No numeric coefficient or physical metric is introduced. `verify.py` exhausts all \(8\) pre-states, \(6\) pair permutations, \(8\) flip masks and \(64\) transport masks: **24,576** exact cases and **147,456** pair-relabeling covariance comparisons. For pre-state \((0,1,0)\) and all \(T_e=1\), flip \((1,0,0)\) closes A while flip \((0,1,0)\) reopens B; both satisfy the admitted *conditional* interface. If one A-edge transport gate is already failed, the A flip changes two closure factors but only one hard-mask bit.

The Phase 23 source verifier's direct-\(\Theta\) block (lines 1–43 of `verify_ud_omega0_phase23_v0_1.py`, original SHA-256 `6709d5ab6c7f98c96a15badc660e7d32ddee7845a25ca596ef2143247d8cb8a2`) was rerun against its original quarantine module (SHA-256 `49ce70c77f80dfa0bede388b4fc2f000b473ad9ab48e5268e54305a0158d512b`) with only its absolute `/mnt/data` base path rebound to the extracted package directory. It passed **384** direct-event cases, covariance, and missing-receipt deferral. The complete original verifier could not be rerun in this environment because its separate control-boundary block imports `0runtime_full_module_v0_3_payload_guard_sync.py`, absent from that package; no control verification is claimed here. `source_rerun/source_theta_only_rerun.py` preserves the path-adapted block and `source_rerun/theta_flip_event_quarantine_contract_v0_1.py` preserves the path-adapted module. The new `verify.py` independently implements the closure and fixed-\(T\) mask enumeration.

## Endogenous source and independent-history limit

The same pre-state \(\Theta^-\), pair frame and typed \(T\) admit distinct post-states when independent valid external \(\xi\) receipts are supplied. This is an **exact formal nonidentifiability witness for deriving \(\xi\) from those pre-inputs alone**, not a claim that both histories arise under one undiscovered native dynamics. It refines, rather than supersedes, the identity/complement diagnostic countermodels in `UD_PREDICTIVE_EVENT_SOURCE_CONTRACT_v0.1.md` (28 September; Library `libfile_fa387efebcf88191ac038e30927d49c7`, §3). Current sources do not define a map from the signed source \(G_p^{S\pm}\), cochains, closure-defect state, or admissibility to \(\xi\). The historical §7 v0.4 sign-to-capacity rule remains a conditional candidate, not the source of the admitted flip receipt.

An independently produced `EXTERNAL_QUARANTINED` \(\xi\) history could be an OP03 **target** only if its provider did not call the candidate selector and the same carrier has raw pre-event cochains or auditable signed \(G_p^{S\pm}\), eligibility, ordered event boundaries and independent outcomes. Its parity quotient also loses even-bit endpoint differences, so it cannot replace a full \(\Theta\) score. `UD_OP03_JOINT_REPLAY_RUNTIME_PATCH_v0.9.json` (Library `libfile_85a55a0fb59c8191a9c35d23cf68f71e`) explicitly marks the independent event corpus OPEN and empirical held-out status NOT_RUN. Domain: one labeled K4 opposite-pair state \(\Theta\in\mathbb F_2^3\), a declared pair permutation \(\pi\in S_3\), pair-integrity bits \(I\), signed rational source vector \(G\), and nonnegative rational burden vector \(W\). The historical code writes `y[pi[i]]=x[i]`, whereas Phase 23 writes `y[j]=x[p[j]]`. **Use \(p=\pi^{-1}\)**. With every input relabeled in the same frame, let

\[
Y=P_{\pi^{-1}}\Theta,\quad
Z=F(Y,\pi I,\pi G,\pi W),\quad
\xi_{\rm cand}=Y\oplus Z.
\]

Then the admitted direct-update *algebra*, **if an independently valid receipt for that same \(\xi\) exists**, gives \(P_{\pi^{-1}}\Theta\oplus\xi_{\rm cand}=Z\). This is a composition identity, not a derivation of the receipt or its event cause. The selector outputs Hamming weight 1 for close/reopen, 2 for its zero-total swap, and 0 for holds. The Phase 23 API treats `None` as **THETA_UPDATE_DEFERRED** with local \(\Theta\) preserved; a valid zero-mask receipt is **APPLIED** and returns \(P_g\Theta\). It does not define a closure-event trigger. ## The sourced negative certificate

\[
 C_e^+=C_e^-,\quad T_e^+=T_e^-,\quad h_e^+=h_e^-.

The source baseline is `UD_EDGE_CLOSURE_AND_TRANSPORT_INTEGRITY_HARD_GATE_DERIVATION_v0.1.md` (21 August 2026, §§II–IV; Library `libfile_e9d5b0d7a4bc81918822ae403d527626`), where \(C_e\) is a context-dependent conjunction of closure receipts, \(T_e\) checks a locally lawful typed map, and \(h_e=C_eT_e\). `UD_HARD_GATE_UPDATE_LAW_SOURCE_DERIVATION_v0.1.md` (23 August, §§1–5; `libfile_a80bf50559c88191a8b3b411cb38d93c`) and `UD_HARD_GATE_BOOLEAN_FACTOR_UPDATE_THEOREM_v0.1.md` (23 August, Gate closure/opening and What is not derived; `libfile_10b3069a88a48191bd7190f02f91807b`) close conditional factor logic and explicitly leave predicate dynamics source-blocked. The historical `UD_JOP_WORKING_MANUSCRIPT_THROUGH_SECTION11_v1.2_JOINT_REPLAY_GOVERNED.md` (30 August, Library `libfile_8b9461fba6248191bb6d58dcf977a977`, §6.2) specializes the local transport test to exact isometry in a contractive sector. The public [UD site](https://tetrahedral-packet-complexes.ben-w-mayes.chatgpt.site/) reports physical promotion 0 and independent review pending as of this source check.

## Conditional exact local map class

This is a **new candidate model class**, not a recovered UD constitutive law. Let \(V_e\cong\mathbb R^d\) have a fixed Euclidean metric and declared domain/codomain. Let the pre-event local map \(U_n:V_e\to V_e\) be a contraction and the **supplied** update components be an orthogonal \(R_n\) and a contraction \(K_n\) with \(K_n^TK_n\preceq I\). Define

\[
U_{n+1}=R_nK_nU_n,\qquad
Q_n=I-U_n^TU_n,\qquad T_n=\mathbf1[Q_n=0].
\]

The exact algebra gives

\[
\boxed{Q_{n+1}-Q_n=U_n^T(I-K_n^TK_n)U_n\succeq0.}
\]

Consequently \(T_n=0\Rightarrow T_{n+1}=0\), because a nonzero positive semidefinite \(Q_n\) cannot decrease to zero. If \(T_n=1\), square \(U_n\) is invertible and

\[
\boxed{T_{n+1}=\mathbf1[K_n^TK_n=I].}
\]

This is an **EXACT conditional pre-step transition rule once \(K_n,R_n\) are supplied before the event**. It is covariant under consistent orthogonal changes of basis. If the proposed \(K_n\) is a self-loss function with \(K(Q=0,c)^TK(Q=0,c)=I\) for every admitted cochain state \(c\), the clean set \(Q=0\) is invariant under this discrete rule: it cannot spontaneously create a transport-integrity failure. To trigger one from a clean state requires a sourced **transverse nonisometric step** or a different primitive event mechanism. A pure contractive composition can never reopen exact hard transport integrity; reopening needs a reset/repreparation, changed fiber/metric, or a map class outside these assumptions. This says nothing about a distinct pair-level \(\Theta\) closure/reopening.

The same type discipline makes the gap explicit: neither \(K_n\) nor \(R_n\) is derived from the pre-event UD chain cochains, defect field, closure receipts, or admissibility. Passing them as named inputs is a conditional model, not a native predictor. Choosing \(K_n\prec I\) whenever \(G_\Sigma<0\) would fail the [fixed-structure K4 null](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T164734Z-codex-native-static-null-b71cb9e8), which has negative signed source while its declared local maps stay isometric. Assigning a post-event \(K_n\) after seeing the switch would leak the target.

## Finite exact check and countermodels

`verify.py` uses rational \(2\times2\) maps, eight signed permutation isometries and nine diagonal contractions with singular values in \(\{0,\tfrac12,1\}\). It checks all **5,184** two-step paths from \(U_0=I\), including **2,880** paths with first-step rank loss. The general statements follow from the displayed algebra, not the finite cases alone.

Two different pre-event completions with identical \((c_n,U_n)\) remain lawful in this declared model: \(K_n=I\) preserves integrity; \(K_n=\operatorname{diag}(\tfrac12,1)\) fails it. # UD native-flow projection boundary v0.1

**11 October 2026 UTC · development — no registry entry · physical promotion 0.**

## Source question and types

The selected task asks for a pre-event local transport or closure update, and an independent same-carrier K4/`Theta` target. The source object here is the **global chain evolution**, not an already defined edge transport. The supplied `UD_COEFFICIENT_PROVENANCE_LEDGER_v0.39(2).md`, Q169, locks a skew global Hodge–Dirac operator on uniquely owned cochains, while Q156/Q167/Q173 use **given** hard masks. The exact K4 incidence and a fixed-`U_e=I` null are frozen in [`UD primitive-update audit and static K4 null v0.1`](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T164734Z-codex-native-static-null-b71cb9e8), §§1–3. The 21 August `UD_EDGE_CLOSURE_AND_TRANSPORT_INTEGRITY_HARD_GATE_DERIVATION_v0.1.md`, §§II–IV (Library `libfile_e9d5b0d7a4bc81918822ae403d527626`) defines a context-dependent lawful local transport predicate, not a projection of the chain evolution. The 30 August `UD_JOP_WORKING_MANUSCRIPT_THROUGH_SECTION11_v1.2_JOINT_REPLAY_GOVERNED.md`, §6.2 (Library `libfile_8b9461fba6248191bb6d58dcf977a977`) specializes its transport gate to exact isometry `T_e=1[I-U_e^*U_e=0]` for a contractive sector. The proposed bridge `U_e=P_eO(s)P_e` below is **new and deliberately adversarial**; the cited sources do not identify these two typed operators.

## Exact native calculation

Take the oriented filled tetrahedron `Delta^3`, Euclidean real chain register `C=C_0⊕C_1⊕C_2⊕C_3` of dimensions `4+6+4+1=15`, vertex order 0–3 and simplex orientations increasing. Let `B_k:C_k→C_{k-1}` be its exact incidence maps and

\[
A=\begin{pmatrix}
0&-B_1&0&0\\
B_1^T&0&-B_2&0\\
0&B_2^T&0&-B_3\\
0&0&B_3^T&0
\end{pmatrix},\qquad O(s)=e^{sA}.
\]

`A:C→C` is skew adjoint, `s` is a **dimensionless native parameter**, and `O(s)` is orthogonal. Initial data for the diagnostic are any canonical unit edge basis vector `e∈C_1`; no boundary change, defect source, loss, or physical clock is posited. Direct incidence gives

\[
B_1^TB_1+B_2B_2^T=4I_6,\qquad B_1B_2=B_2B_3=0,
\qquad A^2e=-4e.
\]

Thus the trajectory on the two-dimensional invariant plane `span(e,Ae)` is exactly

\[
O(s)e=\cos(2s)e+\tfrac12\sin(2s)Ae.
\]

Declare the **candidate projection bridge** `V_e=span(e)` with orthogonal projection `P_e` and `U_e^{proj}(s)=P_eO(s)P_e|_{V_e}:V_e→V_e`. Since `Ae⊥e`,

\[
\boxed{U_e^{proj}(s)=\cos(2s)I_{V_e}},\qquad
\boxed{Q_e^{proj}(s)=I-(U_e^{proj})^*U_e^{proj}=\sin^2(2s)I_{V_e}}.
\]

For each of the six edges, at native `s=0,\pi/4,\pi/2` the projected scalar is respectively `1,0,-1`, and its exact-isometry hard gate is `1,0,1`. This is a **mathematical projection sequence**, not six observed UD mask switches. The underlying full flow is lawful throughout, and `U_e^{proj}=-I` at `\pi/2` is again an isometry. No fitted threshold or physical unit enters.

## Why a local contractive step misses the return

For a chosen step `h=\pi/4`, `O_h=O(h)` is orthogonal and `O_h^2=O(2h)`, but compression does not preserve composition:

\[
P_eO_h^2P_e
=(P_eO_hP_e)^2+P_eO_h(I-P_e)O_hP_e
=-I_{V_e},\qquad (P_eO_hP_e)^2=0.
\]

The `-I` term returns through the complement. Equivalently, for `x_n=P_e\psi_n`, `y_n=(I-P_e)\psi_n`, native source flow entails the **exact augmented-state recurrence**

\[
x_{n+1}=P_eO_hP_ex_n+P_eO_h(I-P_e)y_n,\quad
y_{n+1}=(I-P_e)O_hP_ex_n+(I-P_e)O_h(I-P_e)y_n.
\]

This predicts the projected amplitude from a specified full pre-event chain state and interval. It is **not** a closure receipt or a justified map on the source's internal edge transport fiber. The previous [conditional contractive update boundary v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T225355Z-codex-transport-boundary-6666de3f) assumes `U_{n+1}=R_nK_nU_n`; from `U_h=0`, no such composition can give `U_{2h}=-I`. Its one-way theorem remains exact under its own assumptions. This counterexample shows why the native projection cannot be inserted into that one-step class without environmental memory or a separate reset.

## Frozen-null test and decision

The prior exact [fixed-structure K4 null v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T164734Z-codex-native-static-null-b71cb9e8) allows the same native cochain operator to evolve while primitive closure receipts and six declared internal edge maps `U_e=I` remain fixed. The compression identification would instead label each edge integrity failure at `s=\pi/4`. Those are different **model completions**: a change of global chain amplitude is not by itself a failure of the typed internal transport map. Therefore **NO-GO, scoped:** `P_eO(s)P_e` cannot be asserted as a *universal* source-derived local transport law consistent with that allowed fixed-map completion. This does not forbid a new context-specific bridge with an explicit internal fiber, metric, connection, and structural change mechanism. It also says nothing about pair-level `Theta` events. Exact recurrence times here reflect the finite native operator spectrum, not physical recurrence.

`verify.py` independently constructs all oriented boundary maps from simplex lists; it checks `B_1B_2=B_2B_3=0`, edge Laplacian `4I_6`, `A^3=-4A`, two exact polynomial evaluations of `e^{sA}`, orthogonality and composition on the full 15-space, the six compressed edges, and agreement with the prior frozen null's `B_1,B_2`. It uses rational arithmetic for the exact endpoint operators. The general formula follows algebraically, not from enumerating six edges alone.

## Independent target intake

The frozen `UD_OP03_INDEPENDENT_EVENT_ACQUISITION_PROTOCOL_v0.1.md` (30 August, Library `libfile_30fb9c2688f08191acb9119bfdb6a2f4`, Event boundary through Scoring) and the [OP03 intake v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T165944Z-codex-op03-intake-ed488bce) require ordered pre-event cochains/transport, a predictor freeze before endpoint exposure, an independent producer and sealed post-event `Theta` receipts. Current GitHub `main` at `f2fc124c2bdf6db1fb1700ace2acd1f7634190d9` adds no such producer; a repository filename search found no `pre_event.jsonl` or `outcomes.jsonl`. A fresh Library listing after 10 October 18:25 UTC yielded this project's previous release and MQM files; targeted queries found no new qualifying history. The known generated history remains ineligible because it used the selector to label its endpoints, as recorded in [eligibility audit v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T165456Z-codex-event-eligibility-d4d33a75). The supplied older `Gap2_FINAL_STATUS.md` and placeholder ZIP do not contain K4/`Theta` event receipts. `Gap2_FINAL_Finite_Genesis.png` failed to materialize and was **not inspected**.

**NO_DATA / NOT_RUN:** no independent same-carrier history is available for scoring. This is an acquisition status, not a negative empirical finding. Reopening requires a versioned independent producer with code hash, complete consecutive eligible and null windows, raw ordered pre-event cochains and structural receipts, frozen eligibility, and sealed independently generated endpoint `Theta` labels; then run the existing OP03 intake unchanged.

## Disposition

**EXACT conditional:** edge Laplacian and projected return with noncomposition. **NO-GO, scoped:** naive global-flow compression as a universal internal edge transport law. **OPEN:** constitutive, typed map from native packet state/connection to the internal edge fiber and primitive closure update; independent OP03 target. No autonomous dynamics or physical correspondence promoted. The supplied `UD_GOVERNANCE_CRL2_SUBDIVISION_v1.0.md`, §§1–4, is a governance proposal; non-constructor review remains pending. # UD connected seam connection and discrete-event boundary v0.1

**11 October 2026 UTC · development — no registry entry · physical promotion 0.**

## Question and source identities

Can pre-event UD phase/connection data produce a typed local transport update and decide a hard-mask or K4/`Theta` event? The 21 August `UD_EDGE_CLOSURE_AND_TRANSPORT_INTEGRITY_HARD_GATE_DERIVATION_v0.1.md`, §§I–IV (Library `libfile_e9d5b0d7a4bc81918822ae403d527626`), separates closure from holonomy and defines `h_e=C_eT_e` using required closure receipts and a lawful local transport predicate. The 30 August `UD_JOP_WORKING_MANUSCRIPT_THROUGH_SECTION11_v1.2_JOINT_REPLAY_GOVERNED.md`, §6.2 (`libfile_8b9461fba6248191bb6d58dcf977a977`), has an exact-isometry transport specialization `T_e=1[I-U_e^*U_e=0]`. The supplied `UD_COEFFICIENT_PROVENANCE_LEDGER_v0.39(2).md`, Q156/Q167/Q169/Q173, uses given hard masks with native support operators; it does not generate a seam update.

`UD_COFACE_NEWBORN_PACKET_TRANSPORT_INHERITANCE_AND_FORMATION_DEBIT_RECEIPT_TESTBED_v0.1.md` (3 October; Library `libfile_1ec04cb5aeb88191bfbe754c85d327ca`, §§1–5) exhibits a continuous seam family after structural closure, with two common-axis gauge-invariant newborn differences. It therefore supplies a source-owned **underdetermination control**: closure and inherited face transports do not choose a new seam. `UD_THETA_TRANSPORT_LIFT_v0.1.md` (30 August; `libfile_baae91f0c9d081918c739c6524668e9d`, §§2, 4, 6, 11–12) constructs a distinct eight-dimensional `Theta` representation and explicitly leaves the packet-transport-to-`S_3` receipt and pre-event parity selector open. Its affine receipt `a_e=theta_e^+ XOR P_sigma theta_e^-` is reconstructed from the endpoint; it cannot be used as a pre-event predictor.

## Typed connected testbed

Fix a labeled, fully retained filled K4 with Euclidean one-complex-dimensional node fibers `V_i=C` and pre-event oriented links `u_{ij}:V_i→V_j` of modulus one. Set `u_{ji}=u_{ij}^{-1}` and allow gauge changes `u_{ij}→g_j u_{ij}g_i^{-1}`, `g_i∈U(1)`. This is a **declared common-axis candidate sector** of a packet seam connection, not a derivation that identifies the general UD internal edge transport with phase. All required closure receipts are one. The candidate state space `X=U(1)^6` is connected. A conditional phase evolution would be `u_{ij,n+1}=exp(i alpha_{ij,n})u_{ij,n}`, with real pre-event one-cochain `alpha_n`, initial link values and fixed boundary context; UD has not supplied a constitutive `alpha_n`.

On this candidate sector, each `u_{ij}` is unitary and has a well-typed inverse, so **under the §6.2 exact-isometry specialization** `Q_{T,ij}=I-u_{ij}^*u_{ij}=0`, `T_{ij}=1`, and `h_{ij}=1` for every phase update. Holonomy around `ijk` is `u_{ki}u_{jk}u_{ij}` and may differ from the identity without integrity failure. This is a lawful testbed under its declared full node domains; it does not assert that every possible UD context has the same transport conditions. The identity links reproduce the [frozen K4 static-null completion v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-10T164734Z-codex-native-static-null-b71cb9e8), including its fixed mask despite `G=(-1,-1/2,-1/2)`. Nonzero support loss does not change that conclusion.

## Exact finite census and topological obstruction

`verify.py` takes the exact fourth-root subgroup `mu_4={1,i,-1,-i}` for each of six edges. Of `4^6=4096` exact assignments, `4^3=64` are flat; each is a pure gauge assignment after fixing one vertex phase. The remaining `4032` are nonflat and **all** pass the exact-isometry integrity test. There are `64` holonomy/gauge classes in this finite grid. These are counts of phase assignments, not event probabilities, and are not a sampled continuum result. The code also rechecks all `8×6=48` affine `Theta` permutation lifts on their **separate** eight-state carrier; each is unitary, and some change Hamming weight. Their unitarity does not identify them with the one-dimensional edge links.

**EXACT topological theorem (declared assumptions).** Let `D` be `Theta=F_2^3` or the finite matching-frame group `S_3` with the discrete topology. Any continuous selector `F:X→D` on connected `X=U(1)^6` is constant: its image is connected in a discrete set and thus contains one point. If normalized at identity to `000` or the identity frame, it takes that value everywhere. The same proof holds on any connected component of a continuous Spin(3)/SO(2) seam sector, with fixed discrete structural receipts. No group-homomorphism assumption is needed.

**NO-GO, scoped:** continuous phase motion alone, read through a globally continuous map with fixed labeled structure, cannot select a nontrivial discrete `Theta` toggle or matching-frame permutation. Separately, isometric phase motion cannot cause a `T_e` failure under the exact-isometry specialization. This does **not** prohibit a sourced discontinuity, singularity, topology-changing admission, discrete receipt, threshold with fixed boundary rule, or nonunitary retained-environment channel. It specifies what extra input must be sourced and frozen before claims of occurrence or timing.

The candidate [native-flow projection boundary v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/tree/main/captures/2026-10-11T010749Z-codex-native-projection-c9c95ae7) used `P_e exp(sA)P_e` on a **chain edge subspace** and produced a transient Gram defect. That compression and this unitary **internal seam fiber** are different carriers and maps; neither can be silently substituted for the other.

## Independent K4/`Theta` producer search

On the filled oriented tetrahedron with Euclidean chain support metric, let (B_1:C_1\to C_0), (B_2:C_2\to C_1), and let (A) be the native skew Hodge–Dirac generator on (C_0\oplus C_1\oplus C_2\oplus C_3). Let (\bar\theta^-=100); the open seats are B and C. Let (\mathcal L^-=\mathcal L^+=\operatorname{span}_{\mathbb Q}(e_B,e_C)), (F=I_2), no additions, all pair-integrity receipts one. This release derives a native memory lift and checks a candidate guard without changing the frozen source.

## Exact 12-dimensional native memory lift

Set (q=c_1\in C_1(K_4)=\mathbb R^6) and (p=\dot c_1=B_1^Tc_0-B_2c_2\in C_1). The source generator uses (\dot c_0=-B_1c_1), (\dot c_2=B_2^Tc_1-B_3c_3), with (B_2B_3=0). On the filled tetrahedron, (B_1^TB_1+B_2B_2^T=4I_6). Hence

\[
\dot q=p,\qquad \dot p=-4q,\qquad
M(s)=\begin{pmatrix}\cos(2s)I_6&\tfrac12\sin(2s)I_6\\-2\sin(2s)I_6&\cos(2s)I_6\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Initial conditions (q(0),p(0)) are independent: (p\) is realized by (c_0=B_1p/4,\ c_2=-B_2^Tp/4\), with (c_1=q,c_3=0). This canonical minimum-norm lift (L:C_1\oplus C_1\to C_0\oplus C_1\oplus C_2\oplus C_3) has (A L=L\begin{psmallmatrix}0&I\\-4I&0\end{psmallmatrix}\), and (L^TL=\operatorname{diag}(I_6,I_6/4)\). The induced positive stock (\lVert q\rVert^2+\lVert p\rVert^2/4\) is conserved. The map is an exact 12-dimensional invariant subspace of the 15-dimensional source generator. This does not contradict the prior result that **no nonzero invariant subspace lies entirely inside the six-dimensional (C_1)**.

**EXACT minimality, specified class:** for a linear time-homogeneous first-order realization representing every native (q) trajectory with (q) as readout, the initial jet ((q(0),\dot q(0))\) ranges freely over (\mathbb R^{12}). A realization state must distinguish all these jets, so its linear state dimension is at least 12. (L) attains the bound. This is a minimal realization of the native (C_1) readout under these assumptions, not a primitive packet transport law.

At (s=\pi/4), (M=\begin{psmallmatrix}0&I_6/2\\-2I_6&0\end{psmallmatrix}\), (M^2=-I_{12}), and (M^{-1}=-M). The (q\to q) block vanishes, but (q\to p) carries (-2I_6). The singularity of a (q)-only compression is therefore **not** a singularity of the native memory lift. `memory_lift.py` independently verifies the chain incidence, 15-by-12 intertwiner, positive metric, exact quarter-step inverse and all 24 (S_4) equivariance cases using rational arithmetic.

**CANDIDATE bridge, conditional:** let (R_W(r)=\operatorname{diag}(\rho_1(r),\rho_1(r))\). If a separately sourced observed operator satisfies (T_W^{obs}=R_W(r)M(s)) and its co-moving companion is (D_W^{cf}=M(s)) on the same frozen history, then (T_W^{obs}(D_W^{cf})^{-1}=R_W(r)), including at the (q)-only quarter-step singularity. All 24 exact conditional fixtures pass. The native (A) supplies (M), **not** a nonidentity (r) or the assumed observed/co-moving factorization. Reusing the v0.7 six-dimensional boundary extractor on the 12-dimensional operator requires an explicitly defined bridge; equal edge dimensions do not identify the carriers. Frame-source and switch-source claims remain **OPEN_GATED**.

## Independent finite guard reproduction

`guard_replay.py` reimplements the v0.2 shell optimizer and candidate v0.2.1 coordinate-seat guard using three-bit masks, independently of the earlier matrix verifier. It enumerates all (8\) pre-event Θ states, (8\) frozen coordinate output-seat sets, (8\) pair-integrity masks, and (3^3=27\) exact burden-score vectors: (8^3\cdot3^3=13{,}824\) algebraic combinations. It checks six (S_3) relabelings per combination, (82{,}944\) exact covariance checks.

| Candidate guard classification | Cases |
|---|---:|
| Required open seat fails integrity | 7,992 |
| Admissible no change, (a=000) | 729 |
| Θ switch, (a\ne000) | 5,103 |
| Of switches, zero index (\mu=0) | 972 |

These counts include repeated exact score vectors and are **not** event frequencies. There are (3^3=27) no-change seat/mask combinations, each replicated over 27 score vectors, hence 729. The original v0.2 shell-only optimizer has 912 unique endpoints inconsistent with the coordinate-complete output seat among the cases where the candidate seat guard is integrity-admissible. **EXACT coordinate-seat theorem.** If the frozen viable output obligation space is exactly (\mathcal L^+=\operatorname{span}\{e_p:p\in S^+\}\), any coordinate endpoint satisfying (\operatorname{span}\{e_p:\theta_p^+=0\}=\mathcal L^+\) is uniquely (\theta_p^+=0\iff p\in S^+\). \[
p=\frac13\sum_iP(E_i=1),\qquad
a=\frac13\sum_{i<j}P(E_i=E_j=1),\qquad
b=P(E_1=E_2=E_3=1).
\]

These are mean marginal, mean pair joint, and triple joint error probabilities. The identity

\[
\mathbf1_{E_1+E_2+E_3\ge2}
=E_1E_2+E_1E_3+E_2E_3-2E_1E_2E_3
\]

holds on all eight binary patterns. Therefore majority error is exactly

\[
\boxed{m=3a-2b.}
\]

No permutation symmetry is required. Quantities may be averaged over the fair source label; conditional source-specific statistics can instead be treated separately.

## 2. Sharp joint-moment bounds

Let Q_k=P(sum_i E_i=k). The moments give

\[
Q_0=1-3p+3a-b,\quad Q_1=3p-6a+3b,
\quad Q_2=3a-3b,\quad Q_3=b.
\]

Nonnegativity is equivalent to

\[
b_{\min}=\max(0,2a-p)\le b\le
b_{\max}=\min(a,1-3p+3a).
\]

Thus, for feasible moments,

\[
\boxed{3a-2b_{\max}\le m\le3a-2b_{\min}.}
\]

The bounds are sharp. Choose b at either endpoint, construct the nonnegative Q_k, and distribute Q_k uniformly among the binomial(3,k) patterns of weight k. This gives an explicit law attaining each bound. The checker verifies normalization, moments and majority error of those witnesses using fractions.

With only marginal mean p=1/100, majority error can be anywhere from zero to 3/200. The worst case puts mass 3p/2 on exactly-two-error patterns. Therefore a quoted one-percent receipt error alone does not certify a majority advantage; the resulting majority can be worse than a single receipt.

| p | Mean pair joint a | Sharp majority-error interval |
|---|---|---|
| 1/100 | 1/10000 | [1/10000, 3/10000] |
| 1/100 | 1/1000 | [1/1000, 3/1000] |
| 1/100 | 1/100 | {1/100} |

For pairwise independent equal-marginal receipts, a=p². Triple independence need not hold, and m need not equal 3p²−2p³. Nonetheless the worst-case m<=3p² is small enough for the current criterion.

## 3. Decision faults without an independence assumption

Let L denote the parity of the three forward majority-target faults and the seed-copy fault. Suppose each of those four event probabilities is bounded by q. By the union bound,

\[
P(L=1)\le4q.
\]

This remains valid for correlated decision events. The final seed is wrong when receipt-majority error and L disagree. Consequently

\[
p_{\rm seed}\le m+P(L=1)\le3a-2b_{\min}+4q\le3a+4q.
\]

No independence between acquisition and decision errors is required for these upper bounds. They are sufficient guarantees, not exact formulas for every joint law. The previous parity formula [1−(1−2q)^4]/2 remains exact only under its independent decision-fault model.

Storage is still assumed to use fresh independent bath states and to depend only on the written seed. If its ideal-seed error is e0 and the average seed error is s, the final equal-prior error is e0+(1−2e0)s while s<=1/2. The formula also allows unequal errors conditional on R=0 and R=1: s is their average. It follows by subtracting the two binary-mixture memory distributions.

For the current 32-update ground storage and target epsilon=1/100, define

\[
s_*=\frac{\epsilon-e_0}{1-2e_0}.
\]

The replay's exact rational e0 gives s* approximately 0.000775497742. A robust sufficient source gate is

\[
\boxed{3a+4q\le s_*.}
\]

A tighter version uses 3a−2b_min+4q if p is also available. These gates retain ideal reverse cleanup and ideal fanout; faults outside the four stated decision events need their own terms.

## 4. Conditional guarantee at the current test point

For p=1/100, a=p²=1/10000 and q=1/10000,

\[
p_{\rm seed}\le\frac7{10000},
\quad e_{\rm final}\le e_0+(1-2e_0)\frac7{10000}
\approx0.009925897279<\frac1{100}.
\]

The final inequality is checked exactly using fractions. Thus pairwise independent receipt errors, together with four bounded decision-event marginals, suffice for the accuracy target. Neither three-way receipt independence nor decision-event independence is needed for this guarantee.

With q fixed at 1/10000, the looser sufficient pair-joint ceiling is

\[
a\le\frac{s_*-4q}{3}
\approx0.000125165914.
\]

If all receipt marginals equal p=1/100, define the average pair correlation coefficient by

\[
\bar\rho=\frac{a-p^2}{p(1-p)}.
\]

The ceiling corresponds to bar rho approximately 0.00254201153. This is an average bound, not an individual bound on every pair. Unequal marginals require their actual pair probabilities rather than this equal-marginal correlation conversion.

The bounds are requirements for a declared source model, not measured or native UD correlation values. A small change in shared error can consume the prior margin, so repeating acquisition without a joint-state source law remains insufficient.

## 5. Entropy/resource correction

The receipt workspace contains the joint error flags after carrier uncopies. Under correlated errors its entropy is H(E1,E2,E3), not automatically 3h(p). The general inequality is

\[
H(E_1,E_2,E_3)\le\sum_i h(p_i).
\]

Equality requires error independence. Similarly the output parity garbage can correlate with the receipt flags, so the previous additive 3h(p)+h(u3) expression remains scoped to its independent fault channels. A correlated source can have smaller garbage entropy while producing larger majority error. Reset cost and source fidelity must therefore be derived from different functionals of the same joint state.

The earlier majority release is preserved as an independent-model result. This report adds the correlated-model scope; it does not overwrite its exact conditional formulas or change any registry status.

## 6. What a native source derivation must supply

A source-complete apparatus model must define the receipt-error flags and their pre-decision joint state. If F_i are commuting error projectors on distinct flag registers with state rho_F, then

\[
p_i=\operatorname{Tr}(\rho_F F_i),\quad
a_{ij}=\operatorname{Tr}(\rho_F F_iF_j),\quad
b=\operatorname{Tr}(\rho_F F_1F_2F_3).
\]

The inequality gate can be tested directly on those source-derived quantities. Declaring product flag states and factorized conditional interactions can establish independence within a candidate apparatus, but it does not derive product preparation from native incidence motion. Shared control, carrier drift, bath reuse and coupling errors must be included in the actual joint-state evolution if present.

The supplied source copies and coefficient ledger do not provide this current apparatus joint-state law. The next source task is therefore precise: derive or bound the pair joint-error sum and the four decision-event probabilities using an energetically specified flag environment. The thermodynamic record-to-horizon bridge remains open even if the accuracy gate passes.

Disposition: exact conditional joint-probability theorem and robust accuracy gate checked. Native moments, clock, fault energy, full reset and apparatus area OPEN. Physical promotion 0; independent review OPEN. Development — no registry entry. No ledger, registry, site or repository changes. Gap2_FINAL_Finite_Genesis.png remained unavailable and unused.

# Reversible receipt majority and its resource gate

2026-10-13. Benjamin Walker Mayes, AI-assisted development. Development — no registry entry. Physical promotion 0; independent review OPEN.

## Result and source scope

A three-receipt majority module is constructed as a reversible gate sequence and integrated with the existing twelve-bit ground encoding. It reduces a declared independent receipt-error rate, but costs additional workspace, carrier hold time, gates and garbage reset. Faults in the majority/copy operation impose a second accuracy requirement. The calculation is conditional on source-receipt independence and specified fault channels; it does not derive their actual probabilities or energy environment from UD.

Native P_f supplies the carrier observable. The four-incidence hold and bath-isolated memory write are the prior candidate controls. Native autonomous timing, coupling switches, G05/G06 normalization and horizon map remain open. G is unused.

## 1. Acquire three receipts of the held observable

Use three distinct, initially blank receipt bits a,b,c and a separate initially blank output o. Hold A=P_f by removing its four cross-incidence couplings, so its binary label R is constant throughout acquisition and cleanup. Acquire A into each receipt by the corresponding controlled bit flip. Declare independent XOR acquisition errors E_i with probability p, giving

\[
(a,b,c)=(R\oplus E_1,R\oplus E_2,R\oplus E_3).
\]

These are independent errors conditional on R, not independent receipts marginally: all receipts share the source label. Their error environments must be independently supplied by a future physical model. Fresh bits and repetition alone do not prove that independence.

The native source is only copied as a binary observable during its hold. This is not a three-copy measurement of an arbitrary unknown quantum state.

## 2. Reversible majority and cleanup

Boolean majority satisfies

\[
\operatorname{maj}(a,b,c)=ab\oplus ac\oplus bc.
\]

Apply three Toffoli gates controlled respectively by (a,b), (a,c), and (b,c), each targeting o. From o=0, this computes the majority. Copy o into boundary-memory seed bit 0. Reverse the three majority gates. Finally apply the carrier-controlled receipt copy again to each receipt, converting its value R XOR E_i into E_i. The truth-table checker verifies all input and fault patterns.

With ideal decision gates the output o returns to zero, the three receipt bits retain their error flags, and the memory seed is

\[
S=R\oplus\operatorname{maj}(E_1,E_2,E_3).
\]

Fan the seed out along the previous eleven neighboring CNOTs, starting from the otherwise blank twelve-bit boundary. This generates the same conditional all-zero/all-one codeword family used in the earlier thermal replay.

Primitive counts are three acquisition gates, three majority Toffolis, one seed copy, three reverse Toffolis, three carrier receipt uncopies, and eleven fanout gates: 24 total. The carrier hold lasts through the first 13 gates; thereafter carrier and memory can decouple. The decision module uses four extra workspace bits. Its Toffolis are three-body gate primitives, not a proven two-local decomposition. Routing among receipt bits and the memory seed is declared local to an added decision module, whose physical geometry is not derived.

## 3. Receipt and decision fault laws

For independent acquisition errors the majority seed error is

\[
p_3=3p^2-2p^3.
\]

Exact enumeration gives p3=1499/500000000 at p=1/1000 and p3=149/500000 at p=1/100. This quadratic reduction is conditional on the independent error source.

Now declare an independent target XOR fault of probability q after each of the three forward majority gates and after the seed-copy gate. The four faults combine as a parity error

\[
u_4=\frac{1-(1-2q)^4}{2}.
\]

The effective seed error is therefore

\[
\boxed{p_{\rm eff}=p_3+u_4-2p_3u_4.}
\]

The receipt gates' p and the decision gates' q are different typed probabilities. Reverse computation, carrier uncopies and downstream fanout are ideal in this release. Adding their faults requires a new channel; it cannot be inferred from the four-event model above.

For storage error e_r conditional on a perfect seed, final error is exactly

\[
e_{\rm final}=p_{\rm eff}+(1-2p_{\rm eff})e_r.
\]

## 4. Retention and latency test

The replay derives the same Gibbs storage kernel on the twelve-face graph at beta J=(ln3)/2. Exact rational propagation gives e20 approximately 0.001912274 and e32 approximately 0.009238832. The gate clock again assigns one complete gate round and one collision/refresh round to one slot; this is a declared ratio.

At a common 44-slot deadline, the majority write takes 24 slots and leaves 20 storage updates. The previous single-seed ground write took 12 slots and left 32. The one-hot write took one slot and left 43. Receipt reset is deferred after readout in this schedule; charging its duration before the deadline requires a new time allocation.

| Acquisition p | Decision q | Error after 32 storage updates | Error at 44-slot deadline, 20 storage updates |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1/1000 | 0 | 0.00924177 | 0.00191526 |
| 1/1000 | 1/10000 | 0.00963426 | 0.00231361 |
| 1/1000 | 1/1000 | 0.01315608 | 0.00588800 |
| 1/100 | 0 | 0.00953133 | 0.00220913 |
| 1/100 | 1/10000 | 0.00992358 | 0.00260725 |
| 1/100 | 1/1000 | 0.01344332 | 0.00617953 |

All criterion comparisons use exact rationals. Decimal errors are displays. For the declared one-percent final-error target after 32 storage updates, acquisition p=1/100 combined with decision q=1/10000 passes; decision q=1/1000 fails. At the common deadline the lower thermal exposure improves the error, but spends more time in bath-isolated writing. It is not an intrinsic lifetime improvement at equal post-write age.

At 32 updates the seed ceiling remains (1/100−e32)/(1−2e32), approximately 0.000775498. Majority helps only if both the acquisition majority error and the added decision parity fit inside this ceiling.

## 5. Workspace, energy and reset

Declare the four workspace bits energetically degenerate during the decision stage. This permits ideal logic with zero workspace endpoint energy change, but requires pure blanks and driven control. It does not assign zero total controller cost.

After noisy forward decision gates and ideal reverse computation, o retains the parity of the three forward majority faults, with probability

\[
u_3=\frac{1-(1-2q)^3}{2}.
\]

The receipt uncopies leave E_1,E_2,E_3. The workspace's marginal entropy is

\[
H_{\rm garbage}=3h(p)+h(u_3).
\]

For a blind isothermal reset of that degenerate workspace to its original pure blanks, the necessary work bound is kBT H_garbage. At p=1/100,q=1/10000 this is approximately 0.170738 kBT; at q=0 it is approximately 0.168005 kBT. These are workspace-reset bounds additional to boundary memory reset, drive and source-hold resources. Exact finite pure reset is not provided; accessible side information can change the reset bound but must be physically specified.

The original carrier hold is used explicitly to uncopy R from the receipts. Error flags remain because their stochastic origins are not reversibly controlled in this model. They may correlate with the memory label. Logical uncomputation cannot silently erase an inaccessible noise environment or those flags.

The noise environments themselves still lack Hamiltonian, preparation and renewal laws. Therefore this calculation is not a complete energetic implementation of faulty majority. The twenty-four gate schedule, four workspace blanks, garbage entropy, hold duration and deferred reset are concrete new resource obligations.

The boundary-memory energy still ends at zero for either ideal ground codeword; the earlier 10J fanout path barrier remains. Those facts do not cancel the added decision-module resource costs. The nominal boundary remains 12a0, but the physical area occupied by added workspace is unknown. Retained information per total apparatus area cannot be computed by ignoring that workspace.

## 6. Independence and common-mode failure

To expose the source assumption, let every receipt error contain a shared XOR component C with probability c, plus independent components with probability p. Then

\[
p_{\rm maj}=c+(1-2c)(3p^2-2p^3).
\]

A perfectly shared error is not reduced by majority. The total single-receipt marginal error is c+(1−2c)p, so c and p cannot be conflated with one quoted receipt-error rate. A future source law must establish independent components or directly bound shared error; repeating the same faulty source mechanism is insufficient.

## Disposition and next gate

CHECKED: reversible majority truth table; independent-error reduction; decision parity penalty; workspace garbage; exact storage and common-deadline errors. CANDIDATE: independent acquisition source, degenerate workspace, primitive Toffoli clock and ideal cleanup. OPEN: physical source/decision fault energy, shared-error bound, native clock and local implementation, workspace geometry, pure preparation/reset, extensive area density and horizon normalization.

The next source task is to derive or bound common-mode receipt error and the decision-module error channel while supplying its resource state. The present construction closes the conditional logic and exposes what its claimed robustness requires. Physical promotion remains 0; independent review OPEN. No ledger, registry, site or repository changes. Gap2_FINAL_Finite_Genesis.png remained unavailable and unused.

The broader sufficient union/moment bound gives c_robust(r)=[s_r-4q-3p^2]/[3(1-2p)]. In this declared Gibbs family, c=(1+exp(beta Delta_c))^-1 is strictly decreasing. # Contribution to Unified Dynamics

Public contribution guide · 13 October 2026

Mathematicians, scientists, independent peer reviewers and research software contributors are invited to volunteer on a bounded task. Contributions may include checking a proof, finding a counterexample, independently reproducing a calculation, reviewing a physical correspondence, improving code or clarifying a manuscript.

## Starter tasks

1. Review a declared A/B/C spectrum or frozen-mask continuity argument in UD_REVIEW_REPLAY_v0.1.zip.
2. Audit the receipt thermal-gap frontier: exact error gates, corrected write/storage timing or the physical-scale non-identifiability proof.
3. Recover an exact paper and source equation for a proposed correspondence, including assumptions and units.
4. Submit a small reproducible correction to code, notation or a source citation.

## Volunteer review

Specify the artifact and version, hypotheses, scope and proposed deliverable. A review should state what was checked, describe discrepancies or missing proof steps, record reproduction commands when applicable, and distinguish established results from candidate interpretations.

Independent reviews and constructor checks retain separate status. Favorable and unfavorable findings are both useful. Reviewer attribution and publication of the review summary are agreed with the reviewer. A review of one artifact does not endorse the whole framework.

## How to start

- Open a contribution offer at https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/issues/new.
- Include relevant background, task or artifact of interest, proposed scope, availability and preferred acknowledgment.
- Agree a bounded review or coordinated task before beginning it.
- Return proof notes, code, a result receipt or a review report with assumptions and limitations.
- Use issues and focused pull requests for corrections; preserve original evidence and record the change.

Attribution, acknowledgments and any coauthorship are agreed according to the contribution. Referrals to suitable researchers and reviewers are welcome.

## Practical support

Suitable computing equipment, compute access, research hosting and support for a separately agreed independent review are additional contribution options. The historical 3 October 2026 planning brief estimated $6,500 for a laptop package and $4,000 for a paid mathematical review. These are preliminary USD estimates, subject to quotations and agreed terms; in-kind resources reduce the corresponding cash need.

No payments are collected on the site. Financial and paid-review arrangements require agreed terms; no charitable status or tax-deductibility is represented. Reviewer payment is for careful work regardless of conclusion.

# Governance Amendment — CRL-2 Subdivision and Anti-Erosion Rules

**Status:** governance proposal. Amends the confidence-rating ladder and the
promotion/demotion procedure. **Physical promotion: 0.**

Derived from a measured error distribution over this development session:
zero errors in the exact-substrate layer, seven in the bridge layer, four
material — every material error found only on adversarial review, never during
construction. The amendment concentrates protection where the errors are.

---

## 1. CRL-2 subdivision

The current CRL-2 ("operational / measurement-facing") spans everything from a
written proposal to a replicated result. That range is too wide for one label.
Replace with:

```
CRL-2a  PROPOSED       bridge construction written down; author-checked only
CRL-2b  PRE-REGISTERED frozen before data AND passed >=1 adversarial review
                       by a party who did not construct it
CRL-2c  EXECUTED       survived one blinded run against its frozen rule
CRL-2d  REPLICATED     survived >=1 independent replication
```

**Eligibility gates:**
- 2a → 2b requires a *non-constructor* adversarial review on record.
- Only 2d is eligible for CRL-3 (physical-identification) consideration.
- No claim skips a rung.

**Current status of this session's output:** the pre-registration packet is
**CRL-2a**. It has been adversarially reviewed only by its own author (two
passes), which this session demonstrates is insufficient — two material and
four minor errors survived construction and were caught only on hostile
re-read. It is **not** CRL-2b until a non-constructor reviews it.

---

## 2. Anti-erosion rule (support depth)

Define, for any claim X:

```
depth(X) = 0                              if X is exact-substrate or empirical
depth(X) = 1 + max over dependencies D of depth(D)   otherwise
```

**Rule E1 — status is capped by depth.**
A claim cited only by other conditional claims gets *deeper*, never firmer.
Citation is not evidence. Status improves only by re-derivation against a
lower-depth anchor, never by accumulating dependents.

**Rule E2 — dependency expiry.**
If X depends on assumption A and A is revised or demoted, X auto-demotes to
"pending re-derivation" with no ruling required. Append-only.

**Rationale.** This is the specific mechanism that prevents the failure seen in
the abandoned exploratory thread, where a "structural choice" became
"canonicalized" across a chain in which no single step was individually wrong.
Each step raised apparent firmness by citation. E1 makes that impossible; E2
makes revision propagate.

---

## 3. Asymmetric promotion / demotion

```
PROMOTION (any rung):  requires non-constructor adversarial review,
                       then custodian ruling. Slow by design.
DEMOTION on falsify:   automatic, immediate, no ruling. Append-only.
```

The custodian is removed from the demotion path entirely. This is what makes a
faster promotion path safe to offer: safety never waits on custodian
availability.

---

## 4. Development lane vs registry lane

Separate *may not claim* from *may not work on*.

```
REGISTRY LANE   entries carrying a CRL status. Frozen frontiers apply.
DEVELOPMENT LANE analysis reaching no registry conclusion. Requires only
                 a label: "development — no registry entry." Frozen
                 frontiers do NOT apply.
```

Analysis that promotes nothing (e.g. showing a frozen family fails to
discriminate) belongs in the development lane and does not require frontier
re-entry. Promotion from development to registry requires the §3 procedure.

---

## 5. Retractions and provenance as first-class objects

**Retraction registry.** Every correction is a registry object with the same
standing as a claim: what was wrong, what replaced it, found-by (construction /
self-review / external). The session-level retraction ratio is published as a
diagnostic. A framework with zero recorded retractions after substantial
development is unaudited, not clean.

**Provenance field** on every claim: origin, constructor, reviewer(s),
dependency list, lane. This is the field that catches contamination — content
entering the lineage from outside the substrate — at entry rather than
downstream.

---

## 6. The limit this does not fix

Governance catches *category* errors: claiming CRL-2c when you hold CRL-2a.
It does **not** catch a wrong rule inside a correctly-labeled CRL-2a document.
This session is the evidence: every material error was correctly *inside* a
"proposed" document and still wrong. Only non-constructor adversarial review
catches that class.

Therefore the binding recommendation is procedural, not structural:
**no bridge claim advances past CRL-2a without review by someone who did not
build it.** Everything above raises the floor. It does not substitute for that
review.

**Physical promotion remains 0.**

---

## 7. 2026-09-14 topology/source governance extension

**Status:** active governance amendment.  
**Physical promotion remains 0.**

This section governs the current \(C_4/C_5\), Pachner, open-source,
archive/dissolution, and topology-scheduler branch.

### 7.1 Typed carrier identity is mandatory

Equal matrices, vectors, dimensions, or numerical values do **not** identify
objects with different carrier types or provenance.

The following are permanently distinct unless an explicit typed intertwiner is
proved:

```
C4_cell   admitted boundary-complete 4-simplex carrier used in active homology
C4_evt    transient five-seat Pachner event-mediator carrier
C5_ctx    higher context/source carrier feeding C4_evt
```

Required fields:

```
carrier_type
domain
codomain
admission_condition
source_provenance
dependency_ids
internal_claim_bin
correspondence_status
physical_promotion
```

**Rule T1 — no numerical aliasing.**
Identical local incidence columns do not permit carrier identification.

**Rule T2 — homology firewall.**
Only admitted topological cell carriers enter active simplicial homology.

**Rule T3 — source firewall.**
Open sources are carrier-typed and are not interchangeable.

### 7.2 Exact-launch / no-tolerance rule

**Rule L1.**
Numerical closeness to a launch amplitude, phase, score, or endpoint is not a
theory tolerance and may not authorize topology commit.

**Rule L2.**
Numerical root finding may locate a candidate event, but registry execution
requires either an exact analytic identity or a certified root proof of the
full frozen launch predicate.

**Rule L3.**
No post-exposure epsilon may convert `HOLD` into `PASS`.

### 7.3 Scalar-source nonidentifiability and vector-source provenance

**Rule S1.**
A scalar support source, source power, total budget, or norm cannot substitute
for a signed address-resolved source vector.

Minimum predictive source packet:

```
(source_vector,
 address_basis,
 orientation,
 provenance,
 validity_interval,
 support_power_receipt)
```

**Rule S2.**
If local source derives from a larger closed carrier, preserve both the local
receipt and global exchange parent.

**Rule S3.**
Residual extraction is not a constitutive derivation.

### 7.4 Causal batch custody and no-double-spend

**Rule C1.**
Every topology batch uses one frozen pre-batch state.

**Rule C2.**
Credits produced by a batch enter only the next frozen scheduler snapshot.

**Rule C3.**
Signed address amplitude, not pooled \(q^2\), is the routing object.

**Rule C4.**
Concurrent packets require an exact commuting/reducing-block receipt;
otherwise serialize by independently frozen precedence or HOLD.

### 7.5 Symmetry and precedence

**Rule Y1.**
Exact candidate-exchange symmetry preserving the full pre-event state and law
forces HOLD; deterministic covariant selection is forbidden.

**Rule Y2.**
A strict unique first-hit time of the complete frozen launch predicate is a
lawful parameter-free precedence receipt.

**Rule Y3.**
Address order, array order, lexical order, random numerical noise, and
post-exposure convenience are invalid precedence sources.

### 7.6 CRL firewall for internal topology mathematics

Exact combinatorics, homology, incidence identities, internal Hodge dynamics,
source-interface theorems, and synthetic simulations do not become CRL-2 merely
because they are exact or executed computationally.

```
CRL-1 / INTERNAL
    exact or derived substrate/internal mathematics, algorithms, simulations,
    governance receipts, and source-interface theorems with no frozen
    measurement-facing identification.

CRL-2a..2d
    operational / measurement-facing bridge objects under §1.
```

**Rule R1.**
Internal computational execution is not CRL-2c execution.

**Rule R2.**
A source-addendum may be exact conditional mathematics while remaining below
CRL-2.

**Rule R3.**
Only claims with an explicit frozen external/measurement mapping enter CRL-2.

### 7.7 Correspondence tuple remains mandatory

Every external-facing topology statement carries:

```
(internal_claim_bin, correspondence_status, physical_promotion)
```

Allowed tags remain:

```
FORMAL_CORRESPONDENCE
OPERATIONAL_CORRESPONDENCE
OBSERVABLE_SIGNATURE_CANDIDATE
QUANTITATIVE_CORRESPONDENCE_TEST
EXPERIMENTALLY_REALIZED_ANALOGUE
```

Correspondence never implies physical identity, causation, derivation, or
promotion.

### 7.8 AUTO_LOCK / AUTO_FREEZE interaction

AUTO_LOCK only after carrier type, assumptions, and dependencies are explicit.

AUTO_FREEZE immediately on:

- unproved carrier crossing;
- post-hoc numerical tolerance;
- scalar-to-vector source substitution;
- same-batch credit double-spend;
- unreceipted symmetry breaking;
- internal-to-CRL-2 category promotion without bridge/review gates.

Repairs remain append-only and versioned.

### 7.9 Current topology branch ruling

The following are internal registry objects, not CRL-2 evidence:

- \(C_4^{cell}\) mathematics;
- \(C_4^{evt}\) Pachner/event mathematics;
- \(C_5^{ctx}\) source-extension mathematics;
- exact topology schedulers/selectors;
- synthetic/geometric Pachner simulations;
- archive/dissolution history theorems.

Any later measurement-facing use enters CRL-2a independently.

**Physical promotion remains 0.**
