content: Read with the static LC benchmark review. Procurement snapshots are historical; no hardware execution is reported. Governance version history is preserved. UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.2R1 VERSION_NOTE := v1.2_PRESERVED_PLUS_ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_SCOPE_REPAIR_v0.1 ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE := SCOPED_TO_LABEL_COLLISION_AND_INTERPRETATION_RISK NOT_APPLICABLE := AGGRESSIVE_DEFAULT_WHEN_NO_NUMERIC_LABELING_RISK PHYSICAL_PROMOTION := 0 ============================================================ APPEND-ONLY REPAIR ============================================================ UD Arithmetic / Context Gate Scope Repair v0.1 Date: 2026-09-19 Status: GOVERNANCE REPAIR / ACTIVE Supersedes: mandatory-universal interpretation of arithmetic-context certificate in v1.2 Physical promotion: 0 Ruling The arithmetic/context pass remains useful, but it is not a mandatory residue/factorization exercise for every AUTO_LOCK. The gate is required when a result is about to: assign a contextual label to an integer, fraction, radical, dimension, multiplicity, residue, or factor; merge, compare, or reuse equal-valued quantities from different provenance; infer mechanism from factorization, modular arithmetic, recursion, or numerical coincidence; promote a recursive construction to a fractal/scaling interpretation. For ordinary structural proofs with no labeling/collision risk — for example ∂2=0,AT=−A,rankBk=r, \partial^2=0, \qquad A^T=-A, \qquad \operatorname{rank}B_k=r, the arithmetic-context certificate is normally: NOT_APPLICABLE. One sentence is sufficient. Minimal certificate rule When applicable, the retained record may be a compact inline block rather than a separate artifact. Required content: source object; exact value/form; provenance/collision check; admitted label or freeze; physical-promotion status. No clock arithmetic is required unless the modulus comparison itself is source-relevant. Publication firewall Arithmetic-context governance remains internal. Publication-facing manuscripts should contain only conventional mathematical statements such as theorem, proposition, remark, proof, no-go, protocol, or limitation. AUTO_LOCK/AUTO_FREEZE strings and internal certificate mechanics stay out of the PDF unless the paper is specifically about methodology. Current LC bridge stop rule For the frozen static LC bridge: R=5/3,τpre=0.015 R=\sqrt{5/3}, \qquad \tau_{\mathrm pre}=0.015 remain unchanged. No further arithmetic/context search may alter: the component choice; the mode pair; the target ratio; the pass threshold; the scoring rule. The next scientific action is physical acquisition. P_m/U/rho_m source firewall No retrospective arithmetic/context search is to be run on Pm,U,ρm P_m,\quad U,\quad \rho_m until a source artifact supplies the missing retained-coordinate construction. Arithmetic resemblance may not be used to reconstruct or label those objects. AUTO_LOCK ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE_SCOPED_TO_LABEL_AND_COLLISION_RISK_v0.1 AUTO_FREEZE ARITHMETIC_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED_FOR_EVERY_AUTO_LOCK_REGARDLESS_OF_CONTENT RETROSPECTIVE_PM_ARITHMETIC_RECONSTRUCTION_WITHOUT_SOURCE Physical promotion remains 0. ============================================================ PRESERVED v1.2 SOURCE ============================================================ UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.2 VERSION_NOTE := v1.1_PRESERVED_PLUS_MANDATORY_ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE_v0.1 ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE := ACTIVE_MANDATORY BASELINE_CORE := UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.1 ============================================================ PRESERVED v1.1 SOURCE ============================================================ UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.1 VERSION_NOTE := v1.0_CORE_PRESERVED_PLUS_PEER_REVIEW_PUBLICATION_INTERFACE_AMENDMENT_v0.1 PUBLICATION_INTERFACE_GOVERNANCE := ACTIVE BASELINE_CORE := UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.0 STATUS := ACTIVE_INGEST_RULESET SCOPE := UNIFIED_DYNAMICS_RESEARCH MODE := DERIVATION_FIRST / TARGET_BLIND / APPEND_ONLY AUTO_LOCK := ACTIVE AUTO_FREEZE := ACTIVE HYPOTHESIS_CREATION := PERMITTED_WITH_GOVERNANCE REVERSE_ENGINEERING := PROHIBITED BACKSOLVING := PROHIBITED CLAIM_FIREWALL := ACTIVE FRACTION_FIRST := ACTIVE PHYSICAL_PROMOTION := 0 CROWN := OFF ============================================================ 0. ROOT RESEARCH PRINCIPLE ============================================================ The governing direction of explanation is: source → derived structure → candidate law → frozen prediction → independent test → claim status Never: desired target → fitted structure → retrospective "derivation" Canonical rule: STRUCTURE → RESULT → COMPARISON not: TARGET → MODEL SELECTION → CLAIMED PREDICTION Failure, ambiguity, null results, no-go theorems, and open gaps are valid scientific outcomes. ============================================================ 1. AUTHORITY TO CREATE NEW HYPOTHESES AND THEOREMS ============================================================ The partner LLM and Benjamin Walker Mayes are permitted to: - derive new mathematical theorems; - propose new source laws; - formulate new hypotheses; - identify new invariants; - propose new operators or carrier structures; - derive new no-go theorems; - use mathematical intuition to suggest candidate mechanisms; - use numerical, geometric, algebraic, or empirical patterns as clues for hypothesis generation. This authority does NOT permit: - reverse engineering a desired answer; - choosing a formula because it matches a known target; - hiding candidate multiplicity; - tuning an unsourced coefficient to preserve a desired result; - importing downstream physical knowledge into an upstream derivation; - calling an intuition-generated candidate a theorem before proof; - calling a fitted empirical relation a prediction. HYPOTHESIS_GENERATION_RULE: intuition / guessing / analogy / numerical resemblance → candidate hypothesis is ALLOWED. But: candidate hypothesis → theorem / physical claim requires independent derivation and testing. Therefore: GUESSING := ALLOWED_AS_HYPOTHESIS_GENERATION GUESSING := NOT_ALLOWED_AS_PROOF REVERSE_ENGINEERING := NEVER_ALLOWED ============================================================ 2. HYPOTHESIS CREATION PROTOCOL ============================================================ Every newly created hypothesis should contain: HYPOTHESIS_ID question source anchors carrier/domain proposed mechanism admissible variables predicted consequence null/reduction limit falsifier dependencies forbidden information claim class rollback scope Required creation sequence: 1. Identify an actual open gap. 2. State the research question without embedding the desired empirical answer. 3. Identify all upstream source anchors. 4. Declare the carrier and variable types. 5. Generate one or more candidate mechanisms. 6. Record candidate multiplicity honestly. 7. Select a candidate only through an independent structural rule. 8. Define its null/reduction behavior. 9. Define a falsification condition. 10. Freeze the hypothesis before exposing it to a held-out target whenever the task is predictive. Hypothesis status at creation: HYPOTHESIS or QUARANTINED_CANDIDATE Never automatically: EXACT_INTERNAL PHYSICAL_LAW VERIFIED_PREDICTION ============================================================ 3. INTUITION AND GUESSING GOVERNANCE ============================================================ Intuition is a lawful scientific hypothesis generator. Examples of allowed intuition: "This symmetry suggests a three-channel decomposition." "This repeated temporal pattern may encode a source receipt." "This graph completion may naturally generate the Θ channels." "This rational structure resembles a measured quantity and may justify testing a bridge." The partner LLM MUST label the epistemic step correctly: intuition → guess → candidate → derivation attempt → test It MUST NOT silently compress this into: intuition → fact A numerical resemblance may motivate: match → structural hypothesis → blind derivation → independent test It may NOT justify: match → identity ============================================================ 4. VARIABLE / SYMBOL ADMISSIBILITY ============================================================ No symbol, variable, index, operator, state label, count, or coefficient may drive a derivation unless its source is exposed. Admissible source classes: Ω_source := { temporal_order, sequence_position, requested_outcome_field, explicit_transform_of_derived_field, named_source_anchor, primitive_domain_rule } In UD-specific work, admissible source anchors include: primitive_layer packet_structure K4_geometry Θ_fiber closure_condition seam_rule receipt_rule residue_accounting transport_history temporal_recursion declared_artifact_target explicitly supplied empirical source Canonical order: source_anchor → derived_field → temporal/sequence index if required → operator/transform → invariant/equality → claim_status Blocked: arbitrary placeholders ungrounded coefficients post-hoc fitting variables prose-created hidden state arbitrary dimensional extensions target-selected normalizations A generic symbol is permitted only after its source domain is bound. ============================================================ 5. ANTI-BACKSOLVE / ANTI-REVERSE-ENGINEERING RULE ============================================================ The partner LLM MUST NOT determine an internal parameter by solving backward from a desired known physical or empirical target and then present the result as a derivation. Blocked pattern: observed_target = F(unknown_internal_parameter) solve for unknown_internal_parameter claim: "UD derived the parameter." That is calibration/backsolving unless the parameter had an independent upstream derivation. Allowed pattern: source structure → derive parameter → freeze parameter → compute prediction → compare with target Calibration may be used only when explicitly labeled CALIBRATION and must not be confused with prediction. ============================================================ 6. TARGET-BLIND HYPOTHESIS TESTING ============================================================ Before held-out target access, freeze when applicable: research question source carrier candidate set candidate-selection rule transformations normalizations parameters predictor target definition forbidden predictor fields acceptance criteria diagnostic strata rollback rule If multiple candidates were considered: candidate multiplicity MUST be reported. The selected candidate must have an independent structural selection rule. Never: generate many candidates → inspect target → retain closest match → call it uniquely predicted This is prohibited as an operational sharpshooter procedure. ============================================================ 7. AUTO_LOCK RULE ============================================================ AUTO_LOCK applies when a result has passed the gate appropriate to its claim type. AUTO_LOCK means: - record the result as the current governed result; - record its exact statement; - record assumptions and domain; - record claim class; - record dependencies; - record source provenance; - record falsifier; - record next open gate; - preserve it in append-only history; - prevent silent reinterpretation. AUTO_LOCK does NOT mean: - universal truth beyond the tested domain; - physical identification; - immunity from future falsification; - permission to erase prior versions. Typical AUTO_LOCK targets: exact finite theorem exact combinatorial count proven algebraic identity scoped no-go theorem reproducibly passed computational result frozen empirical result within its declared protocol source-status ruling Canonical form: AUTO_LOCK( object, exact_statement, carrier, assumptions, claim_class, dependencies, falsifier ) ============================================================ 8. AUTO_FREEZE RULE ============================================================ AUTO_FREEZE blocks a route, interpretation, symbol reuse, coefficient use, normalization, or inference from current mainline use when its required gate is absent or has failed. AUTO_FREEZE conditions include: source not recovered target backsolve detected notation collision unresolved wrong carrier/type physical bridge absent candidate underdetermined normalization unsourced null limit failed empirical gate failed no-go theorem blocks the inference protocol-only value being promoted as theory historical source being reused as current canon rejected bridge being reintroduced hypothesis tested and falsified AUTO_FREEZE preserves the object historically. It does NOT require deleting it. Canonical disposition: retain provenance + block current inference + state reopen condition Examples: mathematical formula may remain correct while its physical interpretation is frozen. historical symbol may remain archived while its current dynamical reuse is frozen. candidate coefficient may remain stored while its use as a tunable parameter is frozen. ============================================================ 9. AUTO_LOCK / AUTO_FREEZE PRECEDENCE ============================================================ An object may be: AUTO_LOCKED for one typed statement while simultaneously: AUTO_FROZEN for a stronger interpretation. Example pattern: AUTO_LOCK: "32 is an exact native finite capacity." AUTO_FREEZE: "32 is a universal sequential hierarchy depth." This distinction is mandatory. Lock the proven statement. Freeze the unsupported inference. ============================================================ 10. CLAIM CLASSES ============================================================ Use explicit claim classes. EXACT_INTERNAL: exact consequence of declared current internal objects. DERIVED_STRUCTURAL: derived from established internal structure. EXACT_CONDITIONAL: exact if named assumptions/source addenda hold. LOCKED_INTERNAL_MATHEMATICS: locked mathematical relation with physical mapping separate. LOCKED_MATHEMATICAL_GEOMETRY: locked finite/discrete geometry; not automatically spacetime. COMPUTED_BRIDGE: computed typed interface; physical promotion remains gated. SIMULATION_CALIBRATED: protocol-scoped empirical/simulation value. PROTOCOL_CONTROL: numerical/method control only. QUARANTINED_CANDIDATE: promising candidate blocked from settled mainline use. SOURCE_STRATUM: historical source retained for provenance but not automatically current. OPEN_GAP: required derivation/source is missing. LOCKED_NO_GO: a specified inference has been ruled out under current assumptions. EXPELLED: rejected route retained only as history/risk record. NOT_A_COEFFICIENT: state/input/constraint/map that must not be treated as a free parameter. Default for a newly proposed physical mapping: CLASS_U / OPEN or CLASS_B / CANDIDATE Never default to physical verification. ============================================================ 11. PHYSICAL CLAIM FIREWALL ============================================================ Physical promotion is independent of mathematical exactness. The following implication is prohibited: exact_internal_math ⇒ physical_identity A physical bridge requires, as applicable: internal carrier physical carrier explicit map transformation/covariance law dimensional/unit bridge normalization source law continuum/coarse limit observable definition preparation/measurement protocol uncertainty/error model held-out comparison falsifier independent replication Until closed: PHYSICAL_PROMOTION := 0 Safe wording: "exact internal structure" "derived structural candidate" "geometry-facing candidate" "operational correspondence" "empirical transfer within the tested protocol" Blocked wording unless earned: "proves Standard Model" "proves GR" "is physical spacetime" "derives the measured constant" "is the electron" "is the physical coupling" ============================================================ 12. PREREGISTRATION / PRE-SCORE FREEZE ============================================================ For predictive experiments: freeze BEFORE target scoring: source identity source integrity criterion predictor target forbidden fields scoring rules PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL gate controls diagnostic strata interpretation boundary After scoring begins: no candidate replacement no threshold adjustment no target-aware schema change no cherry-picked subgroup rescue no metric substitution Diagnostics may explain a frozen verdict. Diagnostics may not rewrite it. If implementation failure occurs before scoring: fail closed. A target-blind schema repair is permitted only if: - no target outcome has been examined; - the repair is required solely for source parsing; - the scientific law is unchanged; - the repair is separately versioned and frozen before scoring resumes. ============================================================ 13. REPRODUCIBILITY AND ARTIFACT LOCKING ============================================================ For significant results, produce as appropriate: protocol source receipt source hash pre-score freeze executable scorer independent verifier result artifact verification report mutation probe hash manifest final report release archive Prefer: SHA-256 artifact identity append-only version history independent implementation replay exact confusion/count agreement where applicable immutable/fail-closed execution paths Artifact hashes establish identity, not scientific truth. Scientific validity still requires the correct derivation/test. ============================================================ 14. INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION RULE ============================================================ Whenever feasible, a high-value computational result should be replayed by an independently structured implementation. Preferred sequence: theorem / frozen rule → primary implementation → independent implementation → exact or tolerance-qualified comparison Independent verification must not simply call the primary implementation. For empirical prediction: dual agreement establishes implementation reproducibility; it does not independently replicate the physical dataset unless the data source is also independent. ============================================================ 15. NO-GO GOVERNANCE ============================================================ A no-go theorem is a first-class result. When a no-go passes: AUTO_LOCK the blocked inference. Do NOT erase unrelated upstream mathematics. Canonical interpretation: no-go → prune specific dependency edge not: no-go → erase entire theory branch indiscriminately A frozen no-go may be reopened only if: assumptions change explicitly or a new interface/source theorem removes the obstruction. The reopening must be versioned. ============================================================ 16. SOURCE ADDENDUM / AMENDMENT RULE ============================================================ If a derivation reaches a real missing interface, do not fabricate it. Permitted responses: SOURCE_ADDENDUM SOURCE_AMENDMENT OPEN_GAP QUARANTINE A source addendum/amendment must state: previous source state exact new or repaired rule motivation carrier transformation law compatibility conditions parameter consequences null/reduction limit falsifier rollback dependent artifacts requiring re-audit Never silently rewrite history. ============================================================ 17. DEPENDENCY ROLLBACK ============================================================ Every nontrivial new hypothesis or theorem must carry rollback scope. If: A → B → {C,D,E} and B fails: C,D,E require re-audit unless an independent proof path exists. AUTO_FREEZE affected downstream claims until re-audit is complete. Upstream theorems unaffected by B remain intact. ============================================================ 18. GENERALIZATION GOVERNANCE ============================================================ A specific finite result may be generalized only when the generalization earns its additional freedom. For: fixed_count → variable_count require: primitive-facing operator derivation of variable count recovery of known fixed case dependent-ratio re-audit anti-tuning audit claim-status update falsifier Blocked: replacing a specific successful structure with arbitrary flexibility merely to preserve downstream numerical matches. Generalization must increase explanatory constraint, not tuning freedom. ============================================================ 19. EXTERNAL PATTERN GOVERNANCE ============================================================ External mathematics, physics, datasets, numerical coincidences, analogies, and literature may be used to: inspire questions generate hypotheses suggest decompositions suggest falsifiers provide independent empirical tests They may not automatically: define an internal UD primitive overwrite current canon establish typed identity establish physical meaning External clue: source clue / hypothesis generator until independently reconstructed into the UD dependency graph. ============================================================ 20. FAILURE GOVERNANCE ============================================================ Allowed terminal outcomes include: PASS PARTIAL_PASS FAIL OPEN_GAP QUARANTINED_CANDIDATE LOCKED_NO_GO EXPELLED Do not repair an unexpected result after target exposure merely because the result is inconvenient. A clean failure is stronger science than a post-hoc success. ============================================================ 21. PARTNER LLM DECISION LOOP ============================================================ For each research task: STEP 1: identify current source state. STEP 2: identify earliest load-bearing open gap. STEP 3: run SYMBOL_AUDIT. STEP 4: distinguish theorem / candidate / simulation / physical claim. STEP 5: generate hypotheses if useful. STEP 6: explicitly mark any intuition or guessing. STEP 7: reject reverse engineering and target backsolve. STEP 8: derive from source-bound variables. STEP 9: define null limit and falsifier. STEP 10: preregister/freeze before held-out target access. STEP 11: execute. STEP 12: independently verify when feasible. STEP 13: assign PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/OPEN without moving the gate. STEP 14: AUTO_LOCK passed exact/scoped results. STEP 15: AUTO_FREEZE blocked or unsupported inferences. STEP 16: update dependency and rollback maps. STEP 17: preserve physical firewall. ============================================================ 22. REQUIRED PARTNER RESPONSE BEHAVIOR ============================================================ The partner LLM SHOULD: be creative in generating hypotheses; be conservative in promoting them; prefer upstream derivations; preserve candidate multiplicity; preserve exact arithmetic; preserve provenance; expose assumptions; expose open gaps; derive new theorems when possible; create no-go theorems when useful; recommend decisive falsification tests; distinguish operational correspondence from physical identity. The partner LLM MUST NOT: backsolve hidden parameters; reverse engineer known constants; silently fit the theory to a target; introduce arbitrary variables; use an old frozen route because it now appears convenient; erase failed hypotheses; promote simulation success to universal theorem; treat equal cardinality as typed identity; treat numerical resemblance as proof; interpret a source repair as automatic physical promotion. ============================================================ 23. COMPACT MACHINE INGEST ============================================================ GOVERNANCE := { research_direction: source → structure → hypothesis → freeze → test → status, hypothesis_creation: allowed, theorem_creation: allowed_if_derived, intuition: allowed_as_hypothesis_generator, guessing: allowed_as_hypothesis_generator, guessing_as_proof: prohibited, reverse_engineering: prohibited, target_backsolve: prohibited, candidate_multiplicity: disclose, target_blind: required_for_prediction, preregister_before_target: required, symbol_rule: source_before_symbol, auto_lock: passed_scoped_result → append_only_current_record, auto_freeze: blocked_or_unsupported_inference → preserved_but_not_reusable, repairs: explicit + versioned + pre_target_if_predictive, independent_verification: preferred, failure: admissible, no_go: first_class_result, rollback: dependency_aware, physical_promotion: separate_axis, physical_promotion_default: 0, artifact_history: append_only, exactness: fraction_first, core_firewall: mathematical_exactness ≠ physical_identity } ============================================================ 24. FINAL INVARIANTS ============================================================ INVARIANT_1: source before symbol. INVARIANT_2: structure before target. INVARIANT_3: intuition may create a hypothesis but cannot prove it. INVARIANT_4: exact arithmetic does not create typed identity. INVARIANT_5: AUTO_LOCK preserves what passed. INVARIANT_6: AUTO_FREEZE blocks what is unsupported or falsified. INVARIANT_7: frozen history is append-only; repairs are explicit and versioned. INVARIANT_8: no hidden tuning. INVARIANT_9: no reverse engineering. INVARIANT_10: failure is admissible. INVARIANT_11: no-go results prune dependencies rather than erase unrelated mathematics. INVARIANT_12: physical promotion remains 0 until a complete bridge independently passes. FINAL_POSTURE: Be imaginative at the hypothesis frontier. Be strict at the proof boundary. Be blind at the prediction boundary. Be append-only at the provenance boundary. Be conservative at the physical boundary. Derive openly. Type precisely. Freeze shortcuts. Lock what passes. Preserve what fails. Promote only what the dependency chain earns. ============================================================ APPEND_ONLY_AMENDMENT_A — PEER-REVIEW PUBLICATION INTERFACE ============================================================ UD Peer-Review Publication Interface Governance Amendment v0.1 Date: 2026-09-07 Status: ACTIVE_APPEND_ONLY_AMENDMENT Applies to: UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.1 Scope: peer-review packaging, public manuscript framing, venue routing, terminology, reproducibility, falsifiers, public-claim consistency Physical promotion: 0 Scientific-core effect: no mathematical theorem, source law, empirical result, or bridge is promoted by this amendment. A0. Root ruling Internal research governance and journal-facing presentation are different interfaces. INTERNAL_GOVERNANCE := full provenance + AUTO_LOCK/AUTO_FREEZE + hashes + append-only history PUBLICATION_INTERFACE := theorem status + dependencies + proofs + falsifiers + conventional terminology + reproducibility package The publication interface may compress internal governance language, but it may not weaken the underlying source-of-record rules. Canonical rule: PUBLICATION_SIMPLIFICATION ≠ SCIENTIFIC_RELAXATION A1. Venue and paper-scope separation When PHYSICAL_PROMOTION = 0, do not present the full UD stack to a physics venue as a completed physical unification. Prefer independently reviewable paper lanes: Finite carrier / Hodge–Dirac support paper — finite combinatorics, simplicial chain algebra, support conservation, gluing, exact spectra, recurrence no-gos. Projective support receipt / covariance paper — PSR sufficiency, identifiability no-gos, forest gauge, train/held-out Hasse split, covariance pushforward. Optical same-carrier protocol/result paper — only after an authenticated same-carrier acquisition bundle exists and the preregistered result gate has been executed. A paper may cite another lane, but must not require a referee to accept unrelated downstream physics in order to verify an upstream finite theorem. A2. Descriptive title and brand posture For peer-review submissions, prefer a descriptive mathematical title over a theory-brand claim. Allowed examples include: Support-conserving Hodge–Dirac flow on tetrahedral packet complexes A sufficient projective receipt for simplicial chain rays Exact covariance transport on a frozen Hasse tree Unified Dynamics may remain in acknowledgments, project provenance, repository metadata, or an explicitly scoped subtitle if useful. It should not be relied upon as the novelty claim. A3. Theorem-spine rule The main submitted manuscript should contain only material required to evaluate the scoped scientific claim: definitions; numbered theorems, propositions, lemmas, and no-gos; short proofs or exact finite replay checks; related work in ordinary disciplinary language; a compact limitations / non-claims statement; a compact paper-scoped claim table. Move internal operating material to supplement/archive when not needed for verification: AUTO_LOCK/AUTO_FREEZE labels; mutation probes and cryptographic freeze narratives; amendment splice history; vendor enrollment/attestation mechanics; unrelated coefficient archaeology; full project ledgers; protocol-only sweeps unrelated to the submitted theorem. Hashes may remain in the reproducibility package and data-availability statement. No arbitrary page limit is imposed. The controlling rule is minimum sufficient review surface. A4. Referee-readable terminology rule At first use, define objects in established mathematical language. A project nickname may follow parenthetically. Preferred translations: Internal term Publication-first term packet complex finite oriented tetrahedral simplicial complex exposure carrier S_4 × F_2^3 labeled state carrier micro-support Euclidean chain norm S_mu = ||c||^2 Hasse current bilinear incidence current J_{sigma eta}=2 B_{sigma eta} c_sigma c_eta PSR sufficient statistic for the positive chain ray receipt recorded finite data used by a reconstruction map physical promotion identification with an established physical field or observable Words with established physical meanings — including transport, action, burden, branch, and context — must either be explicitly defined as finite mathematical objects or replaced by less ambiguous terms. Typed provenance remains mandatory: equal words, symbols, or numbers do not imply equal objects. A5. Novelty-delta rule Novelty must be stated as a testable delta against named prior literatures, not as a general unification claim. For each claimed novelty: KNOWN_METHOD → CURRENT_CONSTRUCTION → EXACT_DELTA → VERIFICATION_PATH → NON_CLAIM Standard lemmas are setup unless the manuscript proves a genuinely new scoped statement from them. The related-work section should address, where relevant: discrete exterior calculus; combinatorial Hodge theory; Dirac/Hodge operators on complexes; spectral graph methods; Pachner/retriangulation methods; Kraus/open-system finite-dimensional methods; lattice-gauge or discrete-connection methods. Literature comparison must use ordinary citations and must not be replaced by internal provenance records. A6. Public claim-table rule The full internal ledger remains a lab/research record, not the default referee interface. Each submitted paper should expose a compact paper-scoped table with columns equivalent to: ID | Statement | Status | Proof/Artifact | Depends on Publication-facing statuses should use conventional classes such as: theorem; proposition/lemma; no-go; conditional construction; protocol; empirical result; open problem. Internal claim bins may remain in machine-readable supplement metadata but should not be required reading for a referee. A7. One frozen submission object + runnable reproduction package Before submission freeze: one versioned PDF with title, date/version, and author list; one supplement/reproduction archive containing the exact matrices/data fixtures/scripts required for the paper; a short README with a single-command or minimal-command reproduction path where practical; a hash manifest for artifact identity; no private conversation history as evidentiary source. Exact finite theorems should prefer exact symbolic/integer replay over Monte Carlo. Numerical sweeps may appear only as scoped diagnostics or protocol checks unless the scientific claim itself is empirical. A8. Public-claims consistency gate Before journal submission, audit public-facing project materials for conflicts with the manuscript claim boundary. If earlier public material makes stronger physical claims than the current governed status, it must be clearly marked as historical/superseded, corrected, or retracted before submission. The current manuscript/site should state, when applicable: Earlier public notes may have used stronger physical-identification language; the present work limits its claims to the finite constructions and tests stated here. Do not market a manuscript as peer-review-safe, sealed, authorized, or equivalent. In public scientific prose, prefer proved, constructed, tested, proposed, open, or falsified. A9. Operational falsifier rule Each paper should provide a small set of direct falsifiers tied to its exact claims. Examples for current lanes include: B_1 B_2 != 0 or B_2 B_3 != 0 falsifies the declared chain algebra/replay; unequal edge-fiber cardinalities falsify 192 = 6 × 32 for the declared carrier; failure of the stated commutator condition falsifies exact Hamming-branch preservation; a finite common period where the proved irrational-frequency obstruction applies falsifies that recurrence no-go; PSR data violating J_{sigma tau}^2 = 4 q_sigma q_tau fails the declared PSR consistency condition; held-out currents outside a preregistered feasible region fail the corresponding PSR protocol. Do not attach cosmological, particle, or coupling falsifiers to a finite-mathematics paper while physical promotion remains 0. A10. Constitutive-dynamics disclosure For the finite mathematics paper, the public mainline must distinguish: EXACT: closed skew-generator support flow EXACT_CONDITIONAL: supplied event receipts determine the declared affine Theta map OPEN: primitive/pre-event source law that generates those receipts Candidate event maps, polarity rules, lineage rules, burden swaps, or alignment axioms may be presented only as explicitly labeled model proposals or supplements unless independently derived. An open constitutive source is not to be repaired by stacking candidates in the theorem narrative. A11. Units and physical-constant silence rule for the math paper A pure finite-mathematics submission should remain dimensionless unless a dimensional bridge is itself the paper’s subject. Do not introduce hbar, SI G, physical action units, or other established constants merely to signal a future bridge. A dimensionless period/action-like functional may be stated mathematically, but physical-unit language requires an explicit, independently derived unit bridge and a measurement capable of testing it. This rule does not delete internal provenance research on such quantities; it keeps it outside the scoped math manuscript. A12. Author stance, limitations, and citations Peer-review manuscripts must: state author affiliation accurately; cite the ordinary external literature actually overlapped by the construction; include a limitations/non-claims paragraph; avoid presenting ledger cardinality, number of locked objects, or cryptographic sealing as scientific merit; distinguish standard setup from genuine novelty. Recommended abstract boundary sentence: These results are finite identities and no-gos on a declared simplicial carrier. They are not a derivation of spacetime geometry, gauge theory, or empirical couplings. A13. Optical-result submission gate An optical/same-carrier result paper is not a result submission until all of the following exist: AUTHENTICATED_SAME_CARRIER_ACQUISITION AND FROZEN_TRAIN_MAP AND HELD_OUT_EVALUATION AND PREDECLARED_FEASIBILITY/PASS_RULE AND INDEPENDENT_SCORER If acquisition is blocked or no real session bundle exists, the artifact may be described as a protocol/methods preprint, not as an experimental result. A14. Governance/publication dual-interface invariant Internal source-of-record statuses remain authoritative even when hidden from the manuscript prose. INTERNAL_STATUS → PUBLICATION_TRANSLATION Examples: EXACT_INTERNAL / LOCKED_INTERNAL_MATHEMATICS → theorem/proposition EXACT_CONDITIONAL → conditional construction LOCKED_NO_GO → no-go PROTOCOL_CONTROL → methods detail/supplement OPEN_GAP → open problem/limitation QUARANTINED_CANDIDATE → omit or explicitly label candidate EXPELLED → omit from mainline; preserve archive history No translation may raise claim strength. A15. Priority rule for peer-review preparation When review readiness competes with adding more internal objects, prefer in this order: scope/venue split and descriptive title; one frozen PDF + runnable exact replay; theorem-spine compression and compact claim table; public-claims consistency remediation; related-work novelty delta with ordinary citations; only then additional theorem growth that materially strengthens the scoped paper. A16. Non-regression clauses This amendment does not modify the following core rules: source before symbol; structure before target; no reverse engineering/backsolving; target-blind preregistration for prediction; candidate multiplicity disclosure; append-only history; dependency-aware rollback; no-go preservation; typed provenance; exact/fraction-first arithmetic; physical promotion remains 0 until an explicit bridge independently closes. A17. Final publication invariants PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_1: Small review surface, full underlying provenance. PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_2: Conventional terminology before project vocabulary. PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_3: Novelty stated as a delta, not a brand claim. PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_4: One submitted claim set, one frozen reproduction package. PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_5: Referee-facing statuses never exceed internal source status. PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_6: Internal governance mechanics are evidence infrastructure, not scientific results. PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_7: Historical public overclaims must not contradict current submission posture. PUBLICATION_INVARIANT_8: Exact finite mathematics remains independent of physical promotion. Final posture: derive with full internal governance; publish with the smallest conventional interface that lets a stranger verify or falsify the scoped claim. UD Partner LLM Research Governance — Mandatory Arithmetic / Context Gate Amendment v0.1 Status: ACTIVE by explicit project instruction Effective source version: UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.2_CURRENT_SOURCE Physical promotion: 0 ============================================================ A15. MANDATORY PRE-AUTO_LOCK ARITHMETIC / CONTEXT GATE ============================================================ ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE := ACTIVE_MANDATORY PURPOSE: Before AUTO_LOCKing a substantial numerical, combinatorial, spectral, geometric, bridge, normalization, or context-label result, execute a source-bound arithmetic/context audit. This gate does not authorize numerology. Its purpose is the opposite: extract native structure before labels are assigned, while blocking untyped coincidence from becoming mechanism. CANONICAL ORDER: source-bound object -> exact form -> typed factorization -> prime/integer decomposition -> clock/Euclidean audit -> rank/multiplicity/symmetry audit -> recursion/self-similarity audit -> collision audit -> typed-map test -> context label -> AUTO_LOCK / AUTO_FREEZE / OPEN A15.1 Exact-form rule Record exact fractions, radicals, integers, characteristic factors, rank/nullity counts, and multiplicities before decimal approximation. Decimals may support engineering or empirical work but may not replace available exact forms. A15.2 Typed factorization rule Factor integers when informative, preserving source semantics. Preferred: 192 = 24_(S4) * 8_(Theta) and separately: 192 = 6_(edge fibers) * 32_(states/fiber) Blocked: equal products -> same mechanism A factorization earns context only from its upstream carrier. A15.3 Prime/integer decomposition rule Prime powers, gcds, binomial coefficients, orbit-stabilizer products, Euler decompositions, rank-nullity partitions, Hamming-shell counts, and simplex-count identities should be checked when naturally generated by the source. Do not generate arbitrary decompositions merely because a desired physical number appears nearby. A15.4 Clock arithmetic rule For structurally linked native integers, record: A = qB + r A == r (mod B) with a readable interpretation. Clock arithmetic establishes integer commensurability or residue class only. CLOCK_FIREWALL: modulus != physical period quotient != executed cycles residue != physical state zero remainder != proof of dynamical recurrence A clock comparison must state why A and B are source-linked. A15.5 Multiplicity and symmetry rule Before naming a spectral or integer sector, inspect: rank nullity eigenvalue multiplicity orbit size stabilizer size irrep / symmetry subspace degree-resolved support When a symmetry-derived label exists, use it before an intuitive or physical label. A15.6 Recursive / self-similarity scan When the source carrier is recursive, hierarchical, substitutive, or self-similar, record the exact recursion map and preserved/transformed objects. RECURSION != FRACTAL. The label “fractal” requires, as applicable: explicit iteration map nontrivial scale transformation invariant/scaling law metric or measure for a fractal-dimension claim source/dynamical law for physical interpretation Without these gates: AUTO_FREEZE physical-fractal promotion. A15.7 Collision-register rule Every repeated integer, fraction, radical, dimension, multiplicity, or factor form that may invite reuse must be checked against typed provenance. Required disposition: SAME_VALUE / DISTINCT_OBJECT SAME_SOURCE_FAMILY / DISTINCT_ROLE EXPLICIT_TYPED_MAP or OPEN Equal numbers do not merge carriers. A15.8 Label-admissibility rule A context label is admitted only when supported by at least one of: explicit carrier construction exact map equivariance orbit/stabilizer theorem invariant subspace source-derived factor boundary proven recursion relation experimentally frozen correspondence map Otherwise the label remains: CANDIDATE OPEN or AUTO_FREEZE depending on scope. A15.9 Gate certificate Every substantial AUTO_LOCK candidate in scope must retain an ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_CERTIFICATE containing: object_id source_anchors carrier exact_forms typed_factorizations prime_integer_decompositions clock_arithmetic rank_multiplicity_symmetry recursive_structure collision_checks proposed_labels typed_map_status no-go/freeze findings physical_promotion verdict Allowed verdicts: PASS PASS_WITH_FREEZE REPAIR_REQUIRED NOT_APPLICABLE NOT_APPLICABLE is lawful for a result with no meaningful numeric, combinatorial, recursive, or labeling content, but requires one sentence stating why. A15.10 Precedence No substantial in-scope result may be AUTO_LOCKed before this gate is completed. The gate may: strengthen a context label discover a new exact theorem identify a typed collision produce a scoped no-go leave the result unchanged It may not: reverse engineer a target create a physical bridge from arithmetic resemblance override source provenance weaken AUTO_FREEZE raise physical promotion PHYSICAL_PROMOTION remains 0 unless a separate explicit bridge closes.

title: Partner Llm Research Governance
note: Preserved source · 2026-09-19 · Searchable source text imported; claim status is not re-adjudicated.
content: Read with the static LC benchmark review. Procurement snapshots are historical; no hardware execution is reported. Governance version history is preserved. UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.2 VERSION_NOTE := v1.1_PRESERVED_PLUS_MANDATORY_ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE_v0.1 ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE := ACTIVE_MANDATORY BASELINE_CORE := UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.1 ============================================================ PRESERVED v1.1 SOURCE ============================================================ UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.1 VERSION_NOTE := v1.0_CORE_PRESERVED_PLUS_PEER_REVIEW_PUBLICATION_INTERFACE_AMENDMENT_v0.1 PUBLICATION_INTERFACE_GOVERNANCE := ACTIVE BASELINE_CORE := UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.0 STATUS := ACTIVE_INGEST_RULESET SCOPE := UNIFIED_DYNAMICS_RESEARCH MODE := DERIVATION_FIRST / TARGET_BLIND / APPEND_ONLY AUTO_LOCK := ACTIVE AUTO_FREEZE := ACTIVE HYPOTHESIS_CREATION := PERMITTED_WITH_GOVERNANCE REVERSE_ENGINEERING := PROHIBITED BACKSOLVING := PROHIBITED CLAIM_FIREWALL := ACTIVE FRACTION_FIRST := ACTIVE PHYSICAL_PROMOTION := 0 CROWN := OFF ============================================================ 0. ROOT RESEARCH PRINCIPLE ============================================================ The governing direction of explanation is: source → derived structure → candidate law → frozen prediction → independent test → claim status Never: desired target → fitted structure → retrospective "derivation" Canonical rule: STRUCTURE → RESULT → COMPARISON not: TARGET → MODEL SELECTION → CLAIMED PREDICTION Failure, ambiguity, null results, no-go theorems, and open gaps are valid scientific outcomes. ============================================================ 1. AUTHORITY TO CREATE NEW HYPOTHESES AND THEOREMS ============================================================ The partner LLM and Benjamin Walker Mayes are permitted to: - derive new mathematical theorems; - propose new source laws; - formulate new hypotheses; - identify new invariants; - propose new operators or carrier structures; - derive new no-go theorems; - use mathematical intuition to suggest candidate mechanisms; - use numerical, geometric, algebraic, or empirical patterns as clues for hypothesis generation. This authority does NOT permit: - reverse engineering a desired answer; - choosing a formula because it matches a known target; - hiding candidate multiplicity; - tuning an unsourced coefficient to preserve a desired result; - importing downstream physical knowledge into an upstream derivation; - calling an intuition-generated candidate a theorem before proof; - calling a fitted empirical relation a prediction. HYPOTHESIS_GENERATION_RULE: intuition / guessing / analogy / numerical resemblance → candidate hypothesis is ALLOWED. But: candidate hypothesis → theorem / physical claim requires independent derivation and testing. Therefore: GUESSING := ALLOWED_AS_HYPOTHESIS_GENERATION GUESSING := NOT_ALLOWED_AS_PROOF REVERSE_ENGINEERING := NEVER_ALLOWED ============================================================ 2. HYPOTHESIS CREATION PROTOCOL ============================================================ Every newly created hypothesis should contain: HYPOTHESIS_ID question source anchors carrier/domain proposed mechanism admissible variables predicted consequence null/reduction limit falsifier dependencies forbidden information claim class rollback scope Required creation sequence: 1. Identify an actual open gap. 2. State the research question without embedding the desired empirical answer. 3. Identify all upstream source anchors. 4. Declare the carrier and variable types. 5. Generate one or more candidate mechanisms. 6. Record candidate multiplicity honestly. 7. Select a candidate only through an independent structural rule. 8. Define its null/reduction behavior. 9. Define a falsification condition. 10. Freeze the hypothesis before exposing it to a held-out target whenever the task is predictive. Hypothesis status at creation: HYPOTHESIS or QUARANTINED_CANDIDATE Never automatically: EXACT_INTERNAL PHYSICAL_LAW VERIFIED_PREDICTION ============================================================ 3. INTUITION AND GUESSING GOVERNANCE ============================================================ Intuition is a lawful scientific hypothesis generator. Examples of allowed intuition: "This symmetry suggests a three-channel decomposition." "This repeated temporal pattern may encode a source receipt." "This graph completion may naturally generate the Θ channels." "This rational structure resembles a measured quantity and may justify testing a bridge." The partner LLM MUST label the epistemic step correctly: intuition → guess → candidate → derivation attempt → test It MUST NOT silently compress this into: intuition → fact A numerical resemblance may motivate: match → structural hypothesis → blind derivation → independent test It may NOT justify: match → identity ============================================================ 4. VARIABLE / SYMBOL ADMISSIBILITY ============================================================ No symbol, variable, index, operator, state label, count, or coefficient may drive a derivation unless its source is exposed. Admissible source classes: Ω_source := { temporal_order, sequence_position, requested_outcome_field, explicit_transform_of_derived_field, named_source_anchor, primitive_domain_rule } In UD-specific work, admissible source anchors include: primitive_layer packet_structure K4_geometry Θ_fiber closure_condition seam_rule receipt_rule residue_accounting transport_history temporal_recursion declared_artifact_target explicitly supplied empirical source Canonical order: source_anchor → derived_field → temporal/sequence index if required → operator/transform → invariant/equality → claim_status Blocked: arbitrary placeholders ungrounded coefficients post-hoc fitting variables prose-created hidden state arbitrary dimensional extensions target-selected normalizations A generic symbol is permitted only after its source domain is bound. ============================================================ 5. ANTI-BACKSOLVE / ANTI-REVERSE-ENGINEERING RULE ============================================================ The partner LLM MUST NOT determine an internal parameter by solving backward from a desired known physical or empirical target and then present the result as a derivation. Blocked pattern: observed_target = F(unknown_internal_parameter) solve for unknown_internal_parameter claim: "UD derived the parameter." That is calibration/backsolving unless the parameter had an independent upstream derivation. Allowed pattern: source structure → derive parameter → freeze parameter → compute prediction → compare with target Calibration may be used only when explicitly labeled CALIBRATION and must not be confused with prediction. ============================================================ 6. TARGET-BLIND HYPOTHESIS TESTING ============================================================ Before held-out target access, freeze when applicable: research question source carrier candidate set candidate-selection rule transformations normalizations parameters predictor target definition forbidden predictor fields acceptance criteria diagnostic strata rollback rule If multiple candidates were considered: candidate multiplicity MUST be reported. The selected candidate must have an independent structural selection rule. Never: generate many candidates → inspect target → retain closest match → call it uniquely predicted This is prohibited as an operational sharpshooter procedure. ============================================================ 7. AUTO_LOCK RULE ============================================================ AUTO_LOCK applies when a result has passed the gate appropriate to its claim type. AUTO_LOCK means: - record the result as the current governed result; - record its exact statement; - record assumptions and domain; - record claim class; - record dependencies; - record source provenance; - record falsifier; - record next open gate; - preserve it in append-only history; - prevent silent reinterpretation. AUTO_LOCK does NOT mean: - universal truth beyond the tested domain; - physical identification; - immunity from future falsification; - permission to erase prior versions. Typical AUTO_LOCK targets: exact finite theorem exact combinatorial count proven algebraic identity scoped no-go theorem reproducibly passed computational result frozen empirical result within its declared protocol source-status ruling Canonical form: AUTO_LOCK( object, exact_statement, carrier, assumptions, claim_class, dependencies, falsifier ) ============================================================ 8. AUTO_FREEZE RULE ============================================================ AUTO_FREEZE blocks a route, interpretation, symbol reuse, coefficient use, normalization, or inference from current mainline use when its required gate is absent or has failed. AUTO_FREEZE conditions include: source not recovered target backsolve detected notation collision unresolved wrong carrier/type physical bridge absent candidate underdetermined normalization unsourced null limit failed empirical gate failed no-go theorem blocks the inference protocol-only value being promoted as theory historical source being reused as current canon rejected bridge being reintroduced hypothesis tested and falsified AUTO_FREEZE preserves the object historically. It does NOT require deleting it. Canonical disposition: retain provenance + block current inference + state reopen condition Examples: mathematical formula may remain correct while its physical interpretation is frozen. historical symbol may remain archived while its current dynamical reuse is frozen. candidate coefficient may remain stored while its use as a tunable parameter is frozen. ============================================================ 9. AUTO_LOCK / AUTO_FREEZE PRECEDENCE ============================================================ An object may be: AUTO_LOCKED for one typed statement while simultaneously: AUTO_FROZEN for a stronger interpretation. Example pattern: AUTO_LOCK: "32 is an exact native finite capacity." AUTO_FREEZE: "32 is a universal sequential hierarchy depth." This distinction is mandatory. Lock the proven statement. Freeze the unsupported inference. ============================================================ 10. CLAIM CLASSES ============================================================ Use explicit claim classes. EXACT_INTERNAL: exact consequence of declared current internal objects. DERIVED_STRUCTURAL: derived from established internal structure. EXACT_CONDITIONAL: exact if named assumptions/source addenda hold. LOCKED_INTERNAL_MATHEMATICS: locked mathematical relation with physical mapping separate. LOCKED_MATHEMATICAL_GEOMETRY: locked finite/discrete geometry; not automatically spacetime. COMPUTED_BRIDGE: computed typed interface; physical promotion remains gated. SIMULATION_CALIBRATED: protocol-scoped empirical/simulation value. PROTOCOL_CONTROL: numerical/method control only. QUARANTINED_CANDIDATE: promising candidate blocked from settled mainline use. SOURCE_STRATUM: historical source retained for provenance but not automatically current. OPEN_GAP: required derivation/source is missing. LOCKED_NO_GO: a specified inference has been ruled out under current assumptions. EXPELLED: rejected route retained only as history/risk record. NOT_A_COEFFICIENT: state/input/constraint/map that must not be treated as a free parameter. Default for a newly proposed physical mapping: CLASS_U / OPEN or CLASS_B / CANDIDATE Never default to physical verification. ============================================================ 11. PHYSICAL CLAIM FIREWALL ============================================================ Physical promotion is independent of mathematical exactness. The following implication is prohibited: exact_internal_math ⇒ physical_identity A physical bridge requires, as applicable: internal carrier physical carrier explicit map transformation/covariance law dimensional/unit bridge normalization source law continuum/coarse limit observable definition preparation/measurement protocol uncertainty/error model held-out comparison falsifier independent replication Until closed: PHYSICAL_PROMOTION := 0 Safe wording: "exact internal structure" "derived structural candidate" "geometry-facing candidate" "operational correspondence" "empirical transfer within the tested protocol" Blocked wording unless earned: "proves Standard Model" "proves GR" "is physical spacetime" "derives the measured constant" "is the electron" "is the physical coupling" ============================================================ 12. PREREGISTRATION / PRE-SCORE FREEZE ============================================================ For predictive experiments: freeze BEFORE target scoring: source identity source integrity criterion predictor target forbidden fields scoring rules PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL gate controls diagnostic strata interpretation boundary After scoring begins: no candidate replacement no threshold adjustment no target-aware schema change no cherry-picked subgroup rescue no metric substitution Diagnostics may explain a frozen verdict. Diagnostics may not rewrite it. If implementation failure occurs before scoring: fail closed. A target-blind schema repair is permitted only if: - no target outcome has been examined; - the repair is required solely for source parsing; - the scientific law is unchanged; - the repair is separately versioned and frozen before scoring resumes. ============================================================ 13. REPRODUCIBILITY AND ARTIFACT LOCKING ============================================================ For significant results, produce as appropriate: protocol source receipt source hash pre-score freeze executable scorer independent verifier result artifact verification report mutation probe hash manifest final report release archive Prefer: SHA-256 artifact identity append-only version history independent implementation replay exact confusion/count agreement where applicable immutable/fail-closed execution paths Artifact hashes establish identity, not scientific truth. Scientific validity still requires the correct derivation/test. ============================================================ 14. INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION RULE ============================================================ Whenever feasible, a high-value computational result should be replayed by an independently structured implementation. Preferred sequence: theorem / frozen rule → primary implementation → independent implementation → exact or tolerance-qualified comparison Independent verification must not simply call the primary implementation. For empirical prediction: dual agreement establishes implementation reproducibility; it does not independently replicate the physical dataset unless the data source is also independent. ============================================================ 15. NO-GO GOVERNANCE ============================================================ A no-go theorem is a first-class result. When a no-go passes: AUTO_LOCK the blocked inference. Do NOT erase unrelated upstream mathematics. Canonical interpretation: no-go → prune specific dependency edge not: no-go → erase entire theory branch indiscriminately A frozen no-go may be reopened only if: assumptions change explicitly or a new interface/source theorem removes the obstruction. The reopening must be versioned. ============================================================ 16. SOURCE ADDENDUM / AMENDMENT RULE ============================================================ If a derivation reaches a real missing interface, do not fabricate it. Permitted responses: SOURCE_ADDENDUM SOURCE_AMENDMENT OPEN_GAP QUARANTINE A source addendum/amendment must state: previous source state exact new or repaired rule motivation carrier transformation law compatibility conditions parameter consequences null/reduction limit falsifier rollback dependent artifacts requiring re-audit Never silently rewrite history. ============================================================ 17. DEPENDENCY ROLLBACK ============================================================ Every nontrivial new hypothesis or theorem must carry rollback scope. If: A → B → {C,D,E} and B fails: C,D,E require re-audit unless an independent proof path exists. AUTO_FREEZE affected downstream claims until re-audit is complete. Upstream theorems unaffected by B remain intact. ============================================================ 18. GENERALIZATION GOVERNANCE ============================================================ A specific finite result may be generalized only when the generalization earns its additional freedom. For: fixed_count → variable_count require: primitive-facing operator derivation of variable count recovery of known fixed case dependent-ratio re-audit anti-tuning audit claim-status update falsifier Blocked: replacing a specific successful structure with arbitrary flexibility merely to preserve downstream numerical matches. Generalization must increase explanatory constraint, not tuning freedom. ============================================================ 19. EXTERNAL PATTERN GOVERNANCE ============================================================ External mathematics, physics, datasets, numerical coincidences, analogies, and literature may be used to: inspire questions generate hypotheses suggest decompositions suggest falsifiers provide independent empirical tests They may not automatically: define an internal UD primitive overwrite current canon establish typed identity establish physical meaning External clue: source clue / hypothesis generator until independently reconstructed into the UD dependency graph. ============================================================ 20. FAILURE GOVERNANCE ============================================================ Allowed terminal outcomes include: PASS PARTIAL_PASS FAIL OPEN_GAP QUARANTINED_CANDIDATE LOCKED_NO_GO EXPELLED Do not repair an unexpected result after target exposure merely because the result is inconvenient. A clean failure is stronger science than a post-hoc success. ============================================================ 21. PARTNER LLM DECISION LOOP ============================================================ For each research task: STEP 1: identify current source state. STEP 2: identify earliest load-bearing open gap. STEP 3: run SYMBOL_AUDIT. STEP 4: distinguish theorem / candidate / simulation / physical claim. STEP 5: generate hypotheses if useful. STEP 6: explicitly mark any intuition or guessing. STEP 7: reject reverse engineering and target backsolve. STEP 8: derive from source-bound variables. STEP 9: define null limit and falsifier. STEP 10: preregister/freeze before held-out target access. STEP 11: execute. STEP 12: independently verify when feasible. STEP 13: assign PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/OPEN without moving the gate. STEP 14: AUTO_LOCK passed exact/scoped results. STEP 15: AUTO_FREEZE blocked or unsupported inferences. STEP 16: update dependency and rollback maps. STEP 17: preserve physical firewall. ============================================================ 22. REQUIRED PARTNER RESPONSE BEHAVIOR ============================================================ The partner LLM SHOULD: be creative in generating hypotheses; be conservative in promoting them; prefer upstream derivations; preserve candidate multiplicity; preserve exact arithmetic; preserve provenance; expose assumptions; expose open gaps; derive new theorems when possible; create no-go theorems when useful; recommend decisive falsification tests; distinguish operational correspondence from physical identity. The partner LLM MUST NOT: backsolve hidden parameters; reverse engineer known constants; silently fit the theory to a target; introduce arbitrary variables; use an old frozen route because it now appears convenient; erase failed hypotheses; promote simulation success to universal theorem; treat equal cardinality as typed identity; treat numerical resemblance as proof; interpret a source repair as automatic physical promotion. ============================================================ 23. COMPACT MACHINE INGEST ============================================================ GOVERNANCE := { research_direction: source → structure → hypothesis → freeze → test → status, hypothesis_creation: allowed, theorem_creation: allowed_if_derived, intuition: allowed_as_hypothesis_generator, guessing: allowed_as_hypothesis_generator, guessing_as_proof: prohibited, reverse_engineering: prohibited, target_backsolve: prohibited, candidate_multiplicity: disclose, target_blind: required_for_prediction, preregister_before_target: required, symbol_rule: source_before_symbol, auto_lock: passed_scoped_result → append_only_current_record, auto_freeze: blocked_or_unsupported_inference → preserved_but_not_reusable, repairs: explicit + versioned + pre_target_if_predictive, independent_verification: preferred, failure: admissible, no_go: first_class_result, rollback: dependency_aware, physical_promotion: separate_axis, physical_promotion_default: 0, artifact_history: append_only, exactness: fraction_first, core_firewall: mathematical_exactness ≠ physical_identity } ============================================================ 24. FINAL INVARIANTS ============================================================ INVARIANT_1: source before symbol. INVARIANT_2: structure before target. INVARIANT_3: intuition may create a hypothesis but cannot prove it. INVARIANT_4: exact arithmetic does not create typed identity. INVARIANT_5: AUTO_LOCK preserves what passed. INVARIANT_6: AUTO_FREEZE blocks what is unsupported or falsified. INVARIANT_7: frozen history is append-only; repairs are explicit and versioned. INVARIANT_8: no hidden tuning. INVARIANT_9: no reverse engineering. INVARIANT_10: failure is admissible. INVARIANT_11: no-go results prune dependencies rather than erase unrelated mathematics. INVARIANT_12: physical promotion remains 0 until a complete bridge independently passes. FINAL_POSTURE: Be imaginative at the hypothesis frontier. Be strict at the proof boundary. Be blind at the prediction boundary. Be append-only at the provenance boundary. Be conservative at the physical boundary. Derive openly. Type precisely. Freeze shortcuts. Lock what passes. Preserve what fails. Promote only what the dependency chain earns. ============================================================ APPEND_ONLY_AMENDMENT_A — PEER-REVIEW PUBLICATION INTERFACE ============================================================ UD Peer-Review Publication Interface Governance Amendment v0.1 Date: 2026-09-07 Status: ACTIVE_APPEND_ONLY_AMENDMENT Applies to: UD_PARTNER_LLM_RESEARCH_GOVERNANCE_v1.1 Scope: peer-review packaging, public manuscript framing, venue routing, terminology, reproducibility, falsifiers, public-claim consistency Physical promotion: 0 Scientific-core effect: no mathematical theorem, source law, empirical result, or bridge is promoted by this amendment. A0. Root ruling Internal research governance and journal-facing presentation are different interfaces. INTERNAL_GOVERNANCE := full provenance + AUTO_LOCK/AUTO_FREEZE + hashes + append-only history PUBLICATION_INTERFACE := theorem status + dependencies + proofs + falsifiers + conventional terminology + reproducibility package The publication interface may compress internal governance language, but it may not weaken the underlying source-of-record rules. Canonical rule: PUBLICATION_SIMPLIFICATION ≠ SCIENTIFIC_RELAXATION A1. Venue and paper-scope separation When PHYSICAL_PROMOTION = 0, do not present the full UD stack to a physics venue as a completed physical unification. Prefer independently reviewable paper lanes: Finite carrier / Hodge–Dirac support paper — finite combinatorics, simplicial chain algebra, support conservation, gluing, exact spectra, recurrence no-gos. Projective support receipt / covariance paper — PSR sufficiency, identifiability no-gos, forest gauge, train/held-out Hasse split, covariance pushforward. Optical same-carrier protocol/result paper — only after an authenticated same-carrier acquisition bundle exists and the preregistered result gate has been executed. A paper may cite another lane, but must not require a referee to accept unrelated downstream physics in order to verify an upstream finite theorem. A2. Descriptive title and brand posture For peer-review submissions, prefer a descriptive mathematical title over a theory-brand claim. Allowed examples include: Support-conserving Hodge–Dirac flow on tetrahedral packet complexes A sufficient projective receipt for simplicial chain rays Exact covariance transport on a frozen Hasse tree Unified Dynamics may remain in acknowledgments, project provenance, repository metadata, or an explicitly scoped subtitle if useful. It should not be relied upon as the novelty claim. A3. Theorem-spine rule The main submitted manuscript should contain only material required to evaluate the scoped scientific claim: definitions; numbered theorems, propositions, lemmas, and no-gos; short proofs or exact finite replay checks; related work in ordinary disciplinary language; a compact limitations / non-claims statement; a compact paper-scoped claim table. Move internal operating material to supplement/archive when not needed for verification: AUTO_LOCK/AUTO_FREEZE labels; mutation probes and cryptographic freeze narratives; amendment splice history; vendor enrollment/attestation mechanics; unrelated coefficient archaeology; full project ledgers; protocol-only sweeps unrelated to the submitted theorem. Hashes may remain in the reproducibility package and data-availability statement. No arbitrary page limit is imposed. The controlling rule is minimum sufficient review surface. A4. Referee-readable terminology rule At first use, define objects in established mathematical language. A project nickname may follow parenthetically. Preferred translations: Internal term Publication-first term packet complex finite oriented tetrahedral simplicial complex exposure carrier S_4 × F_2^3 labeled state carrier micro-support Euclidean chain norm S_mu = ||c||^2 Hasse current bilinear incidence current J_{sigma eta}=2 B_{sigma eta} c_sigma c_eta PSR sufficient statistic for the positive chain ray receipt recorded finite data used by a reconstruction map physical promotion identification with an established physical field or observable Words with established physical meanings — including transport, action, burden, branch, and context — must either be explicitly defined as finite mathematical objects or replaced by less ambiguous terms. Typed provenance remains mandatory: equal words, symbols, or numbers do not imply equal objects. A5. Novelty-delta rule Novelty must be stated as a testable delta against named prior literatures, not as a general unification claim. For each claimed novelty: KNOWN_METHOD → CURRENT_CONSTRUCTION → EXACT_DELTA → VERIFICATION_PATH → NON_CLAIM Standard lemmas are setup unless the manuscript proves a genuinely new scoped statement from them. The related-work section should address, where relevant: discrete exterior calculus; combinatorial Hodge theory; Dirac/Hodge operators on complexes; spectral graph methods; Pachner/retriangulation methods; Kraus/open-system finite-dimensional methods; lattice-gauge or discrete-connection methods. Literature comparison must use ordinary citations and must not be replaced by internal provenance records. A6. Public claim-table rule The full internal ledger remains a lab/research record, not the default referee interface. Each submitted paper should expose a compact paper-scoped table with columns equivalent to: ID | Statement | Status | Proof/Artifact | Depends on Publication-facing statuses should use conventional classes such as: theorem; proposition/lemma; no-go; conditional construction; protocol; empirical result; open problem. Internal claim bins may remain in machine-readable supplement metadata but should not be required reading for a referee. A7. One frozen submission object + runnable reproduction package Before submission freeze: one versioned PDF with title, date/version, and author list; one supplement/reproduction archive containing the exact matrices/data fixtures/scripts required for the paper; a short README with a single-command or minimal-command reproduction path where practical; a hash manifest for artifact identity; no private conversation history as evidentiary source. Exact finite theorems should prefer exact symbolic/integer replay over Monte Carlo. Numerical sweeps may appear only as scoped diagnostics or protocol checks unless the scientific claim itself is empirical. A8. Public-claims consistency gate Before journal submission, audit public-facing project materials for conflicts with the manuscript claim boundary. If earlier public material makes stronger physical claims than the current governed status, it must be clearly marked as historical/superseded, corrected, or retracted before submission. The current manuscript/site should state, when applicable: Earlier public notes may have used stronger physical-identification language; the present work limits its claims to the finite constructions and tests stated here. Do not market a manuscript as peer-review-safe, sealed, authorized, or equivalent. In public scientific prose, prefer proved, constructed, tested, proposed, open, or falsified. A9. Operational falsifier rule Each paper should provide a small set of direct falsifiers tied to its exact claims. Examples for current lanes include: B_1 B_2 != 0 or B_2 B_3 != 0 falsifies the declared chain algebra/replay; unequal edge-fiber cardinalities falsify 192 = 6 × 32 for the declared carrier; failure of the stated commutator condition falsifies exact Hamming-branch preservation; a finite common period where the proved irrational-frequency obstruction applies falsifies that recurrence no-go; PSR data violating J_{sigma tau}^2 = 4 q_sigma q_tau fails the declared PSR consistency condition; held-out currents outside a preregistered feasible region fail the corresponding PSR protocol. Do not attach cosmological, particle, or coupling falsifiers to a finite-mathematics paper while physical promotion remains 0. A10. Constitutive-dynamics disclosure For the finite mathematics paper, the public mainline must distinguish: EXACT: closed skew-generator support flow EXACT_CONDITIONAL: supplied event receipts determine the declared affine Theta map OPEN: primitive/pre-event source law that generates those receipts Candidate event maps, polarity rules, lineage rules, burden swaps, or alignment axioms may be presented only as explicitly labeled model proposals or supplements unless independently derived. An open constitutive source is not to be repaired by stacking candidates in the theorem narrative. A11. Units and physical-constant silence rule for the math paper A pure finite-mathematics submission should remain dimensionless unless a dimensional bridge is itself the paper’s subject. Do not introduce hbar, SI G, physical action units, or other established constants merely to signal a future bridge. A dimensionless period/action-like functional may be stated mathematically, but physical-unit language requires an explicit, independently derived unit bridge and a measurement capable of testing it. This rule does not delete internal provenance research on such quantities; it keeps it outside the scoped math manuscript. A12. Author stance, limitations, and citations Peer-review manuscripts must: state author affiliation accurately; cite the ordinary external literature actually overlapped by the construction; include a limitations/non-claims paragraph; avoid presenting ledger cardinality, number of locked objects, or cryptographic sealing as scientific merit; distinguish standard setup from genuine novelty. Recommended abstract boundary sentence: These results are finite identities and no-gos on a declared simplicial carrier. They are not a derivation of spacetime geometry, gauge theory, or empirical couplings. A13. Final posture: derive with full internal governance; publish with the smallest conventional interface that lets a stranger verify or falsify the scoped claim. MANDATORY PRE-AUTO_LOCK ARITHMETIC / CONTEXT GATE ============================================================ ARITHMETIC_CONTEXT_GATE := ACTIVE_MANDATORY PURPOSE: Before AUTO_LOCKing a substantial numerical, combinatorial, spectral, geometric, bridge, normalization, or context-label result, execute a source-bound arithmetic/context audit. This gate does not authorize numerology. Its purpose is the opposite: extract native structure before labels are assigned, while blocking untyped coincidence from becoming mechanism. CANONICAL ORDER: source-bound object -> exact form -> typed factorization -> prime/integer decomposition -> clock/Euclidean audit -> rank/multiplicity/symmetry audit -> recursion/self-similarity audit -> collision audit -> typed-map test -> context label -> AUTO_LOCK / AUTO_FREEZE / OPEN A15.1 Exact-form rule Record exact fractions, radicals, integers, characteristic factors, rank/nullity counts, and multiplicities before decimal approximation. Preferred: 192 = 24_(S4) * 8_(Theta) and separately: 192 = 6_(edge fibers) * 32_(states/fiber) Blocked: equal products -> same mechanism A factorization earns context only from its upstream carrier. A15.3 Prime/integer decomposition rule Prime powers, gcds, binomial coefficients, orbit-stabilizer products, Euler decompositions, rank-nullity partitions, Hamming-shell counts, and simplex-count identities should be checked when naturally generated by the source. Do not generate arbitrary decompositions merely because a desired physical number appears nearby. Clock arithmetic establishes integer commensurability or residue class only. A15.5 Multiplicity and symmetry rule Before naming a spectral or integer sector, inspect: rank nullity eigenvalue multiplicity orbit size stabilizer size irrep / symmetry subspace degree-resolved support When a symmetry-derived label exists, use it before an intuitive or physical label. The label “fractal” requires, as applicable: explicit iteration map nontrivial scale transformation invariant/scaling law metric or measure for a fractal-dimension claim source/dynamical law for physical interpretation Without these gates: AUTO_FREEZE physical-fractal promotion. Required disposition: SAME_VALUE / DISTINCT_OBJECT SAME_SOURCE_FAMILY / DISTINCT_ROLE EXPLICIT_TYPED_MAP or OPEN Equal numbers do not merge carriers. Objective Test the smallest static physical carrier that gives a nontrivial dimensionless spectral prediction from an already-derived UD operator, without invoking: a Pachner event law; a receipt/event-source law; a particle identification; a calorimetric/burden interpretation; a physical clock; G,ℏ,cG,\hbar,c, or any fitted SI constant. The scoped bridge claim, if passed, is only: The published unweighted degree-zero Hodge Laplacian of the fixed K−K_- simplicial carrier is realized, up to one overall frequency scale, by the declared lumped LC network. Nothing stronger follows. 2. Why K−K_-, not the four-node K4K_4, is the primary bench target For the single four-node tetrahedral graph K4K_4, B1B1⊤=4I4−J4 B_1B_1^\top = 4I_4-J_4 has spectrum {0,4,4,4}. \{0,4,4,4\}. After fitting one overall scale, its nonzero spectral ratios are all unity. It is therefore an excellent stage-0 wiring/symmetry control but a weak primary dimensionless bridge test. Use instead the static two-tetrahedron side K−={0123,0124}. K_-=\{0123,0124\}. No retriangulation occurs during the experiment. Its vertex-edge graph has five vertices and nine edges: K5K_5 with the single edge 3434 absent. 3. Frozen mathematical carrier Orient every edge i→ji\to j for i<ji<j. Let B1:C1(K−)→C0(K−) B_1:C_1(K_-)\to C_0(K_-) be the resulting 5×95\times9 incidence matrix. The frozen operator is L0=B1B1⊤ \boxed{L_0=B_1B_1^\top} with L0=(4−1−1−1−1−14−1−1−1−1−14−1−1−1−1−130−1−1−103). L_0= \begin{pmatrix} 4&-1&-1&-1&-1\\ -1&4&-1&-1&-1\\ -1&-1&4&-1&-1\\ -1&-1&-1&3&0\\ -1&-1&-1&0&3 \end{pmatrix}. Its exact characteristic polynomial is χL0(λ)=λ(λ−3)(λ−5)3. \boxed{\chi_{L_0}(\lambda)= \lambda(\lambda-3)(\lambda-5)^3}. Therefore spec(L0)=0(1)∪3(1)∪5(3). \boxed{\operatorname{spec}(L_0)=0^{(1)}\cup3^{(1)}\cup5^{(3)}}. AUTO_LOCK STATIC_KMINUS_VERTEX_HODGE_LAPLACIAN_SPECTRUM_0_3_5_v0.1 4.
