What still prevents execution or promotion The errata make Part A conditional on qualified n=2 and n=3 carriers. The supplied source does not establish those complete physical carriers. These winding-state labels must not be confused with tetrahedron counts in a Pachner move: later combinatorial 2→3 results do not automatically satisfy the laboratory carrier requirement. For Part B, retain the proposed response-shell coverage and the separate partial-integrity event needed to distinguish MTA. Part C remains a held scope analysis in the original packet. Publishing it here does not constitute a custodian ruling or alter a frozen scorer. The site checks reproduce the example recurrence algebra. They do not satisfy the required non-constructor adversarial review of the complete bridge packet. No outreach or laboratory execution is implied. The proposed confidence ladder Level Required evidence under the supplied proposal CRL-2a · Proposed A measurement-facing bridge construction, author-checked only CRL-2b · Pre-registered Frozen before data and reviewed adversarially by a non-constructor CRL-2c · Executed Survived one blinded run against the frozen rule CRL-2d · Replicated Survived independent replication; eligible for later identification consideration The active topology extension separately classifies internal incidence, homology, source-interface mathematics, and synthetic simulations as CRL-1/internal. Exact mathematics can be retained within its stated assumptions without promoting a source amendment or a physical interpretation. The governance record also calls for explicit dependencies, append-only corrections, and re-evaluation when a dependency changes. A longer citation chain is not stronger evidence. The original documents and their different status labels remain visible rather than being silently rewritten into one approved protocol. C₅ context and scheduler synthesis · Exact intake checks.

title: CRL Subdivision and Topology/Source Governance
note: Updated governance · 14 September 2026 · Searchable source text imported; claim status is not re-adjudicated.
content: Sections 1–6 retain their proposal label; section 7 is labeled an active topology/source amendment. The recovered base matches sections 1–6; section 7 is appended. Governance Amendment — CRL-2 Subdivision and Anti-Erosion Rules Status: governance proposal. Amends the confidence-rating ladder and the promotion/demotion procedure. Physical promotion: 0. Derived from a measured error distribution over this development session: zero errors in the exact-substrate layer, seven in the bridge layer, four material — every material error found only on adversarial review, never during construction. The amendment concentrates protection where the errors are. 1. CRL-2 subdivision The current CRL-2 (“operational / measurement-facing”) spans everything from a written proposal to a replicated result. That range is too wide for one label. Replace with: CRL-2a PROPOSED bridge construction written down; author-checked only CRL-2b PRE-REGISTERED frozen before data AND passed >=1 adversarial review by a party who did not construct it CRL-2c EXECUTED survived one blinded run against its frozen rule CRL-2d REPLICATED survived >=1 independent replication Eligibility gates: - 2a → 2b requires a non-constructor adversarial review on record. - Only 2d is eligible for CRL-3 (physical-identification) consideration. - No claim skips a rung. Current status of this session’s output: the pre-registration packet is CRL-2a. It has been adversarially reviewed only by its own author (two passes), which this session demonstrates is insufficient — two material and four minor errors survived construction and were caught only on hostile re-read. It is not CRL-2b until a non-constructor reviews it. 2. Anti-erosion rule (support depth) Define, for any claim X: depth(X) = 0 if X is exact-substrate or empirical depth(X) = 1 + max over dependencies D of depth(D) otherwise Rule E1 — status is capped by depth. A claim cited only by other conditional claims gets deeper, never firmer. Citation is not evidence. Status improves only by re-derivation against a lower-depth anchor, never by accumulating dependents. Rule E2 — dependency expiry. If X depends on assumption A and A is revised or demoted, X auto-demotes to “pending re-derivation” with no ruling required. Append-only. Rationale. This is the specific mechanism that prevents the failure seen in the abandoned exploratory thread, where a “structural choice” became “canonicalized” across a chain in which no single step was individually wrong. Each step raised apparent firmness by citation. E1 makes that impossible; E2 makes revision propagate. 3. Asymmetric promotion / demotion PROMOTION (any rung): requires non-constructor adversarial review, then custodian ruling. Slow by design. DEMOTION on falsify: automatic, immediate, no ruling. Append-only. The custodian is removed from the demotion path entirely. This is what makes a faster promotion path safe to offer: safety never waits on custodian availability. 4. Development lane vs registry lane Separate may not claim from may not work on. REGISTRY LANE entries carrying a CRL status. Frozen frontiers apply. DEVELOPMENT LANE analysis reaching no registry conclusion. Requires only a label: "development — no registry entry." Frozen frontiers do NOT apply. Analysis that promotes nothing (e.g. showing a frozen family fails to discriminate) belongs in the development lane and does not require frontier re-entry. Promotion from development to registry requires the §3 procedure. 5. Retractions and provenance as first-class objects Retraction registry. Every correction is a registry object with the same standing as a claim: what was wrong, what replaced it, found-by (construction / self-review / external). The session-level retraction ratio is published as a diagnostic. A framework with zero recorded retractions after substantial development is unaudited, not clean. Provenance field on every claim: origin, constructor, reviewer(s), dependency list, lane. This is the field that catches contamination — content entering the lineage from outside the substrate — at entry rather than downstream. 6. The limit this does not fix Governance catches category errors: claiming CRL-2c when you hold CRL-2a. It does not catch a wrong rule inside a correctly-labeled CRL-2a document. This session is the evidence: every material error was correctly inside a “proposed” document and still wrong. Only non-constructor adversarial review catches that class. Therefore the binding recommendation is procedural, not structural: no bridge claim advances past CRL-2a without review by someone who did not build it. Everything above raises the floor. It does not substitute for that review. Physical promotion remains 0. 7. 2026-09-14 topology/source governance extension Status: active governance amendment. Physical promotion remains 0. This section governs the current C4/C5C_4/C_5, Pachner, open-source, archive/dissolution, and topology-scheduler branch. 7.1 Typed carrier identity is mandatory Equal matrices, vectors, dimensions, or numerical values do not identify objects with different carrier types or provenance. The following are permanently distinct unless an explicit typed intertwiner is proved: C4_cell admitted boundary-complete 4-simplex carrier used in active homology C4_evt transient five-seat Pachner event-mediator carrier C5_ctx higher context/source carrier feeding C4_evt Required fields: carrier_type domain codomain admission_condition source_provenance dependency_ids internal_claim_bin correspondence_status physical_promotion Rule T1 — no numerical aliasing. Identical local incidence columns do not permit carrier identification. Rule T2 — homology firewall. Only admitted topological cell carriers enter active simplicial homology. Rule T3 — source firewall. Open sources are carrier-typed and are not interchangeable. 7.2 Exact-launch / no-tolerance rule Rule L1. Numerical closeness to a launch amplitude, phase, score, or endpoint is not a theory tolerance and may not authorize topology commit. Rule L2. Numerical root finding may locate a candidate event, but registry execution requires either an exact analytic identity or a certified root proof of the full frozen launch predicate. Rule L3. No post-exposure epsilon may convert HOLD into PASS. 7.3 Scalar-source nonidentifiability and vector-source provenance Rule S1. A scalar support source, source power, total budget, or norm cannot substitute for a signed address-resolved source vector. Minimum predictive source packet: (source_vector, address_basis, orientation, provenance, validity_interval, support_power_receipt) Rule S2. If local source derives from a larger closed carrier, preserve both the local receipt and global exchange parent. Rule S3. Residual extraction is not a constitutive derivation. 7.4 Causal batch custody and no-double-spend Rule C1. Every topology batch uses one frozen pre-batch state. Rule C2. Credits produced by a batch enter only the next frozen scheduler snapshot. Rule C3. Signed address amplitude, not pooled q2q^2, is the routing object. Rule C4. Concurrent packets require an exact commuting/reducing-block receipt; otherwise serialize by independently frozen precedence or HOLD. 7.5 Symmetry and precedence Rule Y1. Exact candidate-exchange symmetry preserving the full pre-event state and law forces HOLD; deterministic covariant selection is forbidden. Rule Y2. A strict unique first-hit time of the complete frozen launch predicate is a lawful parameter-free precedence receipt. Rule Y3. Address order, array order, lexical order, random numerical noise, and post-exposure convenience are invalid precedence sources. 7.6 CRL firewall for internal topology mathematics Exact combinatorics, homology, incidence identities, internal Hodge dynamics, source-interface theorems, and synthetic simulations do not become CRL-2 merely because they are exact or executed computationally. CRL-1 / INTERNAL exact or derived substrate/internal mathematics, algorithms, simulations, governance receipts, and source-interface theorems with no frozen measurement-facing identification. CRL-2a..2d operational / measurement-facing bridge objects under §1. Rule R1. Internal computational execution is not CRL-2c execution. Rule R2. A source-addendum may be exact conditional mathematics while remaining below CRL-2. Rule R3. Only claims with an explicit frozen external/measurement mapping enter CRL-2. 7.7 Correspondence tuple remains mandatory Every external-facing topology statement carries: (internal_claim_bin, correspondence_status, physical_promotion) Allowed tags remain: FORMAL_CORRESPONDENCE OPERATIONAL_CORRESPONDENCE OBSERVABLE_SIGNATURE_CANDIDATE QUANTITATIVE_CORRESPONDENCE_TEST EXPERIMENTALLY_REALIZED_ANALOGUE Correspondence never implies physical identity, causation, derivation, or promotion. 7.8 AUTO_LOCK / AUTO_FREEZE interaction AUTO_LOCK only after carrier type, assumptions, and dependencies are explicit. AUTO_FREEZE immediately on: unproved carrier crossing; post-hoc numerical tolerance; scalar-to-vector source substitution; same-batch credit double-spend; unreceipted symmetry breaking; internal-to-CRL-2 category promotion without bridge/review gates. Repairs remain append-only and versioned. 7.9 Current topology branch ruling The following are internal registry objects, not CRL-2 evidence: C4cellC_4^{cell} mathematics; C4evtC_4^{evt} Pachner/event mathematics; C5ctxC_5^{ctx} source-extension mathematics; exact topology schedulers/selectors; synthetic/geometric Pachner simulations; archive/dissolution history theorems. Any later measurement-facing use enters CRL-2a independently. Physical promotion remains 0.

title: Winding and Response Pre-Registration Packet v1.0
note: CRL-2a proposal · read with errata · Searchable source text imported; claim status is not re-adjudicated.
content: Preserved original proposal with material corrections and unresolved carrier prerequisites. Its title is not evidence of completed preregistration review or a blinded run. Pre-Registration Packet v1.0 Targets: §7.5, §7.22, §7.29 (frozen discriminators/scorers); §7.4 (bench spec) Status: PRE-DATA — must be frozen before any hardware run Physical promotion: 0 throughout. No constitutive law is derived. Supersedes: drafts v0.2, v0.3-addendum, sidecar v0.1 (consolidated here) Two corrections carried from the superseded drafts are recorded in §0. 0. Corrections to superseded drafts 0.1 — Additive source law is not an exclusion. v0.2 flagged Δρ = BJ_B + s_B (§7.24) as possibly excluding burden-dependent formation. §7.25 states nonidentifiability for any scalar law Φ; the additive form is a continuity identity, not a constraint on Φ’s arguments. Retracted. 0.2 — Precision claim was wrong. v0.2 asserted the §7.29 uncertainty budget was “set by the wrong target.” That used single-triple statistics and ignored the 12-runs-per-class averaging already frozen in §7.28. Retracted; corrected budget in §2.4. PART A — WINDING-BURDEN DISCRIMINATOR (§7.22, §7.29) A.1 The receipt-linear family is a line With the verified receipts (I,T,B_k) = (1/4, 3/4, k/2) (§7.20), every receipt-linear cost is ε_k = A + Ck, so f_W(n) = An + (C/2)n(n−1). WBL1 is C = 0; WBQ1 is C = 2A. Hence R_B = 1 + C/A is a continuous readout of C/A, not a binary flag. Report C/A = R_B − 1 ± σ. A.2 New candidate WBX1 (burden-dependent) ε_k = A + Ck + κ·f_W(k), f_W(n) = Σ_{k<n} ε_k, f_W(0)=0 ⟹ f_W(n) = (1+κ)f_W(n−1) + A + C(n−1) [geometric, not polynomial] κ = 0 recovers the receipt-linear family exactly. WBX1 lies outside the §7.20 ansatz but inside the §7.25 admissible class (see §0.1). A.3 False-positive channel in the frozen scorer §7.29 fits two 1-parameter models on 12×E₀ + 12×E₁ (k = 0,1 only). HCB1’s d_i = (2k+1)/4 gives R_B = 3. R_B = 1 + c + κ (c ≡ C/A) ← c and κ enter only as their sum D₂/A = κ(c + κ) ← breaks it; D₂ ≡ ε₂ − 2ε₁ + ε₀ law c κ R_B D₂/A ε₃/A WBL1 0 0 1 0 1 WBQ1 / HCB1 2 0 3 0 7 WBX1 autocatalytic 0 2 3 4 27 WBX1 mixed 1 1 3 2 15 Rows 2 and 3 are numerically identical to the frozen scorer, which would return HCB1 PASS on autocatalytic data. A false-positive channel, not an omitted model. A.4 Parameter-free family falsifier D₂ = 0 identically for every (A,C): I, T are k-independent and B_k is linear in k, so any receipt-linear law is affine in k. A significant D₂ ≠ 0 falsifies WBL1, WBQ1/HCB1 and every intermediate law at once — and measures κ rather than merely rejecting. A.5 Amended measurement set Events: E₀ (0→1), E₁ (1→2), E₂ (2→3), optional E₃ (3→4) Tier 1 family validity D₂ ≟ 0 [parameter-free gate] Tier 2 parameter readout s = R_B − 1; κ = (D₂/A)/s; c = s − κ Tier 3 out-of-sample (E₃) ε₃/A = (1+κ)³ + c(κ²+3κ+3) Three events fix (A,c,κ) exactly; the fourth is fully predicted. PART B — RESPONSE SIDECAR (§7.5, §7.4) B.1 Discrete response-state coordinates All five frozen laws depend on G_p only through its sign. Define (ω_p, g_p) with g_p = 1[G_p > 0]. Lemma 1 (forced ordering). ω_p ≤ g_p, no extra assumption. Proof: ω_p = 1 ⟹ T_p = 1 ∧ L_p = 1 ⟹ ∃e: T_e = 1 ∧ Λ_e^S > 0 ⟹ G_p > 0. Verified by exhaustion over all 16 edge configurations; class (1,0) is empty. ∎ Reachable per-pair: {(0,0),(0,1),(1,1)} → 27 discrete response classes. Lemma 2. (ω_p,g_p) = (0,1) holds on exactly the 4 configurations with pair integrity broken but an integrity-valid edge retaining latent support — i.e. precisely the §4.7 partial-integrity divergence. §7.5’s discriminating class is therefore a formal coordinate, not a hand-picked case. B.2 Gate A — family-validity falsifiers (parameter-free, pre-scoring) A1 Viable completeness V = Σ_p ω_p·θ_p⁺ ≟ 0 zero for R₀,R₂,R₁,R_⊤ (enumerated) and for MTA (Lemma 1) → one event with V>0 falsifies all five A2 Memorylessness same 27-class ⟹ same θ⁺ → falsifies the entire memoryless class, incl. unenumerated laws feasibility ≈ N(N−1)/54 same-class pairs (~10 at N=24) A3 Monotonicity ω ≤ ω′ ⟹ q ≤ q′ §4.8 imposes this to cut 8 viable-complete maps to 4; not derived → violation reopens the 4 excluded maps B.3 Gate B — shell coverage X(ω) = w_H(q) − w_H(ω): w_H(ω) R₀ R₂ R₁ R_⊤ separates 0 0 0 0 3 R_⊤ 1 0 0 2 2 R₁ 2 0 1 1 1 R₂ from R₀ 3 0 0 0 0 nothing Requirement: ≥1 scored event in each of w_H(ω) ∈ {0,1,2}, plus ≥1 event in a (0,1) class (POC-1 vs MTA), before any survival verdict. Class distribution: w_H = 0:8, 1:12, 2:6, 3:1. Shells 1–2 are 18 of 27 — not rare corners. A bench that cannot produce them is mis-specified, not unlucky; check §7.4 channel provisioning rather than re-running. PART C — SCOPE NOTE ON §4.10 (analysis, not amendment) Two observations. Neither closes anything. C.1 — §4.10’s conditional uniqueness does not cover MTA. §4.10 assumes the response is pair-local, q_p = g(ω_p). But ω_p = 0 occurs in both (0,0) and (0,1), where MTA gives q = 0 and q = 1 respectively. MTA is not a function of ω_p alone, so the premise excludes it by construction. §4.10’s uniqueness is uniqueness within the ω-local class and does not reach the one competitor §7.5 keeps live. C.2 — Typed-zero asymmetry. Ω-zero bridge (ω_p=0 ⟹ q_p=0): POC-1 ✓ MTA ✗ on (0,1) DISCRIMINATES G-zero bridge (g_p=0 ⟹ q_p=0): POC-1 ✓ MTA ✓ DOES NOT “Zero source ⟹ zero gate” therefore has discriminating content only once receipt primacy is already fixed. C.3 — Explicitly not new. The equivalence of the Ω-zero rule with closure economy is already stated in §4.11 (“…is equivalent to the already isolated zero-source-silence/closure-economy principle and is not independent evidence”). C.1 and C.2 sharpen §4.10’s scope; they do not improve on §4.11. C.4 — §7.6 status: UNRESOLVED, custodian ruling required. Part C proposes no new response law and adds no member to the frozen equivalence family. It argues the family fails to separate POC-1 from MTA — a claim about the family. Whether that counts as a “reformulation” under the §7.6 freeze is a custodian judgement. Part C is held pending that ruling. Parts A and B do not depend on it. PART D — FROZEN DECISION RULES WINDING (Part A) D₂ ≈ 0 → receipt-linear retained; report C/A = R_B − 1 ± σ D₂ ≠ 0 significantly → receipt-linear REJECTED; report (c,κ) per Tier 2 Tier 3 disagrees → extended family REJECTED; return to §7.24 RESPONSE (Part B) A1 violated → all five frozen laws REJECTED A2 violated → memoryless response class REJECTED A3 violated → §4.8 monotonicity REJECTED; reopen 4 maps Gate B unmet → NO-SCORE (explicitly NOT a model tie) A passed, B met → proceed to §7.5 exact-endpoint scoring, unchanged No post-hoc selection among (c,κ) or among response laws; all are outputs. Invalidation remains outcome-independent and append-only per §7.28. PART E — COST AND PRECISION Acquisition. §7.28 freezes 24 runs in six blocks. Matched E₂ statistics → 36 runs in eight blocks (+50% time) plus n=2 flux-bias state preparation. No new apparatus. Precision (null = HCB1/WBQ1, ε = (1,3,5)A): n/class r σ(D₂)/A 3σ on |D₂/A| min κ detectable 12 20% 0.455 1.364 0.54 12 10% 0.227 0.682 0.30 12 5% 0.114 0.341 0.16 36 10% 0.131 0.394 0.18 At the existing §7.29 baseline (n=12, r=10%) D₂ detects κ ≈ 0.3 at 3σ. No thermometry re-spec required. Binding constraint is acquisition count. Scorer integration. Keep D₂ as a separate pre-fit gate, not a third AICc model: D₂ = 0 is a prediction shared by PLB1 and HCB1, so it tests their common assumption rather than discriminating. AICc small-sample correction at n=36 is +0.118 (k=1) / +0.364 (k=2), so the |ΔAICc| ≥ 10 threshold transfers unchanged. PART F — WHAT THIS DOES NOT CLAIM D₂, R_B, V, X and the 27-class coordinates are dimensionless internal receipts. No physical identification is made; promotion to laboratory observables rests entirely on the §7.26/§7.27 bridges, which remain stated CRL-2 assumptions. No constitutive law is derived. Part A widens the candidate space and closes a false-positive channel; Part B tests shared assumptions and fixes a coverage gap; Part C is scope analysis held pending a §7.6 ruling. The §8.3 highest open problem is untouched. Physical promotion remains 0.

note: Corrections to the v1.0 proposal · Searchable source text imported; claim status is not re-adjudicated.
content: Leakage ambiguity, carrier availability, coverage, and AICc wording corrections. The complete bridge packet still requires non-constructor review. Packet v1.1 — Errata to v1.0 Produced by an adversarial pass on my own v1.0. Three defects found, one material. Physical promotion: 0. E.1 — MATERIAL. D₂ ≠ 0 is not an unambiguous autocatalysis signal v1.0 Part E stated: “D₂ = 0 is a prediction shared by PLB1 and HCB1.” This is false in general. HCB1: ε_k = κ_H·d_k , d_k = (2k+1)/4 = 1/4, 3/4, 5/4 D₂ = κ_H(5/4 − 6/4 + 1/4) = 0 EXACT, unconditional PLB1: ε_k = κ_P·Λ_k , Λ_k = independently RETURNED measured leakage D₂ = κ_P(Λ₂ − 2Λ₁ + Λ₀) = 0 only if measured leakage is stationary or affine in k §7.22 assumes “matched” / “stationary” leakage; it does not guarantee it, and §7.23 requires Λ to be returned by a separate provider precisely because it is not derivable from ε. So D₂ ≠ 0 is consistent with either autocatalytic winding source, κ ≠ 0; or non-stationary measured leakage under PLB1. Required correction to Part A.5. The amended set must return Λ₂ alongside ε₂. Disambiguation rule: D₂(ε) ≈ 0 → receipt-linear family retained D₂(ε) ≠ 0 AND D₂(Λ) ≈ 0 → autocatalysis (κ ≠ 0) D₂(ε) ≠ 0 AND D₂(Λ) ≠ 0 → AMBIGUOUS. Test PLB1 proportionality: compare D₂(ε)/D₂(Λ) against κ_P from the Tier-2 fit. Mismatch → autocatalysis; match → non-stationary leakage. This is required, not optional. Without Λ₂ the Tier-1 gate cannot be interpreted. The §7.23 custody separation must be preserved: the Λ provider still receives no burden values and no bridge labels. E.2 — MATERIAL. Part A understates its dependency v1.0 framed the cost of E₂ as scheduling (+50% runs, eight blocks). That is the bench cost. It omits the carrier cost. §7.13 states the constructed n = 2 carrier “is topologically/Hodge stable but has not yet passed the full nonlinear matter persistence, burden, boundary, scale, transport, or coherence tests.” And E₂ (2→3) requires an n = 3 endpoint which is not constructed anywhere in the source. Corrected framing. Part A is contingent on prior construction and validation of the n = 2 and n = 3 carriers — itself open work under §7.12–§7.13 — not merely on bench scheduling. This is the largest practical risk in the packet and v1.0 did not state it. Part A should be read as: conditional on carrier availability, here is the discriminator. If the carriers do not validate, Part A’s false-positive finding (§A.3) still stands as a known limitation of the current 2-class scorer, even though the proposed remedy is unavailable. E.3 — MINOR. Gate B table omits MTA without saying so X(ω) = w_H(q) − w_H(ω) is undefined for MTA, which is a function of g, not ω. The v1.0 table lists only R₀, R₂, R₁, R_⊤. MTA is separated by the required (0,1)-class event, which Part B does mandate — but the omission should be explicit rather than implicit. E.4 — WORDING. AICc threshold v1.0: “the |ΔAICc| ≥ 10 threshold transfers unchanged.” Imprecise. The small-sample correction is indeed small (+0.118 at k=1, +0.364 at k=2, n=36), but ΔAIC grows roughly linearly in n when one model is genuinely better. Correct statement: threshold semantics unchanged; discriminating power increases with n. E.5 — Checks that passed Lemma 1 (ω_p ≤ g_p) re-verified by exhaustion; class (1,0) empty ε_k indexing ε₀ = E₀ (0→1), matches §7.17 and §7.29 HCB1 d_k = (2k+1)/4 → (1,3,5) null used in the precision table X-table entries R₂ at w_H=2 → X=1; R₁ at w_H=1 → X=2 A1 informativeness fires only when all five fail the same way; strictly more informative than the POC-1 verdict C.1 quotation §4.10 does explicitly assume q_p = g(ω_p) E.6 — Running correction count Across five rounds this makes five corrections to my own claims: additive source law wrongly flagged as an exclusion (v0.2 → v0.3) precision budget wrongly called binding (v0.2 → v0.3) F2 stated in a form that could never fire (v0.2 → v0.3) D₂ wrongly called a shared PLB1/HCB1 null (v1.0 → v1.1) — material Part A dependency on unvalidated n=2/n=3 carriers omitted (v1.0 → v1.1) — material Two of the five are material and both were found only on deliberate adversarial review, not during construction. That ratio is the relevant signal about how much independent checking the rest of the packet still needs.

The adapter preserves measured external evaluate/act states and interventions but explicitly refuses to identify the four-tank state with the four-vertex burden carrier or to manufacture the six-edge source G_E. Because neither cross-carrier map is presently derived, CG_E scoring is held rather than executed. This is a source-identification and preregistration milestone, not empirical validation. The internal lineage-prime scale protocol has also been extended through Hamming-changing source/renewal/sink receipts and genuine additive winding mergers during Pachner/regional scale transitions. Source-complete single-source conjugate histories preserve lineage-prime winding through the declared scale maps. Merger cancellation, composite winding, and merger-generated net |n|=1 remain single-valued while preserving merger ancestry. Missing maps, open exclusion, absorbing transport, and incomplete merger receipts remain fail-closed. Five-cell regional fixtures remain derived, global recurrence is not required, and physical promotion remains zero. theorem/UD_MIXED_HAMMING_MERGER_SCALE_COMPOSITION_THEOREM_v0.1.mdUD Mixed Hamming/Merger Scale Composition Theorem v0.1 Status: EXACT_CONDITIONAL ON DECLARED RECEIPTS/MAPS Physical promotion: 0 On a source-complete lineage history, the following operations compose without ambiguity: the integer Hamming budget w_plus=w_bar+mu_Theta, with mu_Theta=ind(F) or its receipt-complete source/sink/renewal count form; relative matching winding between open-system boundaries; additive winding composition at a genuine merger; permanent loss of lineage-prime status after any genuine multi-predecessor merger; explicit Pachner/regional local-cell maps with scale-frame provenance removed; reflecting/periodic boundary provenance removal; closure/integrity fail-closed handling. Consequently a history can change Hamming shell, merge, cancel or compound winding, and move through declared scale maps while retaining a single-valued winding and exact ancestry. In particular, a merger yielding net |n|=1 remains non-lineage-prime. Geometric gluing alone creates no merger. Scale transformations create no winding by themselves. No global spectral recurrence is required. no_go/UD_EXTERNAL_FOUR_STATE_TO_CG_EDGE_SOURCE_NO_GO_v0.1.mdUD External Four-State to CG_E Source Mapping No-Go v0.1 Status: LOCKED_NO_GO under current source information Physical promotion: 0 InTaSet provides a physical four-tank state and physical input/control telemetry. Current UD burden uses a separately typed four-vertex burden carrier, while the frozen CG_E bridge requires a six-edge source vector before applying the exact edge-to-vertex intertwiner C. Equal dimension 4 = 4 establishes no carrier identity, and the available InTaSet metadata supplies no theorem mapping testbed inputs to the six edges of a tetrahedron. Therefore a lawful adapter cannot compute G_E, C G_E, or a UD burden residual from InTaSet solely from the presently available metadata. Blocked in this scope: treating four tank levels as four vertex burdens by cardinality; selecting six pairwise functions of tank levels/inputs because they improve a held-out burden score; solving backward from external state transitions to a six-edge G_E and then claiming a prediction; scoring kappa before an independently derived cross-carrier map exists. Reopen condition: independently sourced, pretarget definitions of both external-state→burden and external-input/history→six-edge-source maps. protocol/UD_INTASET_FOUR_STATE_TYPED_ADAPTER_PREREG_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet Four-State Typed Adapter Preregistration v0.1 Status: PRE-DATA FREEZE / SOURCE IDENTIFIED / BYTES NOT ACQUIRED Physical promotion: 0 Source InTaSet, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17652851, is independently published real-time telemetry from a physical interconnected quadruple-tank testbed. The four-tank M1/M2 training/testing workbooks are the selected source candidates. Frozen adapter rule A dataset-specific configuration must name, from source documentation or authenticated workbook headers: exactly one time column; exactly four measured state columns; one or more independently measured/commanded intervention-input columns; the state/input temporal alignment convention; source file integrity digest and dataset/session identity. The adapter emits measured external transitions (x_eval, u_eval, x_act) only. It performs no system identification, no fitted background subtraction, no target-aware feature selection, and no header guessing. Hard typing firewall The external four-tank vector is not UD vertex burden merely because both have four components. The physical input vector is not the UD six-edge source G_E. Therefore the frozen CG_E kappa scorer must return/retain: HOLD_NO_TYPED_CROSS_CARRIER_MAPS until both are independently supplied: an explicit typed map external_state -> V_B or a justified burden observable on the external carrier; an explicit source-side map external intervention/history -> G_E in R^6 derived without using the burden target. No dimension/cardinality matching, regression against x_act, or target-aware inverse problem may be used to manufacture either map. Acquisition gate At this release, Zenodo/GitHub source identity and file inventory are independently verified, but archive bytes are not locally acquired by the current runtime. The protocol is therefore frozen before workbook inspection or scoring. protocol/UD_MIXED_HAMMING_MERGER_MULTISCALE_PROTOCOL_v0.1.mdUD Mixed Hamming-Changing Merger Multi-Scale Protocol v0.1 Status: PRETARGET INTERNAL FIXTURE PROTOCOL Physical promotion: 0 This protocol combines the already frozen relative-winding, additive merger, lineage-prime, Hamming-budget, boundary-provenance, and scale-map laws. It tests composition across explicit source, renewal, merger, boundary, Pachner/regional scale, and sink receipts. Exact state Each live lineage carries (source_roots, merger_ancestry, lineage_prime, n, w_H, sigma_intrinsic, chi, carrier, local_cell). Hamming-changing receipts For a receipted open event with current pre-event shell weight w_bar, use the existing integer budget mu_Theta = N_sink - N_src - N_ren + N_overlap = ind(F) and update w_plus = w_bar + mu_Theta, requiring 0 <= w_plus <= 3. Source/sink/renewal/merger events are relative boundaries and do not themselves fabricate matching-exchange winding. Exchange intervals carry the already derived relative/closed matching winding increments. Merger law For source-complete predecessor set P_j, n_out = sum_i n_i. A genuine multi-predecessor merger permanently sets lineage-prime to 0. Equal net winding never erases merger ancestry. Scale/boundary law Scale maps do not change integer winding. Known scale/boundary frame parity is divided out before intrinsic framing is tested. Missing maps, predecessor receipts, re-entry seeds, closure receipts, or merger framing agreement return HOLD; absorbing transport REJECTS. No global Hodge recurrence is required. Regional five-cell fixtures are DERIVED and cannot select canonical AW5 geometry.

This split invariance does not remove the pump-flow calibration requirement. report/UD_INTASET_M1M2_AND_PUMP_CALIBRATION_SOURCE_AUDIT_REPORT_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet M1/M2 and Pump Calibration Source Audit Report v0.1 Executive ruling Two source-side gaps were audited in parallel. Neither is closed numerically by the currently public source-authored corpus. The common QTP routing family is source-authored and exact, but InTaSet M1 / M2 are not publicly cross-walked to explicit (gamma_1,gamma_2) values in the searched sources. The physical Lehigh/Bitlismen platform is pump-actuated and reconfigurable, but no searched public source provides the InTaSet physical pump command/speed -> delivered-flow calibration needed to transform workbook commands into Delta q. No response fitting was used to repair either source gap. What closed The source-authored QTP support topology is Pump 1 -> Tanks 1 and 4; Pump 2 -> Tanks 2 and 3. Therefore, for source-certified valve splits and delivered pump-flow changes, RQTP(γ1,γ2)=(γ100γ201−γ21−γ10) R_{QTP}(\gamma_1,\gamma_2)= \begin{pmatrix} \gamma_1&0\\ 0&\gamma_2\\ 0&1-\gamma_2\\ 1-\gamma_1&0 \end{pmatrix} and GEext=12CTP⊥RQTPΔq G_E^{ext}=\frac12C^TP_\perp R_{QTP}\Delta q are frozen exactly. New exact split-invariant result In edge order (12,13,14,23,24,34), G14=Δq1−Δq24,G23=−G14. G_{14}=\frac{\Delta q_1-\Delta q_2}{4}, \qquad G_{23}=-G_{14}. This subchannel does not depend on gamma_1 or gamma_2. That is a genuine source simplification: once physical delivered pump-flow changes are known, one exact six-edge contrast component can be computed without knowing the valve split configuration. It does not authorize use of raw pump commands as physical flows. M1/M2 source audit The authenticated uploaded archive contains four 4T M1/M2 training/testing workbooks and no accompanying configuration sheet. Workbook metadata exposes no author-authored valve split or pump routing table. The public InTaSet repository states that four testbed configurations exist but does not define M1/M2 through a gamma crosswalk on the searched public surface. A separate overlapping Lehigh QTP publication gives numerical-model MP and NMP parameter examples. Those are useful QTP references but are not an InTaSet configuration receipt. Ruling M1 -> MP, M2 -> NMP, either reverse assignment, and direct gamma-number assignment remain source-blocked. Pump calibration source audit The physical platform is a custom/reconfigurable Bitlismen quadruple-tank installation at Lehigh. Public manufacturer material states that the platform has two independently controlled pumps, programmable tank flow, solenoid-controlled pump inlets, pressure-sensor tank levels, and modifiable couplings. No searched public source gives the calibration needed to evaluate qi=Φi(ui,ζ;c) q_i=\Phi_i(u_i,\zeta;c) from the InTaSet Pump i fields. The Water Research QTP equations contain linear k_i u_i terms in the numerical model. These coefficients are not a physical calibration receipt for the custom Lehigh hardware. Ruling Physical Delta q_i remains source-blocked from raw InTaSet Pump 1/2 commands. Governance consequences AUTO_LOCK common QTP support topology; parametric QTP flow-incidence family; exact six-edge source family conditional on delivered flow; split-invariant G14=-G23 theorem. AUTO_FREEZE assigning InTaSet M1/M2 to MP/NMP without a new source receipt; reusing numerical-model gamma_i or k_i as physical InTaSet coefficients; backsolving pump calibration or valve splits from tank-level outcomes and relabeling the result as source-authored. Physical status PHYSICAL PROMOTION=0 \boxed{\text{PHYSICAL PROMOTION}=0} The remaining source-side bridge is now sharply localized to two receipts: configuration-specific valve splitting and physical pump-flow calibration. The split-invariant edge theorem reduces the first dependency for one exact subchannel, but not the second. manuscript/UD_JOP_v2.40_INTASET_M1M2_AND_PUMP_CALIBRATION_ADDENDUM_v0.1.mdJOP v2.40 Addendum — InTaSet Source-Side Configuration and Pump-Flow Audit External QTP source family For the source-authored quadruple-tank routing family, Pump 1 feeds Tanks 1 and 4 and Pump 2 feeds Tanks 2 and 3. With delivered pump-flow changes a=Delta q_1, b=Delta q_2, the flow-incidence family is RQTP=(γ100γ201−γ21−γ10), R_{QTP}= \begin{pmatrix} \gamma_1&0\\ 0&\gamma_2\\ 0&1-\gamma_2\\ 1-\gamma_1&0 \end{pmatrix}, and the pre-registered edge-source lift is GEext=12CTP⊥RQTP(ab). G_E^{ext}=\frac12C^TP_\perp R_{QTP}\binom{a}{b}. A new exact simplification is G14=a−b4,G23=−a−b4, G_{14}=\frac{a-b}{4},\qquad G_{23}=-\frac{a-b}{4}, which is invariant under both valve split parameters. Source limitations The authenticated InTaSet archive and searched public author/manufacturer sources do not currently provide an explicit M1/M2-to-(gamma_1,gamma_2) crosswalk or a physical Pump-command-to-delivered-flow calibration. Numerical QTP coefficients appearing in a separate modeling case are not promoted to physical InTaSet coefficients. Accordingly the full physical numeric edge-source stream remains HOLD. The split-invariant edge subchannel is exact once delivered pump-flow changes are independently source-certified. No tank-response outcome was used to repair the missing source metadata. Physical promotion remains zero. theorem/UD_INTASET_COMMAND_TO_SIX_EDGE_SOURCE_FAMILY_THEOREM_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet Command-to-Six-Edge Source Family Theorem v0.1 Status DERIVED / EXACT CONDITIONAL Physical promotion: 0 Source-bound objects For one source-authenticated physical configuration c, let RQTP(γ1(c),γ2(c))=(γ100γ201−γ21−γ10). R_{QTP}(\gamma_1^{(c)},\gamma_2^{(c)})= \begin{pmatrix} \gamma_1&0\\ 0&\gamma_2\\ 0&1-\gamma_2\\ 1-\gamma_1&0 \end{pmatrix}. Let the actual delivered pump-flow change be Δq=(ab)=(Δq1Δq2). \Delta q=\binom{a}{b}=\binom{\Delta q_1}{\Delta q_2}. The project-locked edge-to-vertex contrast intertwiner is C=P_perp |B_1|, and the target-blind minimum-norm source lift is GEext=12CTP⊥RQTPΔq. G_E^{ext}=\frac12 C^T P_\perp R_{QTP}\Delta q. Use edge order (12,13,14,23,24,34). (12,13,14,23,24,34). Exact coordinates G12=(2γ1−1)a+(2γ2−1)b4, G_{12}=\frac{(2\gamma_1-1)a+(2\gamma_2-1)b}{4}, G13=(2γ1−1)a+(1−2γ2)b4, G_{13}=\frac{(2\gamma_1-1)a+(1-2\gamma_2)b}{4}, G14=a−b4,G23=−a+b4, G_{14}=\frac{a-b}{4}, \qquad G_{23}=\frac{-a+b}{4}, G24=(1−2γ1)a+(2γ2−1)b4, G_{24}=\frac{(1-2\gamma_1)a+(2\gamma_2-1)b}{4}, G34=(1−2γ1)a+(1−2γ2)b4. G_{34}=\frac{(1-2\gamma_1)a+(1-2\gamma_2)b}{4}. Hence the opposite-edge aggregate vanishes identically: G12+G34=G13+G24=G14+G23=0. G_{12}+G_{34}=G_{13}+G_{24}=G_{14}+G_{23}=0. Moreover CGEext=P⊥RQTPΔq. CG_E^{ext}=P_\perp R_{QTP}\Delta q. Command-domain form In the physical testbed, the workbook’s Pump 1/2 fields are control commands, not source-certified delivered flow measurements. Therefore introduce source-certified pump calibration functions qi=Φi(ui,ζ;c), q_i=\Phi_i(u_i,\zeta;c), where zeta contains any hydraulic/drive state required by the calibration. Then Δqi=Φi(uiact,ζact;c)−Φi(uieval,ζeval;c). \Delta q_i=\Phi_i(u_i^{act},\zeta^{act};c)-\Phi_i(u_i^{eval},\zeta^{eval};c). Only after Phi_i is source-bound may the physical numeric G_E^{ext} stream be generated. A linear specialization Δqi=kiΔui \Delta q_i=k_i\Delta u_i is permitted only if the physical testbed itself supplies that calibration. The numerical-QTP model coefficients k_i are not automatically physical InTaSet pump gains. Ruling The symbolic source family is closed. The physical numeric stream is HOLD until both the configuration-specific valve splits and physical command-to-flow calibration are source-bound. theorem/UD_INTASET_SPLIT_INVARIANT_EDGE_SUBCHANNEL_THEOREM_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet Split-Invariant Edge Subchannel Theorem v0.1 Status DERIVED / EXACT conditional only on source-certified delivered pump-flow changes. Physical promotion: 0 For the standard source-authored QTP family s=RQTP(γ1,γ2)(ab), s=R_{QTP}(\gamma_1,\gamma_2)\binom{a}{b}, the external six-edge source satisfies G14=a−b4,G23=−a−b4. G_{14}=\frac{a-b}{4}, \qquad G_{23}=-\frac{a-b}{4}. Therefore ∂G14∂γ1=∂G14∂γ2=∂G23∂γ1=∂G23∂γ2=0. \frac{\partial G_{14}}{\partial\gamma_1} =\frac{\partial G_{14}}{\partial\gamma_2} =\frac{\partial G_{23}}{\partial\gamma_1} =\frac{\partial G_{23}}{\partial\gamma_2}=0. Meaning The antisymmetric edge component G14−G23=a−b2 G_{14}-G_{23}=\frac{a-b}{2} is invariant to the unknown valve-split fractions. It measures only the contrast between the two delivered pump-flow changes. Limitation This does not remove the pump calibration gap. With workbook commands u_1,u_2, the quantity a-b is not source-known until the physical map from command/speed to delivered flow is authenticated. Accordingly this theorem narrows the source gap from (gamma_1,gamma_2,pump calibration) to pump calibration for one exact subchannel, but it does not authorize a numeric physical source stream from raw Pump 1/2 commands. no_go/UD_INTASET_M1_M2_CONFIGURATION_BINDING_SOURCE_NO_GO_v0.2.mdUD InTaSet M1/M2 Configuration Binding Source No-Go v0.2 Status SOURCE_BLOCKED / AUTO_FREEZE Scope: searched public author/manufacturer corpus as of 2026-09-08. Physical promotion: 0 Question Can InTaSet labels M1 and M2 be source-authoredly assigned to explicit QTP valve settings (gamma_1,gamma_2) or to the separate numerical-QTP MP/NMP examples? Result No source-authored crosswalk was found in: the authenticated uploaded InTaSet archive and 4T workbook metadata; the public InTaSet GitHub repository/README surface; the accessible EWRI 2026 InTaSet article metadata/text; overlapping Lehigh QTP publications examined; public Lehigh lab/project pages examined; Bitlismen public product/installation materials examined. The Water Research QTP paper supplies numerical-model MP/NMP parameter examples, but it does not state that InTaSet M1 or M2 are those examples. AUTO_FREEZE The following substitutions are prohibited absent a new source receipt: M1≡MP,M2≡NMP, M1\equiv MP, \qquad M2\equiv NMP, or the reverse, and direct assignment of (γ1,γ2)=(0.7,0.6) (\gamma_1,\gamma_2)=(0.7,0.6) or (γ1,γ2)=(0.48,0.44) (\gamma_1,\gamma_2)=(0.48,0.44) to either InTaSet configuration. No state-response fitting may be used to repair this source-side gap and then relabeled as a source derivation. no_go/UD_INTASET_PHYSICAL_PUMP_COMMAND_TO_FLOW_CALIBRATION_NO_GO_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet Physical Pump Command-to-Flow Calibration No-Go v0.1 Status SOURCE_BLOCKED / AUTO_FREEZE Scope: searched public author/manufacturer corpus as of 2026-09-08. Physical promotion: 0 Required bridge The six-edge source theorem requires delivered pump-flow changes Δqi. \Delta q_i. The InTaSet 4T sheets provide Pump 1 and Pump 2 command channels, not a source-certified delivered-flow channel. The most general lawful calibration receipt is qi=Φi(ui,ζ;c), q_i=\Phi_i(u_i,\zeta;c), with calibration state zeta and configuration c explicitly sourced. Search result The public Lehigh/Bitlismen materials confirm a custom/reconfigurable quadruple-tank platform, two independently controlled pumps, programmable flow, solenoid inlet control, pressure-sensor tank measurements, and modifiable couplings. The searched public material does not publish a numeric physical pump command/speed-to-delivered-flow curve or a machine-readable calibration table for the InTaSet runs. The overlapping Water Research article contains k_i coefficients for a numerical QTP model and separately reports validation on physical laboratory hardware. That source distinction prevents promotion of the numerical k_i values to physical InTaSet calibration coefficients. AUTO_FREEZE Do not use Δqi=kiΔui \Delta q_i=k_i\Delta u_i with numerical-model k_i as if it were a source-authenticated physical calibration. Do not estimate Phi_i from InTaSet tank-level responses and then call the fitted map a pre-outcome source receipt. Ruling raw Pump 1/2 command changes⇏physical Δqi \boxed{ \text{raw Pump 1/2 command changes} \not\Rightarrow \text{physical }\Delta q_i } under the currently sourced corpus. protocol/UD_INTASET_SOURCE_SIDE_CLOSURE_PROTOCOL_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet Source-Side Closure Protocol v0.1 Objective Close the remaining physical source-side blockers without touching tank-response outcomes. Required new receipts At least one source-authored artifact must provide, per InTaSet configuration: gamma_1, gamma_2 or an equivalent valve/pump split matrix; a pump command/speed -> delivered-flow calibration Phi_i, or a directly measured pump-flow channel; configuration identity tying the receipt to the M1/M2 workbook records; units and sign convention; acquisition/configuration date or other version identity sufficient to rule out mismatch. Zero-touch execution order hash and archive the new receipt; bind M1/M2 config IDs before reading tank outcomes; bind Phi_i or measured flow channels; derive Delta q from Pump 1/2 commands or direct flow; compute G_E_ext with the frozen theorem; hash the pre-outcome source stream; only then open a fresh unexposed outcome corpus for external testing. Determine whether independently measurable four-tank observables can uniquely identify a map into the four-vertex UD burden carrier. Main result: The public archive is source-identified, but binary retrieval is blocked in this runtime. No configuration-specific R_act^(c) is fabricated. Even the strongest natural external stock candidates (hydrostatic pressure, calibrated volume, water mass) do not uniquely identify the UD burden contrast map. Under linearity, total-stock preservation, and full S4 covariance, the entire family remains L_alpha = P0 + alpha P_perp; positivity only restricts -1/3 <= alpha <= 1. report/UD_INTASET_ACQUISITION_AND_EXTERNAL_BURDEN_REPORT_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet Acquisition and External Burden Audit Report v0.1 Status PARTIAL_PASS__ACQUISITION_RUNTIME_BLOCKED__CORRESPONDENCE_NO_GO Physical promotion: 0. Vector 1 — acquisition The public InTaSet source is independently identified at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17652851 and the authors’ GitHub repository. The Zenodo record publishes InTaSet.zip with MD5 0fe80940a3c9520e665b769f4b8d5ab8 and an archive preview exposing the four 4T M1/M2 training/testing workbooks. Vector 2 — external burden observable search The best physically meaningful stock candidates are calibrated tank volume or water mass. They improve typing relative to raw level but do not supply a unique map to UD burden. The exact four-dimensional symmetry calculation leaves L_alpha=P0+alpha P_perp; positivity narrows but does not eliminate the free alpha. Hydrostatic pressure is a level-equivalent intensive state; total mass determines only the uniform mode; hydraulic potential energy is nonlinear; flows live on transport/intervention carriers. Therefore the external physical-correspondence no-go is retained and strengthened. Net frontier external six-edge source lift: exact conditional once real R_act^(c) is source-bound; InTaSet binary/configuration receipt: operationally blocked in this runtime; external state -> UD burden contrast: nonidentifiable from currently available conserved observables; physical promotion: 0. manuscript/UD_JOP_v2.40_INTASET_ACQUISITION_AND_EXTERNAL_BURDEN_NO_GO_ADDENDUM_v0.1.mdManuscript Addendum — InTaSet Acquisition Gate and External Burden Correspondence A new external source audit considered the InTaSet physical quadruple-tank dataset as a potential intervention-facing correspondence carrier. The published archive and four 4T system-identification workbooks are independently source-identified, but archive bytes were not retrievable in the current execution runtime. No configuration-specific actuator incidence was inferred from generic quadruple-tank literature; the external six-edge source lift remains exact conditional on a future authenticated R_act^(c) receipt. Separately, conservation-based physical observables were audited as possible four-component burden carriers. Calibrated volume and water mass provide legitimate external extensive stocks, but do not uniquely identify the UD burden contrast carrier. Under linearity, total-stock preservation and full permutation covariance, the complete correspondence family remains L_alpha=P0+alpha P_perp, with positivity restricting but not selecting alpha. Thus a physical carrier/normalization theorem remains required before an external four-tank state can be identified with UD burden. These results are source and correspondence audits only. No post-act InTaSet outcome was scored and physical promotion remains zero. theorem/UD_EXTERNAL_STOCK_MAP_COMMUTANT_THEOREM_v0.1.mdTheorem — External Four-Stock to UD Burden Commutant v0.1 Let m in R^4 be a calibrated four-component extensive stock vector (for example water volume or water mass), and let b = L m be a proposed linear map to the four-vertex UD burden carrier. Assume: linearity; total-stock preservation: 1^T L = 1^T; full S4 covariance: L P = P L for every four-vertex permutation matrix P. Then the commutant of the permutation representation is span{I,J} and the total-preservation constraint leaves exactly L_alpha = P0 + alpha P_perp where P0 = J/4, P_perp = I - J/4. Equivalently, L_alpha = alpha I + (1-alpha)J/4. If componentwise positivity is also imposed, the allowable range is -1/3 <= alpha <= 1. Therefore conservation, positivity, and even the deliberately strong full-S4 covariance assumption do not uniquely identify the burden contrast map. Two explicit distinct admissible maps are L_1 = I and L_0 = P0. Classification: EXACT INTERNAL MATHEMATICS / EXTERNAL-CORRESPONDENCE NO-GO SUPPORT. no_go/UD_EXTERNAL_BURDEN_OBSERVABLE_ALPHA_NONIDENTIFIABILITY_NO_GO_v0.1.mdNo-Go — External Burden-Like Observables Do Not Fix alpha v0.1 Observables audited pressure-sensor / hydrostatic pressure state; tank level; calibrated volume V_i = A_i h_i; water mass m_i = rho A_i h_i; total water stock; hydraulic potential-energy candidates; actuator/flow variables. Ruling Pressure, volume, and water mass are source-calibrated re-expressions of the same four tank-state coordinates. Volume/mass adds physical units and an extensive interpretation, but conservation fixes only the uniform total-stock mode. Under the strongest symmetry assumptions the correspondence still has the continuous family L_alpha = P0 + alpha P_perp. Total stock fixes the coefficient of P0; it does not fix alpha on the three-dimensional contrast sector. Hydraulic pressure is not an independent conserved stock. Potential energy is nonlinear and requires a new constitutive carrier map. Pump/inter-tank flows are intervention/transport quantities rather than the vertex stock itself. The actual InTaSet platform is reconfigurable and its hydraulic coupling is not the complete-graph K4 burden mixing carrier. Requiring an intertwiner between external hydraulic dynamics and the UD K4 burden operator would therefore be an additional physical carrier theorem, not a consequence of conservation. AUTO_FREEZE tank level = UD burden by equal dimension; water mass = UD burden by shared conservation language; alpha = 1 because identity is convenient; fitting alpha from post-act outcomes and reporting it as a derivation. Reopen condition A source-complete, target-blind carrier theorem must independently identify the external contrast modes with the UD burden contrast carrier and fix their normalization/transformation law. protocol/UD_INTASET_CONFIGURATION_RECEIPT_BINDING_PROTOCOL_v0.1.mdUD InTaSet Configuration Receipt Binding Protocol v0.1 Status: PREOUTCOME FREEZE Physical promotion: 0 Objective Populate the configuration-specific actuator incidence R_act^(c) before any post-act state columns are inspected. Extract only archive metadata and workbook schema/header information initially. Bind one configuration (4T-M1 or 4T-M2) by an independently sourced actuator-to-tank incidence receipt. Construct R_act^(c) only from actuator topology/valve/pump metadata available before outcome scoring. Freeze the matrix and source hashes. Construct pretarget six-edge source using G_E_ext = (1/2) C^T P_perp R_act^(c) Delta q. Only after steps 1-8 may post-act tank-state columns be opened for any correspondence experiment. Fail-closed rules Return HOLD_NO_CONFIGURATION_RECEIPT if the source does not identify the actuator-to-tank distribution. Return HOLD_BINARY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE if archive bytes cannot be acquired or authenticated. No generic textbook quadruple-tank topology may silently substitute for the actual InTaSet configuration. Reference-only family If — and only if — a configuration receipt independently certifies the classical diagonal two-pump split with parameters gamma_1,gamma_2, a compatible actuator-incidence matrix in tank order (T1,T2,T3,T4) is R_act = [[gamma_1, 0], [0, gamma_2], [0, 1-gamma_2], [1-gamma_1, 0]] This formula is REFERENCE_ONLY and is not assigned to InTaSet M1 or M2 by this release.

AUTO_FREEZE synthetic or identity updates used to claim C3_7 persistence; using Hodge or burden subdynamics as the complete defect law; B_e = S_perp from quadratic equivariance alone; choosing among the nine uniform invariants after a downstream target is seen. manuscript/UD_JOP_v2.40_C3_7_EVOLUTION_AND_QUADRATIC_BURDEN_ADDENDUM_v0.1.mdManuscript Addendum — C3_7 Source Gate and Quadratic Burden Intertwiners The current matter-candidate taxonomy does not yet define a source-complete evolution of the full defect label X=(P,n,chi,sigma,Phi_int). Accordingly, recurrence, boundary, scale, and perturbation stability cannot be claimed from the presently sourced Hodge-chain or vertex-burden subdynamics alone. Separately, representation theory shows that nonlinear chain-to-burden coupling is not excluded by the previously established linear no-go. For the 14-dimensional nonharmonic chain carrier, Sym2(C⊥)≅9𝟏⊕4𝟏′⊕10𝟐⊕14𝟑⊕10𝟑′, \operatorname{Sym}^2(C_\perp) \cong9\mathbf1\oplus4\mathbf1'\oplus10\mathbf2\oplus14\mathbf3\oplus10\mathbf3', and hence the quadratic S4-equivariant map space into the four-vertex burden carrier has dimension 23, including nine independent uniform-output channels. The zero-parameter map Q_iso(c)=||c||^2 1_4/4 is a mathematically exact candidate under an additional support-preserving isotropy rule, but no current source identifies it with the native matter burden B_e. Physical promotion remains zero. theorem/UD_QUADRATIC_S4_HODGE_TO_BURDEN_CLASSIFICATION_THEOREM_v0.1.mdQuadratic S4 Hodge-to-Burden Classification Theorem v0.1 Status: EXACT_INTERNAL Carrier: single filled tetrahedron, nonharmonic real chain carrier Physical promotion: 0 Source-bound representations The previously classified nonharmonic chain representation is C⊥≅2𝟑⊕2𝟑′⊕2𝟏′. C_\perp\cong 2\,\mathbf 3\oplus2\,\mathbf 3'\oplus2\,\mathbf 1'. The four-vertex burden carrier is VB≅𝟏⊕𝟑. V_B\cong\mathbf1\oplus\mathbf3. For S4 conjugacy classes ordered as e,(12),(12)(34),(123),(1234), e,(12),(12)(34),(123),(1234), the character of C_perp is χC⊥=(14,−2,−2,2,−2). \chi_{C_\perp}=(14,-2,-2,2,-2). The symmetric-square character obeys χSym2V(g)=12(χV(g)2+χV(g2)), \chi_{\operatorname{Sym}^2 V}(g) =\frac12\left(\chi_V(g)^2+\chi_V(g^2)\right), which gives χSym2(C⊥)=(105,9,9,3,1). \chi_{\operatorname{Sym}^2(C_\perp)}=(105,9,9,3,1). Character projection then yields Sym2(C⊥)≅9𝟏⊕4𝟏′⊕10𝟐⊕14𝟑⊕10𝟑′. \boxed{ \operatorname{Sym}^2(C_\perp) \cong 9\,\mathbf1 \oplus4\,\mathbf1' \oplus10\,\mathbf2 \oplus14\,\mathbf3 \oplus10\,\mathbf3'. } Dimension check: 9+4+20+42+30=105=(14+12). 9+4+20+42+30=105=\binom{14+1}{2}. Corollary: complete quadratic intertwiner count Because V_B = 1 + 3, dimHomS4(Sym2(C⊥),VB)=9+14=23. \boxed{ \dim\operatorname{Hom}_{S_4} \left(\operatorname{Sym}^2(C_\perp),V_B\right) =9+14=23. } Thus: exactly 9 independent quadratic equivariant channels can feed uniform burden; exactly 14 can feed zero-sum burden contrast. This sharply contrasts with the linear classification, where no nonharmonic linear channel reaches the uniform burden sector. Hodge-pair interpretation of the nine invariants The six nonharmonic irreducible blocks occur as three Hodge-paired copies: 3: C0_perp paired with im(B1^T); 3': im(B2) paired with im(B2^T); 1': im(B3) paired with C3. Each pair of equivalent real irreps contributes three invariant symmetric bilinear forms: two norms and one cross-pairing. Hence 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 invariant quadratic scalars, agreeing with the character calculation. Scope This theorem classifies mathematical quadratic equivariant maps. It does not choose which, if any, is the constitutive matter-burden law. no_go/UD_C3_7_SOURCE_COMPLETE_EVOLUTION_NO_GO_v0.1.mdUD C3_7 Source-Complete Evolution No-Go v0.1 Date: 2026-09-08 Status: LOCKED_NO_GO / SOURCE_BLOCKED Physical promotion: 0 Ruling The current governed matter source defines the composite defect label X=(P,n,χ,σ,Φint) X=(P,n,\chi,\sigma,\Phi_{\mathrm int}) and specifies promotion tests for winding, framing, closure stability, recurrence/persistence, boundary robustness, scale robustness, perturbation robustness, charge conjugation, and lower-burden competitor exclusion. It does not supply a source-complete transition map FX:Xt↦Xt+1 F_X:X_t\mapsto X_{t+1} or a continuous evolution equation for the five typed coordinates. In particular, the current source does not define constitutive update laws for winding n; closure branch chi; framing sigma; internal occupancy Phi_int; cross-scale/boundary transport of the full defect label. Therefore a full C3_7 defect evolution law cannot be derived from the present source without adding new constitutive structure. Sourced dynamical sub-laws that remain valid Two distinct sub-carriers do have governed dynamics: Closed oriented-chain support: ċ=𝒜c,𝒜T=−𝒜. \dot c=\mathcal A c, \qquad \mathcal A^T=-\mathcal A. Conditional vertex-burden redistribution: ḃ=−𝒟Bmix(H)b,𝒟Bmix(H)=14BHBT. \dot b=-\mathcal D_B^{\mathrm mix}(H)b, \qquad \mathcal D_B^{\mathrm mix}(H)=\frac14BHB^T. The second law conserves total burden and relaxes contrast. Neither source establishes an identification of c or b with the full defect state X. Frozen shortcuts The following are not admissible as derived C3_7 laws: setting n, chi, sigma, and Phi_int constant merely to force persistence; identifying Phi_int with the chain state without a typed map; identifying chain support with matter burden; selecting boundary/scale update rules ad hoc; choosing a perturbation/noise law after observing candidate survival; treating the existing burden-mixing law as the complete defect evolution. Reopen condition This no-go can be reopened only by an explicit, versioned source addendum or recovered source defining the missing transition maps, their domains/codomains, covariance/symmetry behavior, null limits, and falsifiers. no_go/UD_QUADRATIC_MAP_DOES_NOT_CLOSE_BE_NO_GO_v0.1.mdQuadratic Map Does Not Close B_e — No-Go v0.1 Status: LOCKED_NO_GO The existence of quadratic S4-equivariant maps Sym2(C⊥)→VB \operatorname{Sym}^2(C_\perp)\to V_B does not establish a unique matter-burden law. There are 23 such channels in total and 9 independent channels into the uniform burden sector. Therefore symmetry and polynomial degree alone are insufficient to identify B_e. QISO-1 becomes unique only after adding the explicit candidate rule that the map depend solely on total nonharmonic support and exactly preserve that scalar as total vertex burden. Those are bridge-selection conditions, not presently derived C3_7 constitutive dynamics. Consequently the inference quadratic equivariance⇒Be=S⊥ \text{quadratic equivariance}\Rightarrow B_e=S_\perp is frozen. protocol/UD_C3_7_ROBUSTNESS_COMPETITOR_SUITE_v0.1.mdUD C3_7 Robustness / Competitor Suite v0.1 Status: PREREGISTERED_STRUCTURE / EXECUTION_FAILS_CLOSED_WHERE_SOURCE_MISSING Frozen gates A C3_7 matter candidate is not internally promoted unless all applicable gates are executable and pass: primitive nonzero winding; odd framing; closure/admissibility protection; recurrence/persistence; boundary robustness under absorbing/damped, reflecting, periodic, and open-exclusion treatments; scale robustness from local K4 through multi-packet and larger finite carriers; perturbation robustness under local perturbation, seam noise, branch flips, burden relaxation, and boundary shifts; charge-conjugate partner n -> -n; lower-burden same-charge competitor exclusion; stable native burden B_e. Execution rule A gate is PASS only if its required source law and test carrier are defined before execution. Missing transition, perturbation, boundary, or scale maps yield NOT_EXECUTABLE_SOURCE_BLOCKED, never an inferred PASS. No weighted persistence scalar is permitted unless every weight and threshold is independently sourced. candidate/UD_QISO1_UNIFORM_BURDEN_BRIDGE_CANDIDATE_v0.1.mdQISO-1 Uniform Burden Bridge Candidate v0.1 Status: COMPUTED_BRIDGE_CANDIDATE / ZERO_FREE_PARAMETERS Physical promotion: 0 Candidate selection rule Restrict attention to quadratic maps from the nonharmonic chain carrier to the uniform vertex-burden sector satisfying all of: depend only on the already-defined scalar support S_perp = ||c||^2; S4 covariance; isotropic output on the four vertices; zero maps to zero; nonnegative output for nonnegative support; total output equals the source support exactly; no fitted continuous coefficient. These conditions uniquely force Qiso(c)=S⊥(c)4𝟏4. \boxed{ Q_{\mathrm iso}(c) =\frac{S_\perp(c)}{4}\,\mathbf1_4. } Indeed isotropy gives Q_iso(c)=q(S_perp) 1_4; quadratic dependence on the chain state and dependence only on S_perp gives q=k S_perp; exact total preservation gives 4k=1, hence k=1/4. Therefore 𝟏TQiso(c)=S⊥(c). \boxed{ \mathbf1^TQ_{\mathrm iso}(c)=S_\perp(c). } The normalization 1/4 is derived from the four-vertex carrier; it is not fitted. What this closes It proves that the earlier linear obstruction does not extend to all nonlinear maps. A mathematically lawful quadratic map can reach uniform burden. What remains open The source does not establish the constitutive identity Qiso(c)=bmatter Q_{\mathrm iso}(c)=b_{\mathrm matter} or S⊥=Be. S_\perp=B_e. Support and burden are separate governed carriers. QISO-1 is therefore a frozen hypothesis/bridge candidate for future internal testing, not a derivation of B_e. Removing condition (1) exposes the full nine-dimensional invariant family, so symmetry alone does not uniquely choose QISO-1.

It intentionally ships with calibration_manifest_template.json and run_manifest_template.json unpopulated. Required external files when a source reply arrives raw CSV with at least: timestamp_s h1_cm … h4_cm fL_cm3_s fR_cm3_s populated run_manifest.json populated calibration_manifest.json any referenced source receipts/calibration documents preserved separately Execution Step 1 — freeze without scoring python scorer/freeze_receipts.py \ --raw fresh_run.csv \ --run-manifest run_manifest.json \ --calibration calibration_manifest.json \ --out PRE_SCORE_FREEZE.json This validates schemas/source slots and hashes the three inputs. Step 2 — primary score python scorer/score_primary.py \ --raw fresh_run.csv \ --run-manifest run_manifest.json \ --calibration calibration_manifest.json \ --freeze PRE_SCORE_FREEZE.json \ --out PRIMARY_SCORE_RESULT.json Step 3 — independent score python scorer/score_independent.py \ --raw fresh_run.csv \ --run-manifest run_manifest.json \ --calibration calibration_manifest.json \ --freeze PRE_SCORE_FREEZE.json \ --out INDEPENDENT_SCORE_RESULT.json Step 4 — compare python scorer/verify_dual_score.py \ PRIMARY_SCORE_RESULT.json INDEPENDENT_SCORE_RESULT.json Fail-closed behavior The freeze/scorers refuse if: installed-instrument source identities are missing; uncertainty mode is unset; uncertainty slots are incomplete; run windows are absent; data hashes differ after freeze; measured fL/fR channels are missing; reference/command channels are supplied instead of measured flow; scored windows contain missing/non-numeric values. Synthetic test verification/run_synthetic_verification.py exercises the package on generated data only. No real Córdoba outcome is bundled. Claim boundary Physical promotion remains 0. manuscript/UD_JOP_v2.40_ZERO_TOUCH_CORDOBA_SCORER_ADDENDUM_v0.1.mdJOP v2.40 Addendum — Zero-Touch Córdoba Fresh Comparator Execution Harness v0.1 The source theorem and symbolic metrology are now accompanied by a frozen zero-touch execution harness for a future fresh University of Córdoba QTS run. The scorer consumes only independently measured: (h1,h2,h3,h4,fL,fR) (h_1,h_2,h_3,h_4,f_L,f_R) with source-declared fixed fit windows. Tank-level slopes are estimated by OLS with intercept and branch flows by arithmetic mean over the identical fit windows. The primary residual is R14=14[A1Δm1−A2Δm2−A3Δm3+A4Δm4−ΔfL+ΔfR]. R_{14} = \frac14 \left[ A_1\Delta m_1-A_2\Delta m_2-A_3\Delta m_3+A_4\Delta m_4 -\Delta f_L+\Delta f_R \right]. A separate implementation computes the same residual through branch closure receipts R14=ΔRL−ΔRR4. R_{14} = \frac{\Delta R_L-\Delta R_R}{4}. The package fails closed unless the raw-data hash, predeclared windows, installed-instrument identity receipts, and complete source-authored uncertainty manifest are frozen before scoring. Governing source law The source-predicted edge subchannel is fixed as G14flow=ΔfLmeter−ΔfRmeter4. G_{14}^{\mathrm flow} = \frac{\Delta f_L^{\mathrm meter}-\Delta f_R^{\mathrm meter}}{4}. A_1=A_2=316.82\ {\mathrm cm^2}, \qquad A_3=A_4=184.29\ {\mathrm cm^2}. 1. Frozen raw-data fields The scorer reads only: timestamp_s h1_cm h2_cm h3_cm h4_cm fL_cm3_s fR_cm3_s Additional columns may exist but are ignored. Explicitly barred from the score: fL_ref fR_ref pump/VFD command article-fitted split surfaces valve setting as a substitute for flow tank outcomes used to repair flow calibration 2. Frozen state/window rule Exactly two source-declared windows are required: state0 state1 Each window is specified by exact inclusive zero-based row indices: fit_start_index fit_end_index The indices must be frozen in the run manifest before the outcome scorer is run. No algorithm in this release searches for, shifts, optimizes, expands, contracts, or rejects a window based on the measured result. If the source authors provide their own declared filling-protocol timings, those timings are to be translated into these indices before scoring and frozen in the pre-score receipt. 3. Frozen level estimator For each tank ii and state rr, use ordinary least squares with an intercept over the exact declared window: mi,r=∑n(tn−t‾)(hi,n−h‾i)∑n(tn−t‾)2. m_{i,r} = \frac{\sum_n(t_n-\bar t)(h_{i,n}-\bar h_i)} {\sum_n(t_n-\bar t)^2}. Equivalent centered form is permitted computationally. No robust-regression replacement, smoothing, polynomial fit, endpoint slope, tank removal, or post-hoc transient edit is allowed. 4. Frozen flow-state estimator For each state rr, define the measured branch flow as the arithmetic mean over the same samples used for the level slope fit: fL,rmeter=1Nr∑n∈rfL,nmeter, f_{L,r}^{\mathrm meter} = \frac1{N_r}\sum_{n\in r} f_{L,n}^{\mathrm meter}, fR,rmeter=1Nr∑n∈rfR,nmeter. f_{R,r}^{\mathrm meter} = \frac1{N_r}\sum_{n\in r} f_{R,n}^{\mathrm meter}. Then ΔfL=fL,1meter−fL,0meter,ΔfR=fR,1meter−fR,0meter. \Delta f_L=f_{L,1}^{\mathrm meter}-f_{L,0}^{\mathrm meter}, \qquad \Delta f_R=f_{R,1}^{\mathrm meter}-f_{R,0}^{\mathrm meter}. Flow references and pump commands are never substituted for these measured channels. 5. G_{14}^{\mathrm flow}, \qquad G_{14}^{\mathrm level}, \qquad R_{14}. It also checks the exact identity R14=(RL,1−RL,0)−(RR,1−RR,0)4. R_{14} = \frac{(R_{L,1}-R_{L,0})-(R_{R,1}-R_{R,0})}{4}. 6. Metrology gate This package supports two source-governed uncertainty routes. Route H — hard maximum-error bound The calibration manifest must supply authenticated absolute bounds for: each tank area BAiB_{A_i}; each per-sample level channel BhiB_{h_i}; measured flow BfL,BfRB_{f_L},B_{f_R}; timing bound if material, otherwise an authenticated timing_negligible=true receipt. The scorer propagates the frozen hard-bound theorem. Route C — standard covariance The calibration manifest must supply: a complete 10×1010\times10 covariance matrix for z=(A1,A2,A3,A4,Δm1,Δm2,Δm3,Δm4,ΔfL,ΔfR), z=(A_1,A_2,A_3,A_4,\Delta m_1,\Delta m_2,\Delta m_3,\Delta m_4,\Delta f_L,\Delta f_R), its source/calculation receipt; a pretarget coverage factor kcovk_{\mathrm cov}. The scorer evaluates u2(R14)≈JRΣzJRT. u^2(R_{14})\approx J_R\Sigma_zJ_R^T. 7. No default uncertainty The distributed calibration template deliberately contains no installed-instrument accuracy. The scorer returns: SOURCE_BLOCKED if any required uncertainty slot is null, absent, non-finite, or lacks the declared source receipt identity. No generic WIKA, electromagnetic-flowmeter, NI-DAQ, or catalog tolerance is inserted. 8. Pre-score freeze requirement Before outcome scoring: preserve the raw data file unchanged; populate the run manifest from the source-declared protocol; populate the calibration manifest from authenticated source receipts; run freeze_receipts.py; preserve the resulting PRE_SCORE_FREEZE.json. score_primary.py and score_independent.py refuse execution unless: the raw data hash matches; the run-manifest hash matches; the calibration-manifest hash matches; the package scientific-source hash matches; every required source slot is closed. 9. Verdicts For hard-bound route: EXECUTION_PASS iff |R14| <= B_R14 EXECUTION_FAIL iff |R14| > B_R14 For covariance route: EXECUTION_PASS iff |R14| <= k_cov*u(R14) EXECUTION_FAIL iff |R14| > k_cov*u(R14) Other dispositions: SOURCE_BLOCKED DATA_BLOCKED INTEGRITY_FAIL No alternative metric may replace the primary verdict. 10. Physical claim boundary A PASS would establish a scoped same-apparatus agreement between: directly measured branch-flow contrast, and independently level-derived hydraulic branch contrast, within a pretarget source-authored uncertainty band. It would not establish fundamental physical identity between the UD edge carrier and an established field. PHYSICAL_PROMOTION := 0

Objective Create a genuinely independent Lehigh/Bitlismen tank-side comparator for the already frozen delivered-flow branch contrast Cbr(LEHIGH)=Δq1−Δq2, C_{\mathrm br}^{(\mathrm{LEHIGH})} = \Delta q_1-\Delta q_2, G14,flow(LEHIGH)=Δq1−Δq24. G_{14,\mathrm flow}^{(\mathrm{LEHIGH})} = \frac{\Delta q_1-\Delta q_2}{4}. The target channel must be derived from tank-level/geometry measurements and a source-declared hydraulic isolation configuration, not from the pump command→flow calibration being tested. This comparator is prospective. Existing InTaSet tank outcomes are not used to select or calibrate it. 1. Source-authored hardware facts already available The Lehigh/Bitlismen source family supports: four tank-level pressure measurements; two independently controlled pumps; Pump 1 support on Tanks 1 and 4; Pump 2 support on Tanks 2 and 3; manual valves on tank outlet paths; solenoid control of pump inlet flow; configurable hydraulic couplings using interchangeable tube diameters. The exact 14/2314/23 source law is independent of the unknown pump split fractions. These source facts are sufficient to define a prospective fill-isolation experiment. They are not sufficient to execute it because the public package does not currently provide: source-authored tank level→volume geometry; a Lehigh run-specific valve/isolation configuration receipt; installed level-sensor metrology; authenticated delivered pump-flow telemetry/calibration. 2. Geometry carrier — no cylindrical assumption For each tank i∈{1,2,3,4}i\in\{1,2,3,4\}, require a source-authored volume law Vi=Vi(hi) V_i=V_i(h_i) on the experimental level domain. Define the differential storage capacity Ki(hi):=dVidhi. \boxed{ K_i(h_i):=\frac{dV_i}{dh_i}. } Then the level-derived storage-rate channel is V̇i=Ki(hi)ḣi. \boxed{ \dot V_i = K_i(h_i)\dot h_i. } This formulation does not assume that the tanks are cylindrical or share equal cross-sectional areas. Constant-area specialization Only if a source geometry receipt states that the relevant tank region has constant area AiA_i, Vi(hi)=Aihi+Vi,0, V_i(h_i)=A_i h_i+V_{i,0}, then Ki(hi)=Ai \boxed{ K_i(h_i)=A_i } and V̇i=Aiḣi. \dot V_i=A_i\dot h_i. No Córdoba tank areas, Johansson parameters, numerical-QTP areas, photograph scaling, or generic Bitlismen dimensions may populate this source slot. 3. Frozen hydraulic isolation configuration A scored run must use a source-declared configuration in which all non-pump tank flows entering the storage balance are either: A. physically closed / isolated, or B. independently measured and included as predeclared correction channels. The preferred v0.1 comparator is Mode A: physical isolation. Mode A — fill isolation Before target acquisition, the source/operator receipt must identify the physical valve state showing that, during each scored fill window: pump inlet path is enabled as declared; tank outlet-to-reservoir paths are closed; upper-to-lower/intertank gravity-transfer paths are closed; alternate/bypass outlet paths are closed; no unmeasured drain, overflow, or recirculation path is active. Under this declared configuration: q1,rtank=V̇1,r+V̇4,r, \boxed{ q_{1,r}^{\mathrm tank} = \dot V_{1,r}+\dot V_{4,r}, } q2,rtank=V̇2,r+V̇3,r. \boxed{ q_{2,r}^{\mathrm tank} = \dot V_{2,r}+\dot V_{3,r}. } The pump split fractions inside each branch are irrelevant because the two tank storage rates are summed. Mode B — corrected mass balance Mode B is not executable in v0.1. If the physical rig cannot isolate the non-pump flows, every remaining inflow/outflow term must be independently measured or source-modeled in a separately versioned protocol before scoring. No generic Torricelli coefficient, outlet-orifice area, discharge coefficient, or numerical-model parameter may be inserted into v0.1. 4. Two-state fresh experiment Use two source-declared, non-overlapping fill windows: r∈{0,1}. r\in\{0,1\}. The pump source channel provides independently authenticated delivered-flow states q1,0flow,q1,1flow, q_{1,0}^{\mathrm flow},\quad q_{1,1}^{\mathrm flow}, q2,0flow,q2,1flow. q_{2,0}^{\mathrm flow},\quad q_{2,1}^{\mathrm flow}. The tank-side channel is derived independently from level and geometry. For general geometry, define the window-average tank storage rate V̇‾i,r=1|Wr|∑n∈WrKi(hi,n)ḣi,n, \bar{\dot V}_{i,r} = \frac1{|W_r|} \sum_{n\in W_r} K_i(h_{i,n})\dot h_{i,n}, using the frozen level-derivative estimator and source geometry law. Then q1,rtank=V̇‾1,r+V̇‾4,r, q_{1,r}^{\mathrm tank} = \bar{\dot V}_{1,r} + \bar{\dot V}_{4,r}, q2,rtank=V̇‾2,r+V̇‾3,r. q_{2,r}^{\mathrm tank} = \bar{\dot V}_{2,r} + \bar{\dot V}_{3,r}. Constant-area linear-fill specialization If geometry is constant-area and each source-declared fill window is admitted as linear, mi,r=dhidt|Wr, m_{i,r} = \frac{d h_i}{dt}\Big|_{W_r}, then q1,rtank=A1m1,r+A4m4,r, \boxed{ q_{1,r}^{\mathrm tank} = A_1m_{1,r}+A_4m_{4,r}, } q2,rtank=A2m2,r+A3m3,r. \boxed{ q_{2,r}^{\mathrm tank} = A_2m_{2,r}+A_3m_{3,r}. } This specialization is closest to the already frozen Córdoba comparator but remains a distinct Lehigh experimental object with independently sourced geometry and uncertainty. 5. Independent Lehigh target Define Δq1tank=q1,1tank−q1,0tank, \Delta q_1^{\mathrm tank} = q_{1,1}^{\mathrm tank}-q_{1,0}^{\mathrm tank}, Δq2tank=q2,1tank−q2,0tank. \Delta q_2^{\mathrm tank} = q_{2,1}^{\mathrm tank}-q_{2,0}^{\mathrm tank}. The tank-side target is G14,tank(LEHIGH)=Δq1tank−Δq2tank4. \boxed{ G_{14,\mathrm tank}^{(\mathrm{LEHIGH})} = \frac{ \Delta q_1^{\mathrm tank} - \Delta q_2^{\mathrm tank} }{4}. } The independently sourced pump-flow prediction is G14,flow(LEHIGH)=Δq1flow−Δq2flow4. \boxed{ G_{14,\mathrm flow}^{(\mathrm{LEHIGH})} = \frac{ \Delta q_1^{\mathrm flow} - \Delta q_2^{\mathrm flow} }{4}. } Primary physical residual: R14(LEHIGH)=G14,tank(LEHIGH)−G14,flow(LEHIGH). \boxed{ R_{14}^{(\mathrm{LEHIGH})} = G_{14,\mathrm tank}^{(\mathrm{LEHIGH})} - G_{14,\mathrm flow}^{(\mathrm{LEHIGH})}. } This is not the identity G14=−G23G_{14}=-G_{23} computed twice from the same flow source. It compares pump-side delivered-flow provenance with an independent tank storage-rate measurement path. 6. Exact branch-closure decomposition At state rr, define typed branch closure receipts B1,r=q1,rtank−q1,rflow, B_{1,r} = q_{1,r}^{\mathrm tank} - q_{1,r}^{\mathrm flow}, B2,r=q2,rtank−q2,rflow. Pretarget window rule Before opening the fresh target channel, freeze: run ID; configuration ID; source geometry receipt; valve/isolation state; pump-flow calibration/direct-flow receipt; pump state 0 and state 1; transient exclusion interval; level-fit duration; derivative/slope estimator; uncertainty model and PASS band. No window may move after inspecting R14R_{14}. 8. Isolation qualification gate The operator/source must provide an explicit pretarget isolation receipt. Required fields: pump1_to_tanks_1_4 := confirmed pump2_to_tanks_2_3 := confirmed tank_outlet_to_reservoir_paths := CLOSED intertank_gravity_transfer_paths := CLOSED alternate_upper_outlet_paths := CLOSED unmeasured_bypass_paths := NONE / CLOSED overflow_possible_in_fit_windows := FALSE If a physical path cannot be classified from the source/operator configuration: SOURCE_BLOCKED_CONFIGURATION A photograph alone is not sufficient unless the source operator identifies the valve/path state. A pre-run leak test may be added only after its sensor-derived threshold is frozen. No zero-leak claim is inferred from command state alone. 9. Geometry qualification gate The geometry receipt must provide one of: G1 — full level→volume functions Vi(h) V_i(h) with domain and uncertainty; G2 — level→storage-capacity functions Ki(h)=dVi/dh K_i(h)=dV_i/dh with domain and uncertainty; G3 — constant tank areas Ai A_i with valid level interval and uncertainty. Missing geometry: SOURCE_BLOCKED_GEOMETRY Generic product photographs, Córdoba geometry, Johansson geometry, or inverse fitting from tank-response outcomes are prohibited. 10. No numerical tolerance is defined in v0.1. Until these receipts arrive: NUMERIC_PASS_THRESHOLD := SOURCE_BLOCKED 11. Allowed verdicts SOURCE_BLOCKED_GEOMETRY SOURCE_BLOCKED_CONFIGURATION SOURCE_BLOCKED_PUMP_FLOW SOURCE_BLOCKED_METROLOGY DATA_BLOCKED EXECUTION_PASS EXECUTION_FAIL A blocked result is not converted to a candidate PASS. 12. Cross-platform relationship If this Lehigh comparator is later executed under its frozen uncertainty gate, it becomes the missing second physical comparator required by the existing cross-platform status ladder. Only if: CORDOBA comparator := EXECUTION_PASS LEHIGH comparator := EXECUTION_PASS both source-law lanes := authenticated may the cross-platform reporter assign: DUAL_PHYSICAL_COMPARATOR_REPLICATION_PASS within the scoped QTP experiment. The two comparator residuals are not pooled or normalized against one another. 13. Current source status At freeze time: LEHIGH_LEVEL_CHANNELS := SOURCE_CONFIRMED LEHIGH_MANUAL_OUTLET_VALVES := SOURCE_CONFIRMED_FAMILY LEHIGH_PUMP_INLET_SOLENOIDS := SOURCE_CONFIRMED_FAMILY LEHIGH_CONFIGURABLE_COUPLING_TUBES := SOURCE_CONFIRMED_FAMILY LEHIGH_COUPLING_TUBE_DIAMETER_OPTIONS := {3/8 in, 5/16 in, 1/4 in} LEHIGH_TANK_GEOMETRY := NOT_PUBLICLY_RECOVERED LEHIGH_RUN_SPECIFIC_ISOLATION_STATE := NOT_AVAILABLE LEHIGH_LEVEL_SENSOR_METROLOGY := NOT_RECOVERED LEHIGH_DELIVERED_FLOW_PROVENANCE := NOT_RECOVERED COMPARATOR := PRETARGET_FROZEN EXECUTION := SOURCE_BLOCKED PHYSICAL_PROMOTION := 0 governance/LEHIGH_TANK_GEOMETRY_AND_CONFIGURATION_SOURCE_AUDIT_v0.1.mdLehigh Tank-Geometry and Configuration Source Audit v0.1 Status: PARTIAL_SOURCE_RECOVERY / EXECUTION_BLOCKED Public source recovered Bitlismen product documentation The Quadruple Tank Process Control Research Platform is described as two coupled-tank subsystems. The article does not publish physical tank diameter, cross-sectional area, level→volume calibration, installed outlet-orifice geometry, or a run-specific valve-state table for the laboratory experiments. Those are numerical-QTP model objects and are not promoted to physical Lehigh tank geometry or hardware calibration. Likewise, generic Johansson quadruple-tank parameters are not used.
